acts.name: Awakening and Limgrave
acts.summary: You just opened your eyes in this huge, scary and beautiful world. Time to find friends, gather strength and prepare for the first great trial — Stormveil. I'll be with you, Tarnished!
acts.lore: West Limgrave… I remember its smell — damp earth and ancient magic. Here every stone whispers of old battles. Giants, dragons and mad demi-humans hide in the shadows, but we are not afraid! Because it is right here, among the ruins, that legends are born. Our path to the Ring begins right now.

chapters.name: West Limgrave
chapters.mainGoal: Gather basic tools, meet key allies and unlock the Roundtable Hold.
chapters.summary: We'll start at the Chapel of Anticipation, where I first saw light, and go through every hidden corner of West Limgrave. Every bush, every cave, every stranger — everything matters! We won't miss a single secret, a single reward, and we'll definitely find the way to the Roundtable Hold!

locations.name: Chapel of Anticipation
locations.summary: The very chapel where we first opened our eyes! Everything here is so familiar and yet alien. The place where Tarnished begin their journey.

locations.name: The First Step
locations.summary: A small clearing on top of a cliff where we met a mysterious man in a white mask. From here you can see all of Limgrave!

locations.name: Church of Elleh
locations.summary: A ruined church that smells of incense and old candles. Here lives the merchant Kalé, and at night someone else appears…

locations.name: Gatefront Ruins
locations.summary: A ruined camp of Godrick's soldiers right in front of the castle entrance. Here we got Torrent and the map!

locations.name: Coastal Cave
locations.summary: A dark, damp cave on the western beach, home to evil demi-humans and where poor Boc is hiding.

locations.name: Church of Dragon Communion
locations.summary: A lonely church on an island, reachable only through the cave. Here you exchange dragon hearts for their power.

locations.name: Murkwater River
locations.summary: A narrow riverbed under the bridge, smelling of mud and blood. Here Nerijus attacked us, but Yura came to help!

locations.name: Murkwater Cave
locations.summary: A flooded grotto full of traps and one very cunning merchant called Patches.

locations.name: Waypoint Ruins
locations.summary: Overgrown ruins with poisonous flowers, where the sorceress Sellen languishes in the cellar.

locations.name: Stormhill Shack
locations.summary: A small hut on the windy slope, where Roderika weeps, having lost her companions.

locations.name: Saintsbridge
locations.summary: An ancient stone bridge where knight D warns about the danger in the Summonwater Village.

locations.name: Summonwater Village
locations.summary: A flooded, cursed village where a boatman of death hides in the centre of the lake.

locations.name: Third Church of Marika
locations.summary: A quiet, overgrown church where we found a Sacred Tear and the Flask of Wondrous Physick.

locations.name: Bestial Sanctum
locations.summary: A huge stone sanctuary on the edge of Dragonbarrow, where Gurranq, devourer of Deathroot, dwells.

locations.name: Roundtable Hold
locations.summary: The main hub for all Tarnished! Here are the blacksmith, merchants, Fia's embrace, and wise counsel.

quests.title: Grafted Scion — First Battle
quests.summary: Fight the monster in the Chapel of Anticipation and either defeat it or die to awaken in the Stranded Graveyard.
quests.directions: Right at the start of the game, immediately after character creation, you'll be in a large stone chapel. Walk forward a little and you'll see it. A huge, nightmarish creature hanging on the wall, with many arms like a spider. That's the Grafted Scion. He will jump down at you as soon as you get close enough.
quests.goal: Tarnished, look! This is our very first enemy — the Grafted Scion. He's huge and scary, and I feel he's stronger than us. You can try to fight him, but honestly, it's almost impossible for a beginner. If he kills you — don't worry! That's how it should be. We'll wake up in the cave and start learning. This is just a test of strength.

quests.title: Awakening and Tutorial
quests.summary: Wake up in the cave, complete the tutorial in the Stranded Graveyard, and emerge to the surface.
quests.directions: After dying to the Grafted Scion, you'll awaken in a dark cave. Leave the room, and you'll see a pit on the right with stairs leading down. Go down there — it's the tutorial area, the Stranded Graveyard. There you'll learn to move, attack, dodge and use flasks. When you're done, go back up and head to the glowing lift to rise to the surface.
quests.goal: Let's get out of this cave and try to restore the Ring! There's a scary monster ahead — you could try to fight it, but honestly, without preparation it'll be very tough. First go through the tutorial below — they'll teach us how to move, attack and dodge. That will help us survive!

quests.title: First Grace and White‑Faced Varre
quests.summary: Activate the grace and talk to Varre.
quests.directions: After leaving the Chapel via the lift, you'll immediately see a glowing golden grace on the ground. That is the 'First Step'. A little to the left, on the edge of the cliff, stands a strange man in a white mask — that's Varre. Walk up and talk to him. Just please, don't pay attention to that huge rider in golden armour who roams the plain before you! That's the Tree Sentinel, and he'll crush us with one blow. Just go around him in a wide arc when you move on.
quests.goal: See that man in the white mask, smiling so strangely? That's White‑Faced Varre. Go up to him and talk several times — maybe he'll say something useful. Only, please, don't touch the rider in golden armour who roams the plain! We're not ready for him yet, he'll simply crush us.

quests.title: Church of Elleh and Merchant Kalé
quests.summary: Find shelter at the Church of Elleh, talk to Kalé and buy necessary crafting items.
quests.directions: From the 'First Step' grace, head northeast, but keep left, going around the field where the Tree Sentinel patrols. He is huge and clad in golden armour — if you get too close he'll notice and attack. Better to go around him in a wide arc through the hills. After about a minute you'll see a ruined church with a bell tower — that's the Church of Elleh. Inside, by the warm fire, sits the merchant Kalé. Go talk to him. Be sure to buy the 'Crafting Kit' for 300 runes, the 'Warrior's Cookbook' and all three 'Cracked Pots'.
quests.goal: Oh, look — a church! There should be a merchant. Kalé, I think… Let's go in and buy the crafting kit and pots. We'll be making bombs and arrows! That will come in very handy on the road, so we don't depend on random finds.

quests.title: Breakthrough to the Gatefront Ruins
quests.summary: Sneak past Godrick's soldiers and activate the grace at the castle gate.
quests.directions: From the Church of Elleh continue north along the same road. You'll see wooden barricades and a few of Godrick's soldiers. There aren't many, but they can call for reinforcements. Move past them and you'll enter the camp — on the right by the big gate is the 'Gatefront Ruins' grace.
quests.goal: See the arch and soldiers ahead? That's the Gatefront Ruins. We need to reach the grace, but be careful — there are many of them. Maybe we can run through on horseback? Only we don't have a horse yet… But we can do it! The main thing is not to get into prolonged fights with every soldier. Just push through to the fire.

quests.title: Meeting Melina and Summoning Torrent
quests.summary: Rest at the grace and accept the gift from the mysterious girl.
quests.directions: Just sit at the grace in the Gatefront Ruins. After a few seconds, a cutscene will start. A young girl in a hooded cloak will appear before you — Melina. Listen carefully, she will offer you a deal. Accept her offer, and she will give you the Spectral Steed Whistle to summon Torrent.
quests.goal: Oh, look! A girl in a cloak is sitting nearby. That's Melina! Let's rest and talk to her. She's so mysterious… She'll offer help. Agree! She'll give us Torrent — a loyal steed, and teach us to turn runes into strength. This will change everything!

quests.title: Collecting the Map and Golden Seed
quests.summary: Steal the map from the camp and pick up the Golden Seed at the tree beyond the ravine.
quests.directions: In the centre of the camp, inside the large tent, on a stone stele lies the map of West Limgrave. Just walk up and take it — the soldiers won't notice immediately if you're quick. Then exit through the northern gate of the camp and follow the road north. You'll pass through a narrow ravine with stone walls on both sides. Almost immediately after the ravine, on the left side of the road, you'll see a small glowing golden tree. Next to it lies a Golden Seed.
quests.goal: There in the camp, on the stone stele, lies a map. And beyond the ravine, by the golden tree, there's a seed. We need to grab both quickly and run before the soldiers notice! The map will reveal the whole area, and the seed will give us another flask!

quests.title: Night Meeting with the Witch Ranni
quests.summary: Wait until night at the Church of Elleh and receive the Spirit Calling Bell.
quests.directions: Teleport back to the Church of Elleh. Sit at the fire and choose the option 'Pass time until nightfall'. When the sky darkens and the Erdtree begins to glow with a bluish light, stand up from the fire and look at the ruined wall to the right of the entrance — there you'll see a mysterious woman in a blue dress. That's Ranni. Walk up and talk to her.
quests.goal: Look, night falls, and someone is sitting on the wall! That's the witch Ranni. She seems kind, but very mysterious. Let's go talk, she's clearly waiting for us. Tell her we have Torrent. She will give us a bell and the ashes of wolves!

quests.title: Rescuing Boc from Disguise
quests.summary: Find the demi‑human disguised as a bush and free him.
quests.directions: From the 'Gatefront Ruins' grace ride east along the cliffs. About 200 metres later you'll see a suspicious bush that stands out from the others — it trembles slightly and makes quiet sounds. Hit it with your weapon or roll into it — a demi‑human named Boc will fall out.
quests.goal: It seems someone is calling for help. It's close by, among the bushes. Try to find a strange bush and hit it — maybe it's not just a plant! Boc is hiding there, poor thing. He's in trouble and needs our help.

quests.title: Clearing the Coastal Cave and Tailoring Tools
quests.summary: Defeat the demi‑human chieftains and return Boc's needle and tools.
quests.directions: Enter the cave. It's dark and damp. Inside you'll meet many demi‑humans — they're not very strong, but there are many of them. Go through the cave to the very end, where you'll see a mist wall. Behind it are two demi‑human chieftains. Kill them, take the Tailoring Tools and needle from their corpses, then return to Boc at the entrance.
quests.goal: Inside the cave it's dark and scary. It's full of demi‑humans and probably their chieftains. But we must help Boc. Let's summon the wolves, they'll help us. After the battle, don't forget to grab the Tailoring Tools and give them to Boc. He'll become a great tailor!

quests.title: Exit to the Church of Dragon Communion
quests.summary: Explore the exit from the boss arena and unlock the church.
quests.directions: After defeating the chieftains, do not teleport back to the start of the cave. Instead, go through the tunnel behind the boss arena. It leads upward and brings you out to a small island with a ruined church. Activate the 'Church of Dragon Communion' grace and look around.
quests.goal: Look, there's a passage behind the arena! Let's check where it leads. Maybe there's something interesting? We'll come out to the Church of Dragon Communion — there will be a grace. We don't have dragon hearts yet, but someday we'll return!

quests.title: Invasion of Nerijus and Hunter Yura
quests.summary: Survive the red phantom invasion and defeat him with Yura's help.
quests.directions: Ride Torrent from Lake Agheel north along the riverbed. When you enter the narrow gorge, the screen will darken and an invasion message will appear — it's Nerijus, the Bloody Finger. Don't try to fight him alone, just dodge. After 10‑15 seconds, Yura, the monster hunter, will appear. Together you'll easily defeat Nerijus.
quests.goal: Oh, it seems someone is tracking us! It's Nerijus, the Bloody Finger. He's fast and dangerous. Better to dodge and wait for backup… And here it comes! That's Yura, the hunter. Together we'll defeat him and get Reduvia — a powerful dagger!

quests.title: Dialogue with Yura by the Fire
quests.summary: Talk to Yura and learn about the dragon on the lake.
quests.directions: Go a little further north along the same riverbed. Under a stone overhang by the fire you'll see Yura resting after the fight. Walk up and talk to him until all his dialogue is exhausted. He'll tell you about the dragon that lives on Lake Agheel.
quests.goal: There, by the fire, sits Yura. Let's go talk to him. He'll tell us something important. He'll warn us about the dragon on the lake. Good thing we haven't gone there yet!

quests.title: Murkwater Cave and Patches
quests.summary: Navigate traps, defeat Patches, but spare him to unlock his shop.
quests.directions: Return to the riverbed and find the entrance to Murkwater Cave. Inside, traps await — bells on the floor that make sounds and summon enemies. Carefully avoid them or disarm them. At the end of the cave you'll meet Patches. When he has about 50% health left, he'll surrender — stop attacking immediately! Talk to him, then reset the cave (rest at the grace) and buy 'Margit's Shackle' from him for 5000 runes.
quests.goal: Careful, this cave is full of traps! And at the end a cunning fellow awaits us — Patches. But if we don't kill him when he surrenders, he'll open his shop for us. Try not to finish him off! After the victory we can buy Margit's Shackle from him — it will help a lot against the main boss of the castle!

quests.title: Waypoint Ruins and Sorceress Sellen
quests.summary: Defeat the Pumpkin Head, find Sellen, and become her apprentice.
quests.directions: From the riverbed ride east to the pink poisonous flowers — that's the Waypoint Ruins. Find the stairs down to the cellar. Go down, there you'll be met by the Pumpkin Head — a boss with a huge iron helmet. Kill him, open the door behind him, and talk to Sellen, chained to the wall. Tell her you want to learn magic.
quests.goal: Look, ruins overgrown with poisonous flowers. There should be some boss in the basement… Pumpkin Head. Be careful, but we need to get to the sorceress Sellen. She will teach us magic! This will open up new possibilities!

quests.title: Stormhill Shack and Roderika
quests.summary: Find the weeping girl, talk to her, and receive the jellyfish ashes.
quests.directions: From the Gatefront Ruins head north through the stone arch. Climb up the winding road until you see a wooden shack on the left by the cliff. Inside, sitting on the floor, is a weeping girl in a red hood — Roderika. Talk to her three times until all her dialogue is exhausted. She will give you the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.
quests.goal: Here in the shack, a girl is crying. It's Roderika. She lost her companions. Let's talk to her, maybe she'll give us something useful. She'll give us the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes — a very hardy spirit that will help us in battle.

quests.title: Rescuing Iron Fist Alexander
quests.summary: Find the warrior‑jar stuck in the ground and free him.
quests.directions: From the Shack ride east along the road. Go under the large stone bridge. Immediately after the bridge you'll hear loud cries for help from the right, on a rock. Climb onto the rock — there you'll see a huge jar stuck in the ground. That's Alexander. Approach from behind and hit his back with two‑three charged attacks to pop him out.
quests.goal: Hear the cries for help? That's Alexander, the living jar! He's stuck. We need to approach from behind and give him a good whack on the back — he'll pop out like a cork! Then talk to him. He'll head off to the festival, and we'll meet again.

quests.title: Meeting D (D)
quests.summary: Talk to the knight D at the bridge and learn about the Summonwater Village.
quests.directions: Cross the bridge to the east side. A little further along the road, by a pile of corpses, stands a knight in golden‑silver armour — that's D. Walk up and talk to him. He'll tell you about the Summonwater Village and mark the portal to the Bestial Sanctum on your map.
quests.goal: There, by the pile of bodies, stands a knight in shining armour. That's D. He'll warn us about the danger ahead. Let's listen to him. He'll tell us about the Deathroot and mark the portal on the map. This is important information!

quests.title: Summonwater Village and Tibia Mariner
quests.summary: Defeat the boatman of death and claim the Deathroot.
quests.directions: From Saintsbridge head east, then turn south towards the half‑flooded village. In the centre of the village, in the water, you'll see a boat and the figure of the Tibia Mariner. Immediately mount Torrent and attack him up close, ignoring the skeletons he summons. After victory, take the Deathroot and the Skeleton Militiamen Ashes.
quests.goal: Here, in the water, the Tibia Mariner awaits us — the boatman of death. He summons skeletons, but we need to hit him. Ride Torrent and attack him up close, ignoring the ghosts! After victory, take the Deathroot — it will be very useful to us.

quests.title: Report to D
quests.summary: Show the Deathroot to D and gain access to the portal.
quests.directions: After the battle, return to D — he will be standing on the outskirts of the village. Show him the Deathroot. He will be surprised by your courage and mark the hidden portal to the Bestial Sanctum on your map.
quests.goal: Let's show D this Deathroot. He'll be surprised we managed it. He'll mark the portal on the map that leads to the Bestial Sanctum. This will open new opportunities for us.

quests.title: Third Church of Marika
quests.summary: Find the church, collect the Sacred Tear and the Flask of Wondrous Physick.
quests.directions: Following D's marker or the map, find the Third Church of Marika — it's south of the Summonwater Village, in the forest. Enter inside, take the Sacred Tear at Marika's statue, and in the stone bowl on the right take the Flask of Wondrous Physick.
quests.goal: The Third Church of Marika — a quiet place. Here we'll find the Sacred Tear, which strengthens our flasks. And also the Flask of Wondrous Physick — with it we can make temporary buffs! This will really help us in battle.

quests.title: Using D's Secret Portal
quests.summary: Find the hidden portal behind the church and teleport to the Bestial Sanctum.
quests.directions: Leave the church through the east wall. Go north through the water into the ravine hidden by bushes. At the end of the ravine you'll see a shimmering air portal. Activate it — it will take you north, right to the Bestial Sanctum.
quests.goal: The portal is hidden in the ravine behind the church. Let's find it. I sense strange magic… It will take us right to the Bestial Sanctum. This will be our secret path!

quests.title: Bestial Sanctum and Gurranq
quests.summary: Enter the Sanctum, give the Deathroot to Gurranq, and receive rewards.
quests.directions: Carefully avoid the Watchdog on the stairs. Enter the building, activate the grace inside. Approach the giant creature in the back — that's Gurranq. Give him the Deathroot. He will give you the Beast Eye and the Beast Seal.
quests.goal: Careful, outside there's a huge monster! Go around it and enter the Sanctum. Inside — Gurranq, the beast clergyman. Give him the Deathroot. He'll give us the Beast Eye and the Beast Seal. And around the Sanctum we can farm runes from vulgar militiamen — they give 1000 runes each!

quests.title: Meeting Melina and the Roundtable Hold
quests.summary: Accept Melina's invitation and teleport to the main hub.
quests.directions: Sit at any grace (for example, in the Bestial Sanctum). Melina will appear and offer to take you to the Roundtable Hold. Just agree.
quests.goal: Melina is with us again. She says she's ready to take us to the Roundtable Hold. It's a place where all Tarnished gather. Let's agree! We'll finally find a real home!

quests.title: Exploring the Roundtable Hold
quests.summary: Talk to all important NPCs in the hub and accept Fia's embrace.
quests.directions: Visit all the rooms: Corhyn by the fire, Diallos in the corner, Gideon in the library, Hewg in the smithy, Fia in the dark room. Talk to each until all dialogue is exhausted. When you approach Fia, agree to her embrace. Then use the 'Baldachin's Blessing' she gives you to remove the health penalty.
quests.goal: So many people here! Let's talk to everyone. There's Corhyn selling incantations, Diallos looking for his servant, and Gideon who knows everything. And Fia will even embrace us — but be careful, her embrace gives a buff, but while the item is in our inventory, we have -5% health. Use it to remove the effect.

chapters.name: East Limgrave and Mistwood
chapters.mainGoal: Complete Kenneth Haight's quest, obtain the left half of the Dectus Medallion, meet Blaidd, get the Bloodhound's Fang, and scout the Siofra River.
chapters.summary: From meeting Kenneth Haight to activating the underground world — we'll go through all the important points of East Limgrave, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Roadside Ruins (Kenneth Haight)
locations.summary: A ruined arch where Kenneth Haight calls for help.

locations.name: Fort Haight
locations.summary: A captured fort where the left half of the Dectus Medallion is kept.

locations.name: Mistwood Ruins
locations.summary: Ancient ruins where Blaidd the Half‑Wolf dwells.

locations.name: Church of Elleh
locations.summary: A ruined church where merchant Kalé dwells.

locations.name: Forlorn Hound Evergaol
locations.summary: An isolated arena where the Bloodhound Knight Darriwil is imprisoned.

locations.name: Siofra River Well
locations.summary: The entrance to the underground world of the Siofra River.

quests.title: Meeting Kenneth Haight
quests.summary: Talk to Kenneth Haight and take his quest.
quests.directions: Head east from the Summonwater Village along the main road. After about 300 metres you'll see a ruined stone arch. To the right of the arch there are stones you can climb to get to the top. Climb up — Kenneth Haight stands there. Talk to him.
quests.goal: Hear those shouts? Up on the ruins stands some important gentleman. That's Kenneth Haight. He's asking for help — his home, the fort, has been taken by enemies. Let's climb up and talk to him, maybe he knows something important!

quests.title: Clearing Fort Haight and the Dectus Medallion
quests.summary: Clear the fort of enemies and take the left half of the Dectus Medallion.
quests.directions: From Kenneth's ruins ride southeast along the road to the very edge of the land. You'll see a massive stone fortress on a rise — that's Fort Haight. Enter through the broken southern gate, clear the courtyard of demi‑humans, and climb the fortress wall. On the wall you'll be met by Godrick's knight commander — defeat him. Then climb the wooden ladder to the highest tower. In a chest at the top lies the left half of the Dectus Medallion.
quests.goal: Ahead is Fort Haight, teeming with demi‑humans and soldiers. We need to break through the courtyard, climb the walls, defeat their knight commander, and reach the highest tower. In a chest there lies our goal — a shiny half of a medallion!

quests.title: Kenneth's Reward
quests.summary: Return to Kenneth and receive your well‑deserved reward.
quests.directions: Return to the ruined arch where you first met Kenneth. He is still there. Talk to him — he will thank you. Then teleport to the 'Fort Haight' grace (it appears after clearing the fort) and enter inside. Kenneth will be standing on the wall where you killed the knight. Talk to him until his dialogue starts repeating.
quests.goal: Well, let's go back to Kenneth and tell him the good news! He must be terribly worried. Then we'll agree to enter his service and meet him already in the liberated fort, on the wall.

quests.title: Triggering the Howl in Mistwood Ruins
quests.summary: Visit the ruins and hear Blaidd's howl.
quests.directions: From Saintsbridge ride west into the depths of the Mistwood. Stay on the main road until you see ruined stone walls on the right — that's the ruins. In the centre, on the highest surviving wall, sits Blaidd. Just approach the ruins to hear his howl.
quests.goal: Let's go into the Mistwood Ruins. There, in the very centre, comes a strange, plaintive howl. A silhouette flickers on the high wall. We just need to approach and hear it.

quests.title: The 'Finger Snap' Gesture from Kalé
quests.summary: Return to Kalé and learn how to summon Blaidd.
quests.directions: Teleport to the Church of Elleh in West Limgrave. Approach Kalé sitting by the fire. In the dialogue menu a new option will appear: 'Ask about the howl in Mistwood'. Select it. Kalé will smile and teach you the 'Finger Snap' gesture.
quests.goal: We go back to our warm Church of Elleh to the merchant Kalé. Let's ask him about the howl in the woods. He's an old and wise fellow — he'll surely teach us how to call that wolf.

quests.title: Meeting Blaidd
quests.summary: Use the gesture and talk to Blaidd.
quests.directions: Return to the Mistwood Ruins. Stand directly under the wall where Blaidd is sitting (the highest surviving wall in the centre of the ruins). Open the gesture menu and select 'Finger Snap'. Blaidd will jump down to the ground. Approach and talk to him until he tells you about Darriwil.
quests.goal: Back into the misty ruins. Stand right under the wall where that giant wolf is sitting and do that 'Finger Snap'. He'll jump down and speak to us. He's looking for a traitor.

quests.title: Forlorn Hound Evergaol and the Bloodhound's Fang
quests.summary: Defeat the Bloodhound Knight Darriwil with Blaidd's help and claim the legendary Bloodhound's Fang.
quests.directions: At the southernmost part of Limgrave, on a rise to the left of the road, find a large circular stone ring on the ground surrounded by stone spheres on worms. Stand in the centre of the ring and activate the entrance to the evergaol. Inside, do not run straight to the glowing boss portal — look at the ground before you. There will be a golden summon sign for Blaidd. Activate it, then enter the portal. Together with Blaidd, defeat Darriwil.
quests.goal: We found the Evergaol — a glowing circle on the ground. Let's enter and be sure to summon our friend Blaidd via the golden sign! Together we will defeat that traitor Darriwil and claim the Bloodhound's Fang — a blade worthy of great warriors.

quests.title: The Siofra River Well Lift
quests.summary: Find and activate the lift to the underground world.
quests.directions: Return to the Mistwood. Find a large round stone domed building north of where you picked up the map. It looks like a small fortress with a dome — that's the Siofra River Well. Enter inside, stand on the platform in the centre, and activate the lift. It will descend for about a minute — enjoy the view!
quests.goal: There, deep in the Mistwood, hides an ancient round building. It looks like a small fortress. Let's go inside and stand on the platform in the centre — it will carry us deep underground, to the beautiful and dangerous river.

quests.title: Siofra River Map
quests.summary: Find the map of the underground world and activate the grace.
quests.directions: Upon exiting the lift, immediately activate the 'Siofra River Well' grace. Then run forward through the ruins (ignoring or killing the slow clay warriors), mount Torrent and ride the large lift in the wall to ascend to the open plain. Ride forward to the temple on the steps — the map lies on a corpse. Then activate the 'Siofra River Bank' grace on the right.
quests.goal: Let's explore a bit of this underground beauty! We'll exit the lift, activate the grace, ride through the ruins, and ascend the next lift. There, by the temple, lies the body of a poor soul with a map of this area. Oh, and we'll activate one more grace, right by the bank.

chapters.name: Weeping Peninsula
chapters.mainGoal: Fully explore the Weeping Peninsula: collect all Sacred Tears, Smithing Stones, key items, complete the quests of Irina and Edgar, obtain legendary weapons, and prepare for the assault on Stormveil.
chapters.summary: From crossing the Bridge of Sacrifice to the end of the tragic story of Irina and Edgar — we will go through all the important points of the peninsula, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Bridge of Sacrifice
locations.summary: The bridge leading to the Weeping Peninsula, guarded by soldiers and a ballista.

locations.name: Irina's Spot by the Road
locations.summary: A small roadside resting place where the blind girl Irina sits.

locations.name: Castle Morne Bastion
locations.summary: A fortification at the entrance to the peninsula, where you can find a map and a merchant.

locations.name: Demi‑Human Forest Ruins
locations.summary: Overgrown ruins inhabited by demi‑humans and their queen.

locations.name: Oridys's Rise
locations.summary: A sealed tower that can be opened by striking three ghostly tortoises.

locations.name: Village of the Sick
locations.summary: A forsaken village where mad inhabitants roam.

locations.name: Callu Baptismal Church
locations.summary: A ruined baptismal church with the first Sacred Tear on the peninsula.

locations.name: Church of Pilgrimage
locations.summary: A small church on the northern cape, where you can find a second Sacred Tear.

locations.name: Earthbore Cave
locations.summary: A dark cave where a Rune Bear dwells.

locations.name: Wandering Mausoleum
locations.summary: A giant stone structure on legs that can be brought down.

locations.name: Tombsward Catacombs
locations.summary: Underground catacombs where you can find the Lhutel the Headless ashes.

locations.name: Fourth Church of Marika
locations.summary: A church on the west coast where you can find a third Sacred Tear.

locations.name: Witchbane Ruins
locations.summary: A cellar where the real body of Sorceress Sellen is imprisoned.

locations.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack
locations.summary: A hut on the west coast where you can buy a Lantern and the Zweihander.

locations.name: Morning Evergaol
locations.summary: An evergaol where the Ancient Hero of Zamor is imprisoned.

locations.name: Morne Tunnel
locations.summary: A mine where you can find many Smithing Stones.

locations.name: Castle Morne – Castellan's Tower
locations.summary: The tower where Castellan Edgar resides.

locations.name: Castle Morne – Rear Courtyard and Beach
locations.summary: The southern part of the castle leading to the beach where the Leonine Misbegotten dwells.

quests.title: Cross the Bridge of Sacrifice and Take the Stonesword Key
quests.summary: Fight through the bridge fortifications and find the Stonesword Key.
quests.directions: From the Gatefront Ruins ride south along the main road to the very end of Limgrave. You'll see a massive stone bridge with wooden fortifications and a ballista — that's the Bridge of Sacrifice. Soldiers and the ballista guard the passage, so be ready for a fight or a swift dash. Immediately behind the barricade, on an old chair to the right, lies a skeleton holding a Stonesword Key — take it.
quests.goal: Let's head to the southernmost part of Limgrave! See that stone bridge bristling with spears? That's the Bridge of Sacrifice. We'll break through the soldiers and the ballista, and right behind the barricade, on an old chair, lies a poor skeleton. In its hand glitters a Stonesword Key — it will be very useful!

quests.title: Meet Irina and Take the Letter
quests.summary: Talk to the blind Irina and agree to deliver her letter to her father.
quests.directions: Immediately after the Bridge of Sacrifice, on the right side of the road, a blind girl in a simple dress sits on a stone — that is Irina. Activate the grace nearby and talk to her. She will ask you to deliver a letter to her father Edgar at Castle Morne. Agree to help — this is the start of an important quest.
quests.goal: Just past the bridge, by the road, a golden grace flickers. Beside it, on a stone, sits a girl in a plain dress. That's Irina, she is blind. Approach, talk to her and take the letter for her father — the Castellan of Castle Morne. She needs our help very much.

quests.title: Activate 'Castle Morne Bastion' Grace and Take the Region Map
quests.summary: Reach the bastion, activate the grace, and take the map.
quests.directions: From Irina's spot head south along the main road. After a couple of minutes you'll see a stone stele with a map and a grace nearby — that's Castle Morne Bastion. Take the map from the stele, activate the grace and talk to the merchant by the fire.
quests.goal: Let's continue south along the main road. There, by the stone stele, a map of this misty peninsula awaits us. We'll activate the grace nearby — and the whole region will be laid out before us!

quests.title: Nomadic Merchant and Night's Cavalry
quests.summary: Talk to the merchant, buy pots and a Stonesword Key, then defeat the Night's Cavalry.
quests.directions: A nomadic merchant sits by the fire at the Bastion. Buy Cracked Pots x3 and another Stonesword Key from him. Then sit at the grace, choose 'Pass time until nightfall'. When it gets dark, the Night's Cavalry will appear on the road — fight and defeat him.
quests.goal: Look, a nomadic merchant by the fire. Let's buy some spare Cracked Pots and another Stonesword Key from him. And when night falls, a Night's Cavalry will ride down this road — a dangerous rider in black armour. We'll fight him and claim his power!

quests.title: Golden Seed and Clearing the Demi‑Human Forest Ruins
quests.summary: Take the Golden Seed and defeat the Demi‑Human Queen.
quests.directions: From Castle Morne Bastion ride west toward the forest. Slightly to the right of the road, by a glowing tree, lies a Golden Seed — pick it up. Then enter the Demi‑Human Forest Ruins (overgrown ruins with wooden structures), fight your way to the centre and defeat the Demi‑Human Queen.
quests.goal: West of the road, by the golden tree, a seed glimmers — let's pick it! Then we'll explore those dark ruins where the demi‑humans hide. Their queen possesses magical power, but we'll prevail and take her staff and spell.

quests.title: Oridys's Rise Puzzle
quests.summary: Solve the tortoise puzzle and obtain a Memory Stone.
quests.directions: From the Demi‑Human Forest Ruins head east onto the high ground. You'll see a tall stone tower on a hill — that's Oridys's Rise. A book lies at the entrance. To open the tower, you need to find and strike three ghostly tortoises: one to the left of the entrance in the bushes, one to the right in the bushes, and one invisible in the pond behind the tower (strike the splashes in the water). After that, the tower will open.
quests.goal: Before us is a sealed tower, and at the entrance lies a magical puzzle book. We need to find three ghostly tortoises: one in the bushes on the left, one on the right, and one invisible in the pond behind the tower (just hit the water!). Once all are defeated, the tower will open and we'll get a Memory Stone!

quests.title: Clearing the Village of the Sick and the Stalwart Talisman
quests.summary: Pass through the village, carefully fighting the mad inhabitants, and find the Stalwart Talisman.
quests.directions: From Oridys's Rise head northwest, climbing onto the plateau. You'll see ruined houses — that's the Village of the Sick. Inside, mad inhabitants roam who inflict madness status. Clear the village and find the Stalwart Talisman (it lies near one of the houses).
quests.goal: Let's ascend to the plateau, to that very Village of the Sick we heard whispers about. Its inhabitants are mad and dangerous, they scream and claw. We need to carefully clear each house and find the Stalwart Talisman — it will help us resist such curses.

quests.title: Callu Baptismal Church and the Sacred Tear
quests.summary: Take the first Sacred Tear on the peninsula.
quests.directions: From the Village of the Sick head south across the plateau. You'll see a ruined church at the cliff's edge — that's Callu Baptismal Church. Inside, by Marika's statue, lies a Sacred Tear — take it.
quests.goal: There, amid the ruins, stands Callu Baptismal Church — an old shrine. Let's approach Marika's statue; at her feet shines a Sacred Tear. We'll take it, and our flasks will be filled with even greater healing power!

quests.title: Church of Pilgrimage and the Second Sacred Tear
quests.summary: Take the second Sacred Tear in the church.
quests.directions: From Callu Baptismal Church ride to the northern cape. The church stands at the very edge of the cliff, overlooking the sea. Enter and take the Sacred Tear by the statue.
quests.goal: On the northern cape, over the cliff, nestles a little Church of Pilgrimage. Let's enter, pray and take another Sacred Tear. The more tears, the stronger our life force!

quests.title: Earthbore Cave and the Rune Bear
quests.summary: Clear the cave and defeat the Rune Bear.
quests.directions: From the Church of Pilgrimage descend to the cliffs in the northeast. The cave entrance is hidden among the rocks — you'll see a dark passage leading into the cliff. Go through the cave to the end and defeat the Rune Bear. The talisman lies on a corpse behind it.
quests.goal: Among the rocks hides a dark cave — the lair of a Rune Bear. He is huge and mean, but his hide is soaked in magic. We'll defeat him and take the Magic Scorpion Charm so magic attacks become nothing to us.

quests.title: Bring Down the Wandering Mausoleum
quests.summary: Knock off the growths on the mausoleum's legs to make it lower.
quests.directions: Descend into the central lowland of the peninsula. You'll see a giant stone structure slowly walking on four legs — that's the Wandering Mausoleum. Ride Torrent alongside it and knock off the white skull‑growths on its legs until it lowers to the ground.
quests.goal: See that huge stone tomb on legs roaming the plain? That's the Wandering Mausoleum. Knock off the white skull‑growths on its legs — it will get tired, lower itself, and allow us to enter. Inside we can duplicate the power of fallen demigods!

quests.title: Tombsward Catacombs and Lhutel the Headless Ashes
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs and defeat the Cemetery Shade.
quests.directions: Just south of the Wandering Mausoleum, by the cliffs, you'll see the catacomb entrance. It is sealed by fog — use a Stonesword Key to enter. Go through the dungeon to the end, defeat the Cemetery Shade, and claim the Lhutel the Headless ashes from the chest behind the boss.
quests.goal: Before us is a dark entrance to catacombs, sealed by a stone sword. Use our Stonesword Key. Inside, skeletons roam, and in the depths dwells the Cemetery Shade. We'll overcome it — and gain the ashes of Lhutel the Headless! She will stand as a wall, taking hits for us.

quests.title: Fourth Church of Marika and the Third Sacred Tear
quests.summary: Take the third Sacred Tear.
quests.directions: From the Tombsward Catacombs head west to the coastline. The church stands at the cliff's edge, right over the sea. Inside, by the statue, lies a Sacred Tear — take it.
quests.goal: On the western coast, above the sea, stands the Fourth Church of Marika. This is the third and last tear on the peninsula. Let's take it — and our flasks will reach their peak of power in these lands!

quests.title: Sellen's Real Body in Witchbane Ruins
quests.summary: Find Sellen's real body and talk to her.
quests.directions: South of the Fourth Church of Marika, descend into the cellar of Witchbane Ruins. The entrance is among the rubble. Inside you'll see Sellen chained to the wall — her real body. Talk to her, but do not attack! Nearby lies the spell 'Ambush Shard'.
quests.goal: In these grim ruins there is a cellar where the echoes of strange moans resound. Let's descend and find the chained sorceress Sellen — her real body. Talk to her, but for heaven's sake, do not attack! Otherwise her quest will be broken forever. Nearby lies the spell 'Ambush Shard'.

quests.title: Isolated Merchant's Shack
quests.summary: Visit the shack and buy the Lantern and Zweihander.
quests.directions: On the westernmost coast, between the Fourth Church and the Morning Evergaol, stands a lone merchant's shack. Enter, talk to him and buy the Lantern and the Zweihander.
quests.goal: On the west coast, in a lone shack, lives a merchant. He has a wonderful Lantern you can hang on your belt, and a huge greatsword called Zweihander — a strength‑build dream! Let's buy them to light our way and boost our strikes.

quests.title: Morning Evergaol and the Ancient Hero of Zamor
quests.summary: Defeat the Ancient Hero of Zamor and obtain the talisman.
quests.directions: From the merchant's shack go back slightly to the plain where you see a large stone ring on the ground — that's the Morning Evergaol. Use a Stonesword Key to enter, and defeat the Ancient Hero of Zamor. The talisman drops after the victory.
quests.goal: See that magic ring on the ground? That's the Morning Evergaol. Let's open it with our Stonesword Key. Inside, the Ancient Hero of Zamor awaits — a warrior from the icy wastes. Let's defeat him to get the Radagon's Scarseal talisman — it will strengthen our whole body!

quests.title: Morne Tunnel and Smithing Stones
quests.summary: Clear the mine, collect stones, and defeat the boss.
quests.directions: In the centre of the peninsula, beneath the hanging bridges, there is an entrance to a deep ravine. Descend — you'll see the entrance to Morne Tunnel. Go through the mine, collecting Smithing Stones from the walls, and defeat the Scaly Misbegotten at the end.
quests.goal: Nearby there is an entrance to a mine — Morne Tunnel. There they chip out Smithing Stones with pickaxes. Let's clear this shaft, collect all the stones [1] and [2] to upgrade our weapons to a brilliant shine! At the end lurks the Scaly Misbegotten — we'll crush it.

quests.title: Castle Morne and Castellan Edgar
quests.summary: Reach the castle, find Edgar, and deliver the letter.
quests.directions: Ride to the southernmost tip of the peninsula to the huge castle. Dodge the giant arrows of the golem archer at the gate, break inside and activate the grace by the lift. Ride the lift up, pass through the first courtyard, climb the stairs onto the battlements — at the top of the corner tower you will find Edgar. Hand him Irina's letter.
quests.goal: Here is Castle Morne, shrouded in mist! Dodge the arrows of the huge golem, pass through the courtyards and climb the walls. In the corner tower, the Castellan Edgar awaits. Let's deliver the letter from his daughter — he must know she is alive and waiting for him.

quests.title: Clearing Castle Morne and the Leonine Misbegotten
quests.summary: Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten and obtain the Grafted Blade Greatsword.
quests.directions: Descend from the battlements to the rear courtyard, activate the 'Behind the Castle' grace. Then climb down the cliffs and hanging bridges to the southernmost shore. Enter the foggy passage on the beach and fight the Leonine Misbegotten. After victory, take the Grafted Blade Greatsword.
quests.goal: We descend from the battlements to the rear courtyard, go along the cliffs toward the fog‑shrouded beach. There, in the passage, the Leonine Misbegotten awaits — a monster born of the castle's darkness. It will be a tough fight, but we'll take from it the legendary Grafted Blade Greatsword!

quests.title: The Finale of Irina and Edgar's Quest
quests.summary: Return to Irina's spot and exhaust Edgar's dialogue.
quests.directions: Teleport to the grace just beyond the Bridge of Sacrifice — where you first met Irina. Approach the place where she used to sit. You'll find Edgar over his daughter's body. Exhaust his dialogue to the end.
quests.goal: We won, and Edgar is finally free. But... let's return to where we left Irina. I have a bad feeling... Go to the Bridge of Sacrifice and see what happened. Beside Irina's body now stands Edgar, driven mad by grief. Talk to him.

chapters.name: Stormveil
chapters.mainGoal: Storm Stormveil Castle, defeat Margit and Godrick, activate all quests and collect all hidden items.
chapters.summary: From approaching the castle to the final battle with Godrick — we will go through all floors, secret dungeons and complete key quest lines.

locations.name: Stormhill Shack
locations.summary: Starting point for the assault on the castle.

locations.name: Castleward Tunnel
locations.summary: Grace at the castle entrance, before the bridge to Margit.

locations.name: Margit's Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with Margit, the Fell Omen.

locations.name: Gostoc's Guard Room
locations.summary: The gatekeeper Gostoc's room, where he offers a detour.

locations.name: Rampart Tower
locations.summary: The upper part of the castle, from where the path to Rogier and beyond opens.

locations.name: Rogier's Chapel
locations.summary: The chapel where the sorcerer Rogier is located.

locations.name: Grafted Scion Hall
locations.summary: A dark hall with a mini‑boss and a room with a pile of bodies.

locations.name: Nepheli Loux's Room
locations.summary: A small storage room where you meet Nepheli.

locations.name: Liftside Chamber
locations.summary: A room with a lift that opens a shortcut.

locations.name: Secret Underground Beneath the Castle
locations.summary: A flooded chasm with a boss and Godwyn's face.

locations.name: Secluded Cell
locations.summary: Grace before the battle with Godrick.

locations.name: Godrick's Arena
locations.summary: The throne room where you fight Godrick.

locations.name: Roundtable Hold (after Godrick)
locations.summary: Hub for completing quests and activating spirit tuning.

quests.title: Approaching the Castle
quests.summary: Teleport to the shack and break through the fortifications to the tunnel.
quests.directions: Open the map and teleport to the 'Stormhill Shack' grace. Mount Torrent and ride along the paved road northwest toward the castle. Dash past soldiers at the barricades, dodge ballista bolts in the narrow passage, then ride into the long stone tunnel — there activate the 'Castleward Tunnel' grace.
quests.goal: Let's teleport to the Stormhill Shack. Mount Torrent and ride at full speed along the road littered with soldiers and ballistas. We must break through to the tunnel in the cliff, where the saving grace 'Castleward Tunnel' burns. This is our first step inside!

quests.title: Summoning Rogier against Margit
quests.summary: Summon Rogier and defeat Margit, the Fell Omen.
quests.directions: From the 'Castleward Tunnel' grace climb the stairs. At the entrance to the arena, on the right, you will see a golden summon sign — summon Rogier. Enter the mist, summon spirits, use Margit's Shackle (if you have it) and fight. After victory, activate the grace on the arena.
quests.goal: Let's climb the stairs to the misty arena. Look, at the entrance shines a golden sign — it's Rogier! Let's summon him. We'll enter the mist, summon our spirits, and if we have Margit's Shackle, use it to pin him to the ground. Let's crush this Fell Omen!

quests.title: Deal with Gostoc
quests.summary: Talk to Gostoc and agree to the detour.
quests.directions: After defeating Margit, cross the ruined bridge to the main gate. Do not try to open them — to the left there is a small door. Enter inside, there sits one‑armed Gostoc. Talk to him until dialogue is exhausted and agree to his offer.
quests.goal: Behind the main gate, on the left, is the guard room. There hides Gostoc — the one‑armed gatekeeper. Talk to him, listen to his cautious speech, and agree to the detour. He will lead us through secret paths to avoid the traps at the main gate.

quests.title: Path through the Rampart Tower and Meeting Rogier
quests.summary: Take the detour, reach the tower, descend to the chapel, and talk to Rogier.
quests.directions: Exit through the wall breach from Gostoc's room. Climb the narrow rocky paths and wooden scaffolds along the walls. Enter the tower, activate the 'Rampart Tower' grace. Then go out onto the roofs and reach the chapel (jump onto its roof and enter through the window). Inside, by the altar, Rogier sits — talk to him.
quests.goal: Let's go through the breach, climb the wooden scaffolds, dodging the cries of birds of prey. In the Rampart Tower we will light a grace, and then descend into the old chapel. There, among the pews, Rogier awaits. Let's ask him everything.

quests.title: Chrysalids' Memento
quests.summary: Avoid the Grafted Scion and take the quest item.
quests.directions: From the chapel exit and go into the dark hall with the Grafted Scion. Sneak past it (or kill it). Then enter the adjacent room where a troll hangs and a pile of bodies lies. Approach the pile and take the Chrysalids' Memento.
quests.goal: We'll leave the chapel and peek into the dark hall where the many‑legged Grafted Scion prowls. We can slip past it quietly, like mice. Further on is a room with a troll hanging from the ceiling and a mountain of bodies below. There, among the fallen, lies the Chrysalids' Memento. Let's take it — Roderika needs it.

quests.title: Meeting Nepheli Loux
quests.summary: Find and talk to Nepheli Loux.
quests.directions: From the Grafted Scion hall exit into the inner courtyard. Run along the right side into the small storeroom (before the dead end with the giant). Inside you will find Nepheli. Talk to her, exhaust her dialogue.
quests.goal: We'll dash through the inner courtyard to the little storeroom on the right. Inside, among barrels, stands a warrior in an iron helm. That is Nepheli Loux. Talk to her, listen to her story — she lost her men and thirsts for revenge against Godrick.

quests.title: Activating the Lift and Shortcut
quests.summary: Activate the lift and open the doors for fast travel.
quests.directions: From Nepheli's room exit into the courtyard, run past the giant up the stairs, enter the room on the left and activate the 'Liftside Chamber' grace. Stand on the lift, ascend, then open the large wooden doors leading back to the courtyard.
quests.goal: We'll run past the giant to the small room on the left. There burns the 'Liftside Chamber' grace. We'll stand on the lift, go up, and open the large wooden doors. Now we can quickly reach Godrick from any point in the castle!

quests.title: Secret Underground and Ulcerated Tree Spirit
quests.summary: Descend into the dungeon, defeat the boss, and activate Rogier's quest trigger.
quests.directions: From the 'Liftside Chamber' grace exit into the courtyard, turn right to the cliff where a corpse sits. Drop onto a beam, then onto the next, and so on down to the bottom. You'll land in a flooded chasm — there is the boss. After victory, find the bloodstain before Godwyn's face and activate it.
quests.goal: From the 'Liftside Chamber' grace we'll go out into the courtyard and turn right to the cliff. Down there, fragile beams — we'll jump down them like stairs. In the flooded chasm we'll meet the Ulcerated Tree Spirit. Let's defeat it! And then find the bloodstain before the terrible face of Godwyn and touch it.

quests.title: Preparation for the Godrick Fight
quests.summary: Reach the grace before the boss and activate Nepheli's summon sign.
quests.directions: Return to the lift in the 'Liftside Chamber', ascend, and go through the open shortcut (through the large doors) past where the giant stood, to the fog gate. Activate the 'Secluded Cell' grace. At the entrance to the fog, find Nepheli's golden sign and summon her.
quests.goal: We'll return to the lift and go through the open shortcut to the 'Secluded Cell' grace. From here the throne room is just a stone's throw away. And at the fog entrance, Nepheli's golden sign awaits us. Let's summon her — together we are strong!

quests.title: Godrick the Grafted
quests.summary: Defeat Godrick and obtain his Great Rune and Remembrance.
quests.directions: Enter the mist. Summon spirits and Nepheli. In the first phase, dodge his strikes, hit his back. When he cuts off his arm and grafts a dragon head, stay at his side or behind him — that's the blind spot for his fire breath. Defeat him, claim the rewards.
quests.goal: We'll enter the mist. Summon spirits and Nepheli. In the first phase, dodge his wild swings, and when he grafts the dragon head, strike the blind spot at his side. The fire breath won't reach us there. Let's crush the demigod!

quests.title: Chrysalids' Memento and Roderika
quests.summary: Return to the Roundtable, give the Memento to Roderika, and start her training with Hewg.
quests.directions: Teleport to the Roundtable Hold. Approach Roderika by the fireplace, give her the Chrysalids' Memento. Then talk to Hewg about Roderika, return to her, again to Hewg, choose 'Look after Roderika'. Rest at the grace, then find Roderika by the blacksmith and talk to her.
quests.goal: We'll teleport to the Roundtable Hold. Approach Roderika by the fireplace, give her the Memento. Then whisper to Hewg about her talent, return to her, back to Hewg, rest at the fire, and see her sitting next to the blacksmith, ready to become a Spirit Tuner.

quests.title: Returning for the Crimson Hood
quests.summary: Go back to the room with the pile of bodies and collect the hood.
quests.directions: Teleport to Stormveil at the 'Rampart Tower' grace. Descend to the hall with the Grafted Scion, then to the room with the troll and the pile of bodies. Climb the pile and take the Crimson Hood, which appeared there after you gave the Memento.
quests.goal: Now that the Memento is with Roderika, a new item has appeared in that gruesome room with the troll and bodies — the Crimson Hood. Let's go back there (teleport to Rampart Tower and descend), climb the pile of bodies and take it. It will warm us and boost our health.

quests.title: Continuing Rogier's and Fia's Quest
quests.summary: Talk to Rogier on the balcony and ask about his wound.
quests.directions: In the Roundtable Hold, find Rogier on the balcony (in a wheelchair). Talk to him, ask about his wound and about what you saw beneath the castle (Godwyn's face and the bloodstain). Exhaust his dialogue.
quests.goal: Let's find Rogier in the Roundtable Hold — he now sits on the balcony in a wheelchair. We'll talk to him about his wound, about what we saw in the dungeon, and about Godwyn's face. His words will connect us with Fia and her secrets.

acts.name: Liurnia of the Lakes
acts.summary: We breathed the damp air of Liurnia! After grim Stormveil, this land feels like a fairy tale — endless lakes, crystal caves, and secrets hidden in mist. Time to make new friends and find out how to enter the mysterious Academy.
acts.lore: Liurnia — a land where magic once bloomed like water lilies. Now exiles, albinaurics and strange merchants live here. But beneath the water lie ruins of ancient kingdoms, and ahead awaits the Raya Lucaria Academy, where great knowledge languishes. We need to weave a web of alliances to get inside.

chapters.name: South Liurnia
chapters.mainGoal: Fully unlock the southern map, collect tears and keys, help Hyetta, Rya, Patches, Thops and Blackguard, and obtain the Glintstone Key without disturbing the sleeping dragon.
chapters.summary: From our first steps at the lakeside cliffs to the decisive dash past the dragon Smarag — we will explore every patch of land, complete five quest chains, and prepare for the assault on the Academy.

locations.name: Lake-Facing Cliffs
locations.summary: The first grace of Liurnia after the dark castle. Here we are greeted by fresh wind and the blind girl Hyetta.

locations.name: Church of Irith
locations.summary: A half‑ruined church where a Sacred Tear and the exiled mage Thops hide.

locations.name: Liurnia Lake Shore
locations.summary: A quiet harbour with a map, a merchant, and a view of the island where an old acquaintance waits.

locations.name: Scenic Isle
locations.summary: A tiny islet where Patches shares rumours about the Iron Virgin.

locations.name: Boilprawn Shack
locations.summary: Blackguard's hut, smelling of boiled prawns and the secret of Rya.

locations.name: Village of the Albinaurics
locations.summary: A flooded, ravaged village where albinaurics and the warrior Nepheli hide.

locations.name: Lakeside Crystal Cave
locations.summary: A sparkling cave swarming with crystals and snails, leading to Latenna.

locations.name: Slumbering Wolf's Shack
locations.summary: A secluded corner where Latenna waits for someone to take her home.

locations.name: Purified Ruins
locations.summary: Ruins with a secret cellar where Hyetta awaits the second grape.

locations.name: Glintstone Dragon Smarag's Spot
locations.summary: A dangerous islet where the Glintstone Dragon sleeps, guarding the Academy key.

quests.title: Entering Liurnia and First Meeting with Hyetta
quests.summary: Activate the grace, take the Golden Seed, and talk to Hyetta.
quests.directions: Exit Godrick's throne room through the rear exit (or go around the castle on the right). Just beyond the door you will see a glowing grace on the cliffs — that is 'Lake-Facing Cliffs'. Activate it. A golden tree grows by the road — pick the Golden Seed. Then approach the blind girl standing by the road (this is Hyetta), and give her the Shabriri Grape you picked up in Godrick's throne room.
quests.goal: Let's step out of the throne room into the light. Here, on the cliffs, a grace stands — light it. See the golden tree? Pick the seed. Now look at the road: a blind girl Hyetta sits there. Give her the first Shabriri Grape we found in the castle — it was waiting for her.

quests.title: Church of Irith and Meeting Thops
quests.summary: Take the Sacred Tear and talk to the mage Thops.
quests.directions: From 'Lake-Facing Cliffs' descend the slope to the half‑ruined building standing a little lower by the road. This is the Church of Irith. Enter, take the Sacred Tear from Marika's statue. Then approach the mage Thops sitting on the bench, talk to him, and donate 10 runes to start his quest.
quests.goal: Let's descend to the church nestled by the road. Inside, at the feet of Marika's statue, shines a Sacred Tear — let's take it. And on the bench sits a lonely mage Thops. Talk to him and donate 10 runes — even such a small gesture gives him hope.

quests.title: Map of East Liurnia and the Merchant
quests.summary: Activate the grace, take the map, and talk to the merchant.
quests.directions: From the Church of Irith head north to the lake shallows. Activate the 'Liurnia Lake Shore' grace. The map lies by the stele — take it. Then approach the merchant sitting by the fire and buy the Lantern and the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11] from him.
quests.goal: Let's go down to the water, where the 'Lake Shore' grace burns. The map lies by the stele — it will reveal the eastern lands. And by the fire sits a merchant. Buy the Lantern (to free your hands) and the recipe book from him. It will always come in handy.

quests.title: Rya and Her Necklace
quests.summary: Find Rya in the gazebo and take her quest to retrieve the necklace.
quests.directions: From 'Lake Shore' ride north through the shallows, keeping a little to the left, heading for the bird telescope. You will find a round stone gazebo. Inside sits Rya. Talk to her and agree to help recover the stolen necklace.
quests.goal: Let's ride north through the shallows, towards the stone gazebo. Inside sits a lovely girl named Rya. Talk to her — she will tell you that some brute stole her necklace. Promise to find it.

quests.title: Patches on Scenic Isle
quests.summary: Talk to Patches and learn the rumour about the Iron Virgin.
quests.directions: From 'Lake Shore' ride northwest to a small rocky islet with the 'Scenic Isle' grace. There sits Patches. Talk to him, listen to his rumour about the Iron Virgin under the Academy.
quests.goal: Let's visit the tiny islet — there, by a lone tree, sits our old friend Patches. Talk to him. He will tell you about the Iron Virgin that can teleport you straight to the Erdtree. But don't go near it yet, okay?

quests.title: Blackguard and Rya's Necklace
quests.summary: Redeem the necklace from Blackguard and buy a prawn from him.
quests.directions: From 'Scenic Isle' ride northwest to the 'Boilprawn Shack'. Enter, talk to Big Boggart, redeem the necklace for 1000 runes. Then be sure to buy at least one Boiled Prawn and talk to him again so he becomes your ally.
quests.goal: Here is the Boilprawn Shack. Inside is gruff but honest Boggart. Redeem Rya's necklace for 1000 runes. Then be sure to buy at least one Boiled Prawn and talk to him again. That will show him we respect his work.

quests.title: Returning the Necklace to Rya
quests.summary: Return the necklace to Rya and receive the Invitation to Volcano Manor.
quests.directions: Return to the stone gazebo where you met Rya. Give her the necklace, exhaust her dialogue, and receive the Invitation to Volcano Manor.
quests.goal: Let's go back to Rya's gazebo and give her the necklace. She will be overjoyed and give us the Invitation to Volcano Manor — a beautiful scroll that will come in handy later.

quests.title: Village of the Albinaurics and Nepheli
quests.summary: Find Nepheli in the village and talk to her.
quests.directions: From the Boilprawn Shack ride far southwest, under the overhanging stone plateau. Enter the dark cave beneath the cliff and climb the winding path past hanged bodies. Exit at the 'Village of the Albinaurics' grace. Under the stone bridge you will find Nepheli — talk to her.
quests.goal: Let's ride into the flooded village — it is hidden from prying eyes. Under the bridge stands Nepheli, our warrior acquaintance. Talk to her. She is investigating a brutal massacre and will be glad of our help.

quests.title: Albus' Secret Medallion
quests.summary: Find Albus disguised as a pot, and take the right half of the Secret Haligtree Medallion.
quests.directions: From the 'Village of the Albinaurics' grace climb the hill to the well. To the right by the rock stands a large lone pot. Hit it — that is Albus. Talk to him and take the right half of the Secret Haligtree Medallion.
quests.goal: Let's climb the hill to the well. See that big pot by the rock? It trembles strangely... Hit it! This is Albus, an old albinauric. Talk to him, and he will give us the right half of the Secret Haligtree Medallion. This is a very important item, but I warn you — after this we may face trouble at the Roundtable.

quests.title: Omenkiller
quests.summary: Defeat the Omenkiller with Nepheli's help.
quests.directions: Cross the bridge from where Albus was. On the arena before you will be the Omenkiller. On the floor to the left you will see a golden summon sign for Nepheli — activate it and defeat the boss together.
quests.goal: Cross the bridge from where Albus was. There, in the mist, the Omenkiller will appear — a grotesque monster with a scythe. But on the floor shines Nepheli's golden sign! Let's summon her and defeat the enemy together. She is so eager for revenge.

quests.title: Lakeside Crystal Cave and the Bloodhound Knight
quests.summary: Clear the cave and defeat the Bloodhound Knight.
quests.directions: From the Village of the Albinaurics descend back to the lake shallows and ride east along the southern rocky wall. Find the cave entrance, overgrown with crystals, guarded by snails. Go through the cave to the end, defeat the Bloodhound Knight, take the Spear Talisman, and exit through the passage to the Slumbering Wolf's Shack.
quests.goal: Along the southern wall of rocks hides a cave sparkling with crystals. Let's go through it, wary of snail snipers, and defeat the Bloodhound Knight. Behind him — the exit to Latenna and a useful Spear Talisman.

quests.title: Latenna and Her Ashes
quests.summary: Talk to Latenna, show her the medallion, and receive her ashes.
quests.directions: Exit the cave through the passage behind the boss arena — you will reach the Slumbering Wolf's Shack. Activate the grace, approach Latenna sitting next to the wounded wolf, show her the Secret Medallion, and promise to carry her home. She will transform into ashes.
quests.goal: Let's exit the cave to the little shack. There, beside the wounded wolf, sits Latenna. She cannot walk. Show her the Secret Medallion Albus gave us, and promise to take her to the Haligtree. She will turn into ashes and become our spirit — a very accurate archer!

quests.title: Purified Ruins and the Second Grape
quests.summary: Find the second Shabriri Grape and a recipe book.
quests.directions: Teleport to the eastern shore of the lake (slightly north of the starting nomadic camp) and find the Purified Ruins. In the centre of the ruins there is a wooden floor — break it and descend into the cellar, take the second Shabriri Grape. Then search the nearby Raya Lucaria soldier camp — in a chest lies the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1].
quests.goal: Hyetta said she would wait for us at the Purified Ruins. Let's go there! In the centre of the ruins there is a wooden floor — break it and go down into the cellar. There lies the second Shabriri Grape. Also search the soldiers' camp nearby — there is a recipe book there.

quests.title: Second Meeting with Hyetta
quests.summary: Find Hyetta in the ruins and give her the second grape.
quests.directions: Hyetta has moved to the Purified Ruins. Find her among the ruins, give her the second grape, and exhaust her dialogue.
quests.goal: Hyetta should be somewhere here, among the walls. Find her and give her the second Shabriri Grape. She will be endlessly grateful and continue her journey.

quests.title: Academy Glintstone Key
quests.summary: Take the key from the dragon Smarag without engaging in battle.
quests.directions: Ride west from the Academy, to the high rock jutting out of the water. Before it sleeps the Glintstone Dragon Smarag. Go around him from behind, find the sorcerer's corpse with the key, take the key and quickly leave without fighting.
quests.goal: To the west of the Academy sleeps the huge Glintstone Dragon Smarag. Behind him lies the corpse of a sorcerer with the Glintstone Key. We need to sneak there very quietly, take the key, and run away. It is not yet time to fight the dragon, and we cannot enter the Academy yet — that would break our friends' quests.

chapters.name: Raya Lucaria Academy
chapters.mainGoal: Full playthrough of the Academy: helping Yura, collecting all items, battles with the Red Wolf and Rennala, obtaining the second key for Thops.
chapters.summary: From entering the Academy to defeating Rennala — we will go through all floors, hidden passages and rooftops, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: South Gate of Raya Lucaria
locations.summary: The entrance to the Academy through the magical barrier.

locations.name: Main Academy Gate
locations.summary: Grace by the lift leading inside.

locations.name: Ruined North Bridge
locations.summary: The bridge where you can help Yura in battle.

locations.name: Church of the Cuckoo
locations.summary: The first interior grace of the Academy.

locations.name: Monastery Cemetery
locations.summary: A foggy cemetery with zombies and a hidden armour set.

locations.name: Water Wheel Lift
locations.summary: A huge rotating wheel that leads to the upper floors.

locations.name: Schoolhouse Classroom
locations.summary: Grace in the classroom area, near the lecture halls.

locations.name: Debate Parlor
locations.summary: The arena of the Red Wolf of Radagon.

locations.name: Academy Rooftops
locations.summary: The upper route with parkour and a hidden hatch.

locations.name: Grand Library of Raya Lucaria
locations.summary: The arena of Queen Rennala.

quests.title: Passing Through the Barrier
quests.summary: Use the Glintstone Key at the south gate and activate the grace.
quests.directions: Teleport to the 'South Gate of Raya Lucaria' grace. Approach the giant blue magical barrier and choose the action 'Use Academy Glintstone Key'. Cross the bridge and immediately activate the 'Main Academy Gate' grace.
quests.goal: We stand before the blue magical barrier. It shimmers and ripples. Let's use our Glintstone Key — it will fit like a key to a lock. We'll cross the bridge and light the 'Main Academy Gate' grace to secure our foothold.

quests.title: Finding the Hidden Path on the North Bridge
quests.summary: Go along the ruined bridge to the north to find Yura's sign.
quests.directions: From the 'Main Academy Gate' grace, turn your back to the lift and walk north along the half‑ruined bridge. Carefully step past the debris until you see a red summon sign on the stone slabs.
quests.goal: Don't rush to the lift! Let's turn around and carefully, over the rubble, walk north along the ruined bridge. I sense a familiar presence — Yura is somewhere here. Look for the red summon sign, hidden among the stones.

quests.title: Invasion to Help Yura
quests.summary: Activate the red sign, help Yura defeat Ravenmount, and claim the reward.
quests.directions: Activate the red summon sign on the bridge. You will be transported to Yura's world and fight alongside him against the Bloody Finger Ravenmount. After victory, you will automatically return to your world. Yura will be standing in the same spot — talk to him until his dialogue is exhausted.
quests.goal: Touch this red sign. We will enter Yura's world, where he fights the Bloody Finger Ravenmount. Help him destroy the enemy! After the victory, we will be thrown back, and Yura will be waiting right here — talk to him.

quests.title: Church of the Cuckoo and Activating the Grace
quests.summary: Return to the lift, ascend, and reach the Church of the Cuckoo.
quests.directions: Return to the 'Main Academy Gate' grace, step onto the central platform of the giant lift, and ride up into the interior. At the top, exit into the corridor, kill the two sorcerers, go into the left wing of the building, and activate the 'Church of the Cuckoo' grace.
quests.goal: Now let's return to the main gate and step onto the lift. It will take us up into a corridor full of puppet sorcerers. Fight through them and activate the 'Church of the Cuckoo' grace — it will be our beacon.

quests.title: Clearing the Cemetery and Albinauric Armour Set
quests.summary: Cross the cemetery, defeat enemies, and find the hidden armour set.
quests.directions: Exit the Church of the Cuckoo through the side door onto the grim cemetery. Fight through the zombies and cross the first suspension bridge. On the next bridge, look over the railing to the right and down — there is a hidden path. Drop down and take the Albinauric armour set.
quests.goal: Let's exit the Church through the side door — it leads to the foggy cemetery. Slow but dangerous zombies roam here. We'll fight through them to the bridge, then drop down onto the hidden path below. There, under the bridge, lies a full Albinauric armour set.

quests.title: Climbing the Water Wheel
quests.summary: Jump onto the rotating wheel and ride it to the upper level.
quests.directions: Move through the cemetery, dodging archers, until you reach the cyclopean rotating water wheel. Time your jump and leap onto the rising stone platform. At the top, quickly jump off onto solid ground in the doorway, kill the guard sorcerer, and activate the 'Schoolhouse Classroom' grace.
quests.goal: Before us is a huge rotating wheel. Wait for a wooden platform to rise from below and jump onto it. It will carry us up, right to the schoolrooms. There we kill the sorcerer and immediately light the 'Schoolhouse Classroom' grace.

quests.title: Exploring the Classrooms and the Illusory Wall
quests.summary: Clear the lecture halls, find the scroll, open the illusory wall, and claim Comet and the mask.
quests.directions: From the 'Schoolhouse Classroom' grace, go down the corridor ahead, clear the lecture halls of sorcerers. In one of the rooms, on a desk, find the Classroom Scroll. Continue down the corridor, find a bookshelf on the left with no books on it. Strike it — the wall will disappear. Take the sorcery 'Comet' and the Sage's Mask.
quests.goal: Let's walk through the corridors, peeking into every room. We need the Classroom Scroll — it's on the desk. Then find the bookshelf without books. Strike it, and a secret passage will open! Inside lie the sorcery 'Comet' and the Sage's Mask.

quests.title: Red Wolf of Radagon
quests.summary: Defeat the Red Wolf and obtain a Memory Stone.
quests.directions: Return to the main corridor, climb the wide stone stairs, wary of the sorcerer ambush and the giant living jar, to the misty veil. Summon spirits and engage the Red Wolf of Radagon. After victory, activate the 'Debate Parlor' grace.
quests.goal: Let's return to the main corridor and climb the stairs. Beyond it is the mist and the Red Wolf of Radagon. He is fast as lightning and fights with magic. Summon spirits and dodge. Defeat him to claim the Memory Stone.

quests.title: The Second Glintstone Key on the Chandelier
quests.summary: Climb to the rooftops, parkour across, and claim the key on the chandelier in the Church of the Cuckoo.
quests.directions: Exit the Debate Parlor through the ruined archway into the inner courtyard. Turn left, run along the wall, climb the wooden scaffolding onto the stone bridge ledge, and vault over the railing onto the roof. Move across the rooftops to the west, fighting off puppets, break through stained glass windows, and descend onto the beams of the Church of the Cuckoo. On the chandelier, find a corpse with the key.
quests.goal: Let's go into the courtyard from the Debate Parlor, turn left, and climb the wooden scaffolding onto the roofs. We'll walk along the beams, break the stained glass, and descend into the Church of the Cuckoo. There, on the huge chandelier, lies the corpse of a sorcerer with a key — this is the second Glintstone Key for Thops!

quests.title: Moongrum, Carian Knight
quests.summary: Defeat Moongrum before the lift to Rennala.
quests.directions: Return to the Debate Parlor, exit into the courtyard, run along the rocky slope, dodging the giant iron balls. At the top platform in the next hall, before the lift, you will meet Moongrum. Use jumping or heavy attacks to break through his guard and defeat him.
quests.goal: Let's go back into the courtyard and avoid the huge magic ball that rolls after us. At the top, Moongrum awaits — a knight with a shield and sword. Don't attack him continuously; he parries! Use jumps or powerful charged attacks to break his stance.

quests.title: Queen Rennala of the Full Moon (Phase 1)
quests.summary: Defeat Rennala in the first phase by striking the glowing students.
quests.directions: Enter the Grand Library. Rennala floats in a golden cocoon, while her students sing around her. Ignore the ordinary mobs, look for the student with a golden aura (the one throwing books). Hit her once to break the aura. Repeat this three times with different students, after which Rennala will fall to the floor.
quests.goal: Let's enter the library. Rennala floats in a golden cocoon, and her students sing around her. But one of them shines brighter — that is her shield. Find and strike the glowing maiden to dispel the aura. Repeat three times, and Rennala will fall.

quests.title: Queen Rennala of the Full Moon (Phase 2)
quests.summary: Defeat Rennala in the second phase and claim her rune.
quests.directions: After the cutscene, dodge the initial attack, summon spirits, constantly attack Rennala while ignoring the summoned phantoms, and defeat her. After victory, activate the 'Grand Library of Raya Lucaria' grace.
quests.goal: We stand in the lunar glow. Rennala summons giant phantoms — a dragon, a wolf, a knight. Don't waste time on them! Dodge the first attack, summon our wolves, and strike the queen herself in the centre. Her magic is strong, but her body is fragile. Let's crush her!

chapters.name: Final Cleanup of Liurnia
chapters.mainGoal: Complete all side quests in the region, collect key items, and prepare for the transition to the Starscourge Wastes without prematurely activating the Altus Plateau.
chapters.summary: From completing Thops' line to defeating the Magma Wyrm Makar — we will go through all remaining points to close all loose ends and open new possibilities.

locations.name: Church of Irith
locations.summary: A half‑ruined church where Thops awaits us.

locations.name: Schoolhouse Classroom
locations.summary: The area where Thops' body can be found.

locations.name: Iji's Anvil
locations.summary: The workshop of the giant blacksmith on the road to the manor.

locations.name: Caria Manor
locations.summary: A huge manor haunted by ghosts and knights.

locations.name: Three Sisters
locations.summary: An open area with three towers — Ranni, Seluvis, and Renna.

locations.name: Ranni's Rise
locations.summary: The abode of the witch Ranni.

locations.name: Seluvis's Rise
locations.summary: The tower of the treacherous sorcerer Seluvis.

locations.name: Roundtable Hold
locations.summary: A reliable shelter for all Tarnished.

locations.name: Siofra River Bank
locations.summary: A point in the underground world where Blaidd awaits us.

locations.name: Black Knife Catacombs
locations.summary: Dark catacombs where a secret boss hides.

locations.name: Four Belfries
locations.summary: A place with portals to various corners of the world.

locations.name: Ruin‑Strewn Precipice
locations.summary: A dangerous slope leading to the Magma Wyrm.

quests.title: The Key for Thops
quests.summary: Return to the Church of Irith and give Thops the second Glintstone Key.
quests.directions: Teleport to the 'Church of Irith' grace in southern Liurnia. Inside the church, find Thops on the bench and give him the second Glintstone Key.
quests.goal: Let's visit our friend Thops at the Church of Irith. He has waited so long for this moment! We'll give him the second Glintstone Key, and his dream of returning to the Academy will finally come true. Let's have a final word with him.

quests.title: Thops' Final Rest
quests.summary: Find Thops' body in the Academy and take his belongings.
quests.directions: Teleport to the 'Schoolhouse Classroom' grace in the Academy. Go out to the rotating lift, and to the right by the wall behind the table you will find Thops' body. Take his staff and sorcery.
quests.goal: Let's go to the Schoolhouse Classroom. There, by the rotating lift, lies our poor friend... He could not survive his return. We'll take his Staff and the sorcery 'Thops's Barrier' — may his knowledge aid us on our journey.

quests.title: Meeting Iji
quests.summary: Talk to the blacksmith Iji on the road to the manor.
quests.directions: From the Church of Irith head northwest along the road to Caria Manor. Iji's anvil is right by the road at the crossroads. Approach and talk to him.
quests.goal: On the road to Caria Manor we will meet a giant blacksmith. That is Iji, a friend of Ranni. Let's talk to him, stock up on smithing stones, and learn what is happening at the manor.

quests.title: Loretta, Royal Knight
quests.summary: Traverse Caria Manor and defeat Loretta.
quests.directions: From Iji's anvil follow the road northwest, it will lead straight to the manor gates. Inside the manor, fight through ghosts and knights; at the end of the hall you will meet Loretta. Battle her.
