quests.goal: Caria Manor will meet us with ghosts and knights. We need to break through them, for at the end Loretta awaits — a royal knight guarding the path to the witch. Let's fight her and prove we are worthy to proceed!

quests.title: Service to Ranni
quests.summary: Talk to Ranni in her tower and agree to serve her.
quests.directions: From the Three Sisters, approach the tower with a blue light on top — that is Ranni's Rise. Climb to the top and talk to her. Agree to serve her.
quests.goal: Let us ascend Ranni's tower. She sits in her chair, surrounded by moonlight. Let's talk to her and agree to serve. This is the start of a great and perilous path, but it will lead us to the secrets of the Ring!

quests.title: Ranni's Allies
quests.summary: Talk to Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis at the base of the tower.
quests.directions: Descend from Ranni's tower to the Three Sisters plaza. There you will find Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis. Talk to each until their dialogue is exhausted.
quests.goal: Let us descend, where Ranni's loyal servants await us. Blaidd growls, Iji clangs his hammer, and Seluvis watches with a sly glint. Let's speak with each of them — they will tell us about their tasks.

quests.title: Farewell to Ranni
quests.summary: Return to Ranni and speak to her again to lift the barrier.
quests.directions: Ascend Ranni's tower again and talk to her. She will lift the barrier.
quests.goal: Let's go up to Ranni once more. She will remove the magical barrier, and we can continue on our way. This is our farewell for now — a long road to Nokron lies ahead.

quests.title: Seluvis's Potion
quests.summary: Visit Seluvis's tower and take the potion from him.
quests.directions: In the Three Sisters, find the tower with a purple glow — that is Seluvis's Rise. Climb to the top, talk to him, and take the potion.
quests.goal: Let's enter Seluvis's tower. He will greet us with a venomous smile and give us a potion, asking us to give it to Nepheli. We'll take the potion, but we won't harm our friend — we'll give it to Gideon instead!

quests.title: Rescuing Nepheli
quests.summary: Give Seluvis's potion to Gideon for disposal.
quests.directions: Teleport to the Roundtable Hold. Find Gideon in the library and give him the potion.
quests.goal: We teleport to the Roundtable and find Gideon sitting among his books. We'll hand over the dangerous potion — he will understand what it is and destroy it. Thus we save Nepheli!

quests.title: Blaidd in Siofra
quests.summary: Find Blaidd in the Siofra River and tell him about Radahn.
quests.directions: Teleport to the 'Siofra River Bank' grace (you unlocked it in Chapter 2). Blaidd stands on a rise near the spirit spring in the upper part of Siofra. Approach and talk to him.
quests.goal: Let's descend to the underground Siofra River, where Blaidd awaits us. He stands at the cliff, bewildered. We will tell him that the path to Nokron is blocked by Radahn, and to proceed we must attend the festival in the Starscourge Wastes.

quests.title: Fia's Embrace
quests.summary: Accept Fia's embrace and receive the Weathered Dagger.
quests.directions: In the Roundtable Hold, find Fia's room (it is in the side corridor). Talk to her and agree to the embrace. Afterwards, she will give you the Weathered Dagger.
quests.goal: Let's find Fia in her room at the Roundtable. She will offer us an embrace — do not refuse, it is part of her secret ritual. After the embrace, she will give us the Weathered Dagger.

quests.title: The Dagger for D
quests.summary: Give the Weathered Dagger to the knight D.
quests.directions: In the central hall of the Roundtable, find D. Give him the dagger.
quests.goal: D stands in the central hall. We will give him the dagger as Fia asked. He will frown but accept it. Something is not right here...

quests.title: Fia's Tragedy
quests.summary: Find Fia in the room behind the blacksmith and take the Twin Armour set.
quests.directions: Rest at the grace in the Roundtable, then approach the room behind Hewg the blacksmith — it will open. Inside you will find Fia and D's body, take the Twin Armour set.
quests.goal: Let's rest at the fire, and the door behind the blacksmith will open. We'll enter and see a sad scene: Fia and D lie lifeless. We'll take the Twin Armour set in their memory.

quests.title: Black Knife Catacombs
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs and defeat the secret boss to obtain the Black Knifeprint.
quests.directions: The catacombs are on the eastern edge of Liurnia, by the cliffs, not far from the road to Caelid. Go through the dungeon to the end and defeat the boss. The Black Knifeprint lies in a chest after the boss.
quests.goal: Let's find the dark catacombs hidden among the rocks. We'll sneak through traps and skeletons, defeat the secret boss, and obtain the Black Knifeprint — Rogier needs it for his research.

quests.title: Studying the Knifeprint
quests.summary: Give the Black Knifeprint to Rogier at the Roundtable.
quests.directions: In the Roundtable Hold, find Rogier on the balcony (he is in a wheelchair). Give him the Black Knifeprint.
quests.goal: Let's return to Rogier on the balcony. He is already waiting. We'll give him the Knifeprint — he will study it and tell us more about the conspiracy against Godwin and how it relates to Fia.

quests.title: The Stormhawk King
quests.summary: Use the Four Belfries portal to reach the Chapel of Anticipation, and claim the Stormhawk King.
quests.directions: Find the Four Belfries in western Liurnia. Enter the tower with the portal leading to the Chapel of Anticipation (it is on the upper platform). Activate the portal, go to the Chapel, climb to the second floor, and take the Stormhawk King from where you awoke.
quests.goal: We'll head to the Four Belfries. There, in one of the towers, is a portal to our home Chapel of Anticipation. We'll go through it and find what Nepheli so needs — the legendary Stormhawk King!

quests.title: Magma Wyrm Makar
quests.summary: Defeat Magma Wyrm Makar at the Ruin‑Strewn Precipice, but do not activate the lift to Altus.
quests.directions: In northeastern Liurnia, in a dead end by the cliffs, there is a path leading to the precipice. At the end you will face the Magma Wyrm. Defeat it, then do not use the lift and do not activate any graces on the Altus Plateau.
quests.goal: The last battle in Liurnia! We will fight Magma Wyrm Makar on the lava‑drenched slopes. We will defeat him and claim our reward, but remember: do not approach the lift and do not light any graces on the Altus Plateau, or our quests will break!

acts.name: Underground World
acts.summary: We have descended underground, where false stars shine! It is so quiet and majestic here, but ancient spirits hide beneath the stones. Time to explore the Siofra River, light the sacred flames, and meet an old friend.
acts.lore: The Siofra River is not just water. It is the very blood of the Lands Between, flowing in the depths, nourishing the roots of the Erdtree. Here, in eternal twilight, dwell ancestral spirits, and their fiery pillars are the memory of those who came before us. We must honour them and unravel the mystery of the starry sky beneath the earth.

chapters.name: Siofra River
chapters.mainGoal: Explore the upper tier of the Siofra River, light all 8 flame pillars, defeat the Ancestor Spirit, meet Blaidd, and collect all key loot.
chapters.summary: From descending into the underworld to defeating the Ancestor Spirit — we will go through all the important points of the region, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Siofra River Well
locations.summary: The entrance to the underground world through a round stone building in the Mistwood.

locations.name: Siofra River Well Depths
locations.summary: The first grace after the descent, near the ruins of clay warriors.

locations.name: Siofra River Bank
locations.summary: The main grace of the region, near the map and the first pillar.

locations.name: Hallowhorn Grounds
locations.summary: A sacred place where the Ancestor Spirit can be summoned.

locations.name: Merchant on the Dam
locations.summary: A merchant's camp in a stone building on the dam.

locations.name: Blaidd's Spot in Siofra
locations.summary: A point by the spirit spring where Blaidd stands.

locations.name: Ancestor Spirit Arena
locations.summary: The battleground with the Ancestor Spirit after activating the deer carcass.

quests.title: Descent into the Siofra River Well
quests.summary: Find the entrance, descend on the lift, and activate the first grace.
quests.directions: Head to the eastern part of the Mistwood in Limgrave. Find the round stone building marked 'Siofra River Well' — it is located south of the Third Church of Marika and north of the Minor Erdtree. Enter inside and activate the lift platform to descend into the dungeon. Once the platform reaches the bottom, immediately activate the 'Siofra River Well Depths' grace.
quests.goal: Tarnished, remember that round building in the Mistwood? That is the entrance to an underground fairy tale — the Siofra River Well. Let's go in, step onto the platform, and slowly descend where a whole world hidden in stardust awaits us.

quests.title: Initial Loot Gathering at the Ruins
quests.summary: Collect smithing stones and find the secret scarab.
quests.directions: From the grace, head toward the nearby ruins (where clay warriors roam). On corpses hanging from ledges, find Smithing Stone [4] and [2]. Then climb the columns to reach the ceiling part of the ruins — there will be a hole. Drop down, kill the scarab, and claim the sorcery 'Oracle Bubbles' and a Silver Pickled Fowl Foot.
quests.goal: See those ancient ruins with clay warriors? Climb up, there are smithing stones lying there. And if you climb the columns and find a hole in the ceiling, we can drop right down to a magical scarab — it will give us the sorcery 'Oracle Bubbles'!

quests.title: Path to the Waterfall and Ascent to the Dam
quests.summary: Go to the waterfall, grab another stone, and ride the lift to the dam.
quests.directions: From the ruins, descend and move toward the waterfall (visible and audible). Take Smithing Stone [4] from the corpse by the waterfall. Then find the lift platform (to the left of the waterfall) and activate it to ascend to the dam.
quests.goal: Hear that roar? It's an underground waterfall! Let's run to it, grab another Smithing Stone [4] from the corpse, and then find the lift behind the water curtain. It will carry us up onto the great dam.

quests.title: Activating the 'Siofra River Bank' Grace and Region Map
quests.summary: Find the grace, activate it, and take the map.
quests.directions: After exiting onto the dam, head north along the river, keeping to the right bank. Find the 'Siofra River Bank' grace and activate it. Then approach the stairs leading to the Hallowhorn Grounds — at the base of the stairs, on a corpse, you will find the Map: Siofra River.
quests.goal: We have reached the big water! Activate the 'Siofra River Bank' grace so we can return here. And over there, by the stairs leading to the sacred lands, lies a corpse with a map. Without it, we'll get lost.

quests.title: Lighting All 8 Flame Pillars
quests.summary: Find and light all 8 flame pillars in the region.
quests.directions: Use the map to find all 8 pillars (obelisks with bowls). They are marked with green flag icons. Ride Torrent and light each pillar in turn. You can ignore enemies or kill them along the way. When all pillars are lit, you will see a notification.
quests.goal: Now we have the map, and our main task is to light all eight flame pillars! Mount Torrent and ride to each obelisk with a bowl. They are marked on the map as flags. When they all shine, we will be able to summon the Ancestor Spirit itself.

quests.title: Meeting the Merchant and Buying Keys
quests.summary: Climb to the dam, find the merchant, and buy valuable items.
quests.directions: From the bank, climb the stairs to the dam (to the right of the entrance). Walk along the scaffolding to the stone building — inside sits the merchant. Talk to him and buy 3 Stonesword Keys, Soap, Cookbooks, Shotel, and Arrows.
quests.goal: On the dam, among the scaffolding, a merchant hides. Go into his stone house and be sure to buy Stonesword Keys — three of them! Also Soap, Shotel, and Arrows. The keys will come in very handy.

quests.title: Collecting Additional Loot
quests.summary: Collect Marika's Scarseal, Horn Bow, Dragonwound Grease, and Great Oracular Bubble.
quests.directions: To the west, at the cliff, find Dragonwound Grease. To the north, under the waterfall, find Marika's Scarseal. Inside the building (where the blue beetle with the ball is), kill the beetle and obtain the sorcery 'Great Oracular Bubble'. Drop down under the bridge to find the Horn Bow on the lower level.
quests.goal: While we are here, let's gather the hidden treasures. To the west, by the cliff, lies Dragonwound Grease. To the north, under the waterfall, is Marika's Scarseal. And inside the building, a blue beetle with a ball will give us the sorcery 'Great Oracular Bubble'. Also the Horn Bow under the bridge!

quests.title: Meeting Blaidd
quests.summary: Find Blaidd at the spirit spring and talk to him.
quests.directions: From the bank, ride east to the spirit spring on the rise. You will see Blaidd standing at the edge. Approach and talk to him, exhaust all dialogue.
quests.goal: To the east of the bank, at the spirit spring, Blaidd awaits us. He stands there, gazing at the starry sky. Talk to him, he will tell us he is looking for the path to Nokron. This conversation must not be missed!

quests.title: Ancestor Spirit
quests.summary: Activate the deer carcass and defeat the Ancestor Spirit.
quests.directions: Return to the Hallowhorn Grounds. Enter the right building (the building on the right of the entrance), where the dead deer lies. Activate it — this will teleport you to the arena. Fight the Ancestor Spirit, using spirits to distract. After victory, claim the Ancestral Spirit's Ashes.
quests.goal: All pillars are burning, and the path is open! Return to the Hallowhorn Grounds and find the dead deer in the right building. Touch it, and we will be transported to the Ancestor Spirit's realm. Fight it as a noble beast, and take its Ashes.

chapters.name: Nokron, Eternal City
chapters.mainGoal: Explore Nokron, defeat the Mimic Tear, collect the Fingerslayer Blade, Mimic Tear Ashes, Black Whetblade, clear the Siofra Aqueduct and open the path to the Deeproot Depths.
chapters.summary: From entering through the crater to defeating the Valiant Gargoyles — we will go through all key points of Nokron, not missing a single item or quest.

locations.name: Meteorite Crater
locations.summary: The impact site of the meteorite after defeating Radahn, leading into Nokron.

locations.name: Nokron Rooftops
locations.summary: The first zone of the city, where you can find the Ghostflame Torch.

locations.name: Nokron, Eternal City (grace)
locations.summary: The first grace in the city, after passing through the window.

locations.name: Mimic Tear Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with the Mimic Tear boss.

locations.name: Night's Sacred Ground
locations.summary: The second zone of the city, containing the Black Whetblade and Mimic Tear Ashes.

locations.name: Giant Skeleton
locations.summary: The place where the Fingerslayer Blade is kept.

locations.name: Siofra Aqueduct
locations.summary: The path to the Deeproot Depths and the Valiant Gargoyles.

locations.name: Deeproot Depths
locations.summary: A location accessible via the coffin transport after the Gargoyles.

quests.title: Entering Nokron through the Crater
quests.summary: Find the meteorite crater and descend into Nokron.
quests.directions: Teleport to the 'Fort Haight West' grace in eastern Limgrave. From there head northwest — you will see a huge crater with floating rocks. Approach the crater from the north side, where there is a gentle slope down. Jump from platform to platform, descending along the rocks. Find a passage in the cliff and go through the tunnel. At the end of the tunnel, drop into the ruins — you will land on the rooftops of Nokron. Do not use the teleport from the Four Belfries — it leads only to an isolated fragment!
quests.goal: Tarnished, remember that star that fell after we defeated Radahn? It blasted a huge crater! Let's teleport to Fort Haight and head northwest. There we'll climb down the platforms like steps of a giant and jump straight onto the roofs of the ancient city. And don't even think about using the Four Belfries teleport — it's a dead end!

quests.title: Clearing the Nokron Rooftops
quests.summary: Explore the rooftops, collect the Ghostflame Torch and other items.
quests.directions: Drop onto the rooftop below. Sprint along the narrow roof and jump to a small square platform on the right. From the north‑west corner of the platform, run and jump onto a column, then across to the next roof. From the corpse, take the Ghostflame Torch. Then clear all roofs: kill Silver Tears, collect Rune Arc, Burred Bolts, Golden Rune, Nascent Butterflies, Smithing Stone [5], Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Ghost Glovewort (3).
quests.goal: On these ancient roofs, treasures are hidden like birds in nests! Let's search everything: take the Ghostflame Torch — it glows blue like stars! And collect rune arcs, stones, and butterflies. Just be careful: Silver Tears crawl around here, they pretend to be puddles and then — boo!

quests.title: Activating the 'Nokron, Eternal City' Grace
quests.summary: Pass through the window and activate the first grace.
quests.directions: Jump across to the neighbouring building, go forward to the open window. On the top floor, collect Smithing Stone [5] and Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Drop down one floor — collect Golden Rune (6) and Ghost Glovewort (3). In the next room, activate the 'Nokron, Eternal City' grace.
quests.goal: Let's jump to the next building and crawl through the broken window — like mice into an old pantry. We'll go down one floor and light our first grace in this city. Let its golden glow dispel this underground gloom!

quests.title: Mimic Tear
quests.summary: Defeat the Mimic Tear using the unequip tactic.
quests.directions: Exit the building, descend the stairs into an open area with a gazebo in the centre. In the gazebo lies the Ghost‑Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (1) — take it. Before entering the arena (the large arch), unequip all weapons and armour. Enter the arena, let the boss spawn naked, then quickly re‑equip your gear and defeat it.
quests.goal: Down there, a very strange foe awaits — it will become us! It's the Mimic Tear. But I have a cunning plan: before the arena, let's unequip all our weapons and armour, walk in naked, and when it appears just as helpless — we'll quickly put everything back on and show it who's the real boss!

quests.title: Black Whetblade and Mimic Tear Ashes
quests.summary: Collect the Black Whetblade and the Mimic Tear Ashes.
quests.directions: After defeating the Mimic Tear, continue along the main path. Stay to the left side of the cliff to find the 'Ancestral Woods' grace and a spot to drop onto the rooftops of the Night's Sacred Ground. Descend lower, you will meet two Silver Tears and Nox Swordstresses. Near the altar, on a corpse, lies the Black Whetblade. Not far from it, find a statue with an imp requiring a Stonesword Key. Insert the key and open the chest with the Mimic Tear Ashes.
quests.goal: Now we are on sacred ground! By the altar lies the Black Whetblade — it will allow our blades to ooze darkness. And over there, a statue with a little imp. Open it with a Stonesword Key, and behind it we will find the Mimic Tear Ashes — now our copy will fight for us!

quests.title: Additional Loot in Night's Sacred Ground
quests.summary: Collect Celestial Dew, Nox Flowing Hammer, and the Night Maiden Set.
quests.directions: From the 'Night's Sacred Ground' grace, climb the stairs on the right — in the room with two Night Maidens and a large spherical Silver Tear. Kill the enemies and take the Nox Flowing Hammer. On a corpse by the road in the Night's Sacred Ground lies Celestial Dew. The Night Maiden Set drops from Night Maidens in this zone.
quests.goal: Let's look around and grab everything that's not nailed down. By the road, a corpse holds Celestial Dew — it washes away sins. And if we go up the stairs and deal with those Night Maidens, we'll take their hammer and a wonderful armour set. Careful, there's a silver death‑ball rolling around too!

quests.title: Fingerslayer Blade
quests.summary: Take the Fingerslayer Blade from beneath the giant skeleton.
quests.directions: From the 'Night's Sacred Ground' grace, cross the plaza with many Silver Tears. On the opposite side of the plaza you will see a giant skeleton on a throne. At its base, under the skeleton, is a chest. Open it and take the Fingerslayer Blade and the Great Ghost Glovewort.
quests.goal: Tarnished, look — a giant skeleton! Beneath it, a chest with the Fingerslayer Blade, the very one Ranni asked for. It's a weapon that can wound gods! But remember: once we take it, Seluvis's quest may break, so if we have any business with him — finish it now.

quests.title: Siofra Aqueduct and Valiant Gargoyles
quests.summary: Clear the aqueduct, fight Crucible Knights, and defeat the Gargoyles.
quests.directions: From the 'Ancestral Woods' zone, head east, bypassing the Hallowhorn Grounds. Find a ledge leading to the Siofra Aqueduct. Activate the 'Aqueduct‑Facing Cliff' grace. Traverse the aqueduct, fighting Crucible Knights and squads of Fallen Hawk Soldiers. At the end of the aqueduct, by a large waterfall, a dual boss awaits — the Valiant Gargoyles. Defeat them, then unlock access to the coffin transport in the cave at the northern end of the aqueduct.
quests.goal: Here, to the east, is an ancient aqueduct that once carried water to Nokron. Now it nests Crucible Knights. Let's fight through them and face two huge Gargoyles at the end of the tunnel. It will be a fierce battle, but beyond them lies the path to the very heart of the Erdtree!

quests.title: Deeproot Depths
quests.summary: Use the coffin transport to reach the Deeproot Depths.
quests.directions: After defeating the Gargoyles, unlock access to the coffin transport in the cave at the northern end of the aqueduct. Rest in the coffin — it will carry you to the Deeproot Depths.
quests.goal: At the end of the aqueduct, a stone coffin awaits us. It looks eerie, but it's a portal! Rest in it, and it will take us straight to the Deeproot Depths of the Erdtree — where Fia plans to complete her ritual. This place is full of sorrow, but also great power.

chapters.name: Ainsel River / Nokstella
chapters.mainGoal: Complete the underground branch of Ranni's quest: obtain the Miniature Ranni Doll, defeat the Baleful Shadow, acquire the Discarded Palace Key and the Dark Moon Ring.
chapters.summary: From the teleport from Renna's Rise to obtaining the Dark Moon Ring in the Academy — we will go through all key points of Ainsel and Nokstella, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Renna's Rise (top)
locations.summary: The top of Renna's Rise with a teleport to Ainsel.

locations.name: Ainsel River Main
locations.summary: The first grace in Ainsel, near the Ranni doll.

locations.name: Uhl Palace Ruins
locations.summary: Extensive ruins along the river with many Silver Tears.

locations.name: Nokstella, Waterfall Basin
locations.summary: Grace before the lower level of Nokstella.

locations.name: Lower Level of Nokstella
locations.summary: A labyrinth of streets and buildings with Silver Tears and Night Maidens.

locations.name: Baleful Shadow Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with the Baleful Shadow.

locations.name: Dragonkin Soldier Arena (Nokstella)
locations.summary: Optional boss in the tunnel.

locations.name: Rennala's Room (Academy)
locations.summary: The location of the chest with the Dark Moon Ring.

quests.title: Entering Ainsel through Renna's Rise
quests.summary: Climb Renna's Rise and activate the teleport to Ainsel.
quests.directions: Teleport to the Three Sisters in Liurnia. Approach Renna's Rise — it is now unlocked. Climb to the very top of the tower and activate the Waygate at the summit.
quests.goal: We gave Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade, and she gave us the inverted statue. Now our path leads to the top of Renna's Rise, among the Three Sisters. Let's climb and activate the ancient teleport. It will take us straight to the underground river, where a new secret awaits.

quests.title: Ranni's Doll and Three Conversations
quests.summary: Take the Miniature Ranni Doll and talk to it three times at the grace.
quests.directions: Immediately after teleporting, look around. On a corpse nearby lies the Miniature Ranni Doll. Take it. Next to the spawn point, find and activate the 'Ainsel River Main' grace. Sit at the grace and choose the option 'Talk to the doll' three times in a row.
quests.goal: Right next to the grace lies a small doll — cold, but radiating familiar magic. It is Ranni herself! Take it and sit by the fire. Talk to the doll three times — at first it will be silent, but then it will speak and tell us what enemy awaits ahead. Without these conversations, we cannot proceed.

quests.title: Exploring Ainsel River Main
quests.summary: Collect loot in the first zone: Magic Grease, Nox Swordstress, Ghost Glovewort, Drawstring Holy Grease, Smithing Stone, Silver Tear Husks, Celestial Dew.
quests.directions: From the Ainsel River Main grace, search the surrounding ruins. On the left in the ruins, find 3x Magic Grease. On the right — a Nox Swordstress riding a giant ant, nearby Ghost Glovewort (7). In the central ruins, kill two Nox Monks — they drop 2x Drawstring Holy Grease and Smithing Stone (6). Circle the large building on the right, on a corpse on the cliff — 3x Silver Tear Husks. In the building to the northwest — snails guard Celestial Dew.
quests.goal: Before moving on, let's search these ruins. We can find magic greases, rare stones, and even Celestial Dew. Around the corner on the left lurks a Night Maiden rider on an ant — be careful, she's fast. And in the central ruins, monks guard greases and a stone.

quests.title: Uhl Palace Ruins
quests.summary: Travel through the ruins, collect Golden Rune, Ghost Glovewort, Somber Smithing Stone, Stonesword Key, and Golden Seed.
quests.directions: From the grace, head west along the river through the Uhl Palace Ruins. On the right — snails, nearby Smithing Stone (6). In the water — many Silver Tears that explode with lightning when killed. Use this against them. After clearing: on the left side of the river — Golden Rune (10), 2x Ghost Glovewort (8), and Ghost Glovewort (7). Under the roof on the left — Silver Tears guard a corpse with Somber Smithing Stone (7). Opposite, to the north — kill three giant ants, behind them on a cliff a corpse with a Stonesword Key. At the top of the next section — Golden Seed.
quests.goal: Let's go west along the bank of the underground river. There are many Silver Tears here — if you hit them, they explode with lightning, so use that against them. We will find a Golden Seed (it will strengthen our flasks!), a Stonesword Key, and rare smithing stones. All of this is vital for our journey.

quests.title: Path to Nokstella
quests.summary: Pass by (or defeat) the Malformed Star and take the lift down to Nokstella.
quests.directions: From the Uhl ruins, move toward the area before Nokstella. There you will meet a Malformed Star — a giant caterpillar‑like creature. You can run past using walls as cover from its magic attacks. If you choose to kill it, aim for the head and stay beneath it to avoid magic. Reward for killing: Somber Smithing Stone (7). Then find the building to the southwest — inside is a lift that will take you down to the next grace, 'Nokstella, Waterfall Basin'.
quests.goal: Further on, the path is blocked by a huge Malformed Star. It hangs in the air and spits magic. You can run past, hiding behind columns, or take the fight. Beyond it is a lift that will take us straight to the Waterfall Basin of Nokstella, where we will light a grace.

quests.title: Exploring the Lower Level of Nokstella
quests.summary: Collect loot: Magic Grease, Fan Daggers, Ant's Skull Plate, Ghost‑Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (2), Archer Ashes, Golden Rune (10).
quests.directions: From the 'Nokstella, Waterfall Basin' grace, move forward. On the left by a ruined wall — a corpse with 3x Magic Grease. Climb the stairs up. On the landing — a Night Maiden and Fan Daggers on the railing. In the building on the first landing — a Nox Swordstress guards a chest with Ant's Skull Plate. Continue climbing — a group of Silver Tears. In the building on the next landing — Silver Tears with shields. Inside the chest — Ghost‑Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (2). Behind the building — Archer Ashes. On the bridge you'll meet a Silver Sphere — stand by the statue on the south side of the bridge so the ball crashes into it. After it is destroyed, take Golden Rune (10) from the corpse.
quests.goal: The lower level is a labyrinth of dark streets. We will find here a bell bearing that allows us to buy gloveworts for spirits, the ashes of a skilled archer, and many other useful things. Check every chest, but beware of silver balls — they hit hard.

quests.title: Hidden Rooms of Nokstella
quests.summary: Find the Night Maiden & Swordstress Puppets, and the trap room with Great Ghost Glovewort.
quests.directions: Return south, to the right side of the building. Find a statue with an imp (Imbued Stone Key). Use a Stonesword Key to remove the fog wall. Inside — two Nox Monks. Kill them. In the chest in the centre of the room — Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets. Then return to the bridge, cross to the other side, and enter the building to the east. There is a trap: doors will close, and a Silver Sphere will drop from the ceiling. Use the corners of the room to avoid being crushed. In the chest — Great Ghost Glovewort.
quests.goal: There are two secret rooms here. One is behind the imp statue, opened with a Stonesword Key; inside lie the puppets of the Night Maiden and Swordstress, a wonderful summoning duo. The second is beyond the bridge, in the eastern building, but it's a trap: a silver ball rolls around. Press yourself against the wall in the corner and open the chest with the Great Ghost Glovewort.

quests.title: Baleful Shadow
quests.summary: Defeat the Baleful Shadow and obtain the Discarded Palace Key.
quests.directions: Exit outside, climb the stairs to the northwest. In the dead end by the building, you will find the arena where the Baleful Shadow appears. Before the fight, apply all buffs. Use weapons with bleed or frost. Keep distance, provoke his jump attack, roll forward under him. After his attacks, get behind him. After victory, take the Discarded Palace Key.
quests.goal: Let's go outside and climb to the misty arena. There, the Baleful Shadow awaits — a blood‑red phantom, an exact copy of Blaidd, but one who betrayed Ranni. He fights fiercely, but we know his weakness: bleed and frost. Defeat him and take the Discarded Palace Key, which will unlock the chest with the Ring.

quests.title: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella
quests.summary: Defeat the optional Dragonkin Soldier boss and take the Great Ghost Glovewort.
quests.directions: From the Ainsel River Main grace, descend down and left into the tunnel. Beware of giant ants on the ceiling. Follow the river, then turn right. At the end of the tunnel — the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella. Defeat him, open the chest under the throne, and take the Great Ghost Glovewort.
quests.goal: If we return to the first Ainsel bonfire and go down into the tunnel, we can find a sleeping Dragonkin Soldier. He is a huge knight with stone scales. Let's fight him to get another Great Ghost Glovewort for our spirits. He is optional, but for 100% completion — it's perfect.

quests.title: Dark Moon Ring
quests.summary: Return to the Academy, open the locked chest, and claim the Dark Moon Ring.
quests.directions: Teleport to Raya Lucaria Academy. Go to Rennala's room (after the boss). Use the Discarded Palace Key on the locked chest in this room and take the Dark Moon Ring.
quests.goal: We have the Discarded Palace Key. Let's return to Raya Lucaria Academy, to the room where we fought Rennala. There is a locked chest there. We'll insert the key and take out the Dark Moon Ring — the very one needed for the betrothal to Ranni and the finale of her story.

acts.name: Caelid
acts.summary: Caelid — the land of scarlet rot and ancient battles. Here, amid crimson skies and rotting swamps, great secrets and dangers are hidden. We must explore the southern part to prepare for the meeting with Radahn.
acts.lore: Caelid is a cursed land, afflicted by Scarlet Rot after the war between Radahn and Malenia. Here monsters dwell, and the air is thick with death. But it is here that we will find the keys to great power and complete important quests.

chapters.name: South Caelid
chapters.mainGoal: Explore the southern part of Caelid, clear all dungeons, start Millicent's quest, advance Sellen's quest, collect the map and key items.
chapters.summary: From entering Caelid to clearing all five dungeons and starting Millicent's and Sellen's quests — we will go through all key points of the southern region.

locations.name: Smoldering Wall

locations.summary: Catacombs with a boss fight against two Grave Wardens.

locations.name: Church of the Plague
locations.summary: The location where Millicent lies.

locations.name: Sellia Town
locations.summary: A magical town hidden behind a barrier.

locations.name: Witchbane Ruins
locations.summary: The location of Sellen's original body.

quests.title: Entering Caelid and Anastasia's Invasion
quests.summary: Cross into Caelid, defeat Anastasia, and activate the grace.
quests.directions: Head east from the 'Saintsbridge' grace in Limgrave. Pass by the Summonwater Village and follow the road east until the sky turns crimson. As you approach the Smoldering Church, Anastasia's invasion will begin. She will appear right at the entrance. Fight her, then enter the church, collect the recipe books, and activate the grace.
quests.goal: Let's step into this crimson inferno! Before us is the Smoldering Church, but right at the entrance we will be met by Anastasia — the Tarnished‑Eater. She looks like a mad cook, and her knives are sharp. Let's fight her right now, before she strikes first!

quests.title: Caelid Map and Scarab
quests.summary: Find the region map and a sorcery from a scarab.
quests.directions: From the Smoldering Church head south along the main road. At the fork by the stele, you will find the Caelid map. Then continue south along the road, and near the cart next to two giant dogs, you will spot a scarab. Kill it to obtain the incantation 'Whirl, O Flame!'.
quests.goal: We need the map! There, at the fork, stands a stele — it holds exactly that. And nearby rolls a scarab, its belly filled with the incantation 'Whirl, O Flame!'. Just be careful — two giant dogs roam around, and they are very aggressive.

quests.title: Decaying Ekzykes
quests.summary: Defeat the dragon Ekzykes and claim its heart.
quests.directions: From the Caelid map, head west to the cliff, then back southeast. There, on the open plain, lies Decaying Ekzykes. Use Torrent to dodge the rot clouds, and attack his legs. After victory, take the Dragon Heart.
quests.goal: To the west, among the crimson dunes, lies Decaying Ekzykes. His body oozes rot, and his breath turns the air to poison. Mount Torrent, circle around him, hit his legs, and dodge the clouds of blight. We will take his heart to exchange for draconic power!

quests.title: Night's Cavalry (Caelid)
quests.summary: Defeat the Night's Cavalry on the road.
quests.directions: After defeating Ekzykes, return to the 'South Caelid Highway' grace, rest and change the time to night. Then follow the main road southeast — the rider will appear on the road. Attack his horse to knock him from the saddle.
quests.goal: Let's wait for darkness! On the southeastern road, a rider in black will appear — the Night's Cavalry. He swings a flail, but if we attack his horse, it will stumble, and we can land the decisive blow. Let's fight him!

quests.title: Caelem Ruins and Twin Pumpkin Heads
quests.summary: Clear the ruins, defeat two Pumpkin Heads, and claim the Visage Shield.
quests.directions: Head east from the map location to the 'Caelem Ruins'. In the southeastern part of the ruins, find the stairs down to the underground chamber. Descend, summon spirits for distraction, and fight the two Pumpkin Heads. After victory, open the chest behind them and take the Visage Shield.
quests.goal: Under the Caelem ruins is an underground chamber. Inside, two Pumpkin Heads await us at once — one with a hammer, the other with a flail. Fighting both at once will be tough. Let's summon our faithful spirit to distract one while we deal with the other. Their heads are the weak spot!

quests.title: Scarab and Merchant at the Smoldering Wall
quests.summary: Find the scarab with an Ash of War and visit the merchant.
quests.directions: From the Caelem Ruins head slightly south to the 'Smoldering Wall'. Near the grace you will find a scarab — kill it to obtain the Ash of War 'Life Steal Fist'. Then talk to the merchant sitting by the fire and buy useful consumables from him.
quests.goal: Another scarab rolls by the Smoldering Wall. Kill it, and it will drop the Ash of War 'Life Steal Fist' — with it, our strikes will drain life from enemies. Nearby by the fire sits a merchant, who can replenish our arrows and bolts.

quests.title: Minor Erdtree Catacombs (Caelid)
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs and defeat the two Grave Wardens.
quests.directions: Southeast of the 'South Caelid Highway' grace, at the foot of the Minor Erdtree, find the catacomb entrance. Go through the dungeon to the boss — two Grave Wardens. Use summons for distraction, hit one at a time, defeat them, and take the ashes.
quests.goal: Beneath the roots of the Minor Erdtree hide catacombs. Inside, two stone Grave Wardens await us — they are like animated dog statues. Let's summon someone tanky to distract them, and hit them one by one. After victory, we will get their ashes, and they will become our guardians!

quests.title: Gael Tunnel and Magma Wyrm
quests.summary: Defeat the Magma Wyrm and claim the Moonveil.
quests.directions: West of the Caelem Ruins, at the eastern border of Limgrave, find the entrance to the 'Gael Tunnel' mine. Go through the tunnel to the boss — the Magma Wyrm. Stay to the side, hit its head, dodge the lava. After victory, take the Moonveil.
quests.goal: In Gael Tunnel, at the eastern border, crawls a huge Magma Wyrm. It bathes in lava, and its body is red‑hot. We need the legendary Moonveil katana it guards. Stay to its side, don't get under its lava spit, and hit hard. This weapon will change our path!

quests.title: Gaol Cave and the Mad Duelist
quests.summary: Defeat the Mad Duelist and obtain the Frenzied Flame Seal.
quests.directions: Northwest of the 'Impassable Greatbridge', by the cliffs, find the entrance to 'Gaol Cave'. Go through to the boss — the Mad Duelist. Defeat him and take the Frenzied Flame Seal.
quests.goal: In Gaol Cave sits the Mad Duelist — a warrior consumed by frenzied flame. He is fast and dangerous. Let's defeat him to claim the Frenzied Flame Seal. With it, we can cast fire incantations that drive enemies mad.

quests.title: Sellia Crystal Tunnel and Miner's Bell Bearing
quests.summary: Defeat the Fallingstar Beast and obtain the Miner's Bell Bearing.
quests.directions: North of the town of Sellia, by the cliffs, find the entrance to the 'Sellia Crystal Tunnel' mine. Go through to the boss — the Fallingstar Beast. Defeat it, take the Miner's Bell Bearing and stones.
quests.goal: In the Sellia Crystal Tunnel lurks a Fallingstar Beast — a many‑legged thing with claws. It guards the Miner's Bell Bearing, which will let us buy somber smithing stones from merchants. This will give us the power to upgrade any legendary weapon!

quests.title: Caelid Catacombs and Illusory Wall
quests.summary: Defeat the Cemetery Shade and find the illusory wall with ashes.
quests.directions: Far south, west of the 'Impassable Greatbridge', near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion, find the catacomb entrance. Go through to the boss — the Cemetery Shade. After victory, find the illusory wall on the right under the stairs, behind it take 2x Grave Glovewort (5) and the Miranda Sprout Ashes.
quests.goal: In the southern catacombs hides a Cemetery Shade — a fast monster that inflicts bleed. Let's defeat it and be sure to check the wall on the right under the stairs: it's illusory! Behind it lie valuable ashes and flowers. A secret for the observant!

quests.title: Cathedral of Dragon Communion
quests.summary: Activate the grace and exchange the dragon heart.
quests.directions: Far south, west of the 'Impassable Greatbridge', by the shore, stands the Cathedral of Dragon Communion. Enter, activate the grace, then approach the altar and exchange the Dragon Heart for the incantation 'Ekzykes's Decay'.
quests.goal: On the far south stands a grand church dedicated to dragons. Inside is an altar where we can exchange Ekzykes' heart for the incantation 'Ekzykes's Decay' — it will allow us to inflict rot on enemies like the dragon did. Let's do it!

quests.title: Millicent's Quest — Start
quests.summary: Talk to Gowry and take the task to find the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
quests.directions: Southern Caelid, east of Sellia, between the Sellia Gate and the town itself, find Gowry's Shack. Enter, talk to him, choose 'Listen to request' and agree to help Millicent.
quests.goal: Let's visit Gowry's shack, east of Sellia. The old sage sits by the fire, worried about his daughter Millicent. She is sick, and she needs the Unalloyed Gold Needle. We agreed to help — this will be our good deed in this harsh land.

quests.title: Commander O'Neil and the Unalloyed Gold Needle
quests.summary: Defeat Commander O'Neil and take the needle.
quests.directions: Head to the centre of the Swamp of Aeonia, to the large tree where Commander O'Neil stands. First kill the soldiers he summons, then attack him using bleed. After victory, take the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
quests.goal: In the very heart of the rotting swamp stands Commander O'Neil. He is badly wounded but still summons ghostly soldiers. First kill them so they don't interfere, then attack the commander himself. He is weak to bleed. We will get the needle — the key to saving Millicent!

quests.title: Meeting Millicent at the Church of the Plague
quests.summary: Give the needle to Millicent and start her quest.
quests.directions: Return to Gowry, rest at the grace, talk to him again to receive the restored needle. Then head to the Church of the Plague (northwest of Sellia). Inside, find Millicent by the western wall and give her the needle.
quests.goal: Let's return to Gowry, he will repair the needle. Then we'll rest at the fire and talk to him again — the needle will be ready. Now to the Church of the Plague, where Millicent lies. She is barely alive, but as soon as we give her the needle, her pain will ease. This will start her long journey.

quests.title: Sellia Town — Lighting the Torches
quests.summary: Light three torches on Sellia's towers to remove the barrier.
quests.directions: Enter Sellia Town from the south. Find three towers: one to the southeast (climb the external ladder), one in the centre (accessible via rooftops), and one to the northwest (by the large statue). On each, light the torch. After this, the barrier will disappear, and you can take the Ash of War 'Sword Dance' from the chest at the entrance.
quests.goal: Sellia is a town of mages, but the entrance is blocked by a magical barrier. We need to find three towers: one to the southeast, one in the centre, and one to the northwest. Each has a torch — let's light them! Once all three burn, the barrier will fall, and we can take the Ash of War 'Sword Dance' at the entrance.

quests.title: Sellen's Quest — Original Body
quests.summary: Find Sellen's body in Witchbane Ruins and advance her quest.
quests.directions: Southeast of the 'Impassable Greatbridge', by the cliffs, find the Witchbane Ruins. Enter the cellar where Sellen's body is chained. Talk to her, do not attack.
quests.goal: We need to visit Sellen — but not the one we know, her real body. It is imprisoned in Witchbane Ruins, in an underground chamber, chained. Let's descend and speak with her — this will help her be freed in the future.

chapters.name: Radahn Festival
chapters.mainGoal: Start the Radahn Festival, defeat the Starscourge, claim his Great Rune and Remembrance, unlock access to Nokron, and advance related quests.
chapters.summary: From checking the pre‑festival bosses to activating the Great Rune — we will go through all key moments without missing a single detail.

locations.name: Redmane Castle (before festival)
locations.summary: The castle before the festival activates, where you can fight a dual boss.

locations.name: Impassable Greatbridge
locations.summary: The entrance to Redmane Castle and the teleport to the festival.

locations.name: Starscourge Radahn Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with Radahn.

locations.name: Roundtable Hold (after Radahn)
locations.summary: Hub for activating the rune and obtaining Fia's dagger.

locations.name: Divine Tower of Caelid
locations.summary: The tower for activating Radahn's Great Rune.

quests.title: Pre‑Festival Dual Boss
quests.summary: Defeat the Misbegotten Warrior and the Crucible Knight before the festival activates.
quests.directions: While the festival has not yet started, head to Redmane Castle. Go through the inner courtyard and find the arena where the Misbegotten Warrior and the Crucible Knight fight. They await in the central hall of the castle. Kill them to obtain the Red‑Hot Whetblade.
quests.goal: Inside the castle, before the festival begins, two guardians await — the Misbegotten Warrior and the Crucible Knight. If we don't defeat them now, they will vanish forever, and with them the Red‑Hot Whetblade. Let's fight them, Tarnished!

quests.title: Starting the Festival via Ranni's Questline
quests.summary: Complete all steps of Ranni's quest to activate the festival.
quests.directions: To start the festival, you must follow Ranni's quest chain. Make sure you have completed Caria Manor, spoken to Ranni, met Blaidd in Siofra, and discussed everything with Sellen. After that, the festival will begin automatically.
quests.goal: The festival will not start without our involvement. We have already done everything needed: passed Caria Manor, sworn to serve Ranni, met Blaidd in Siofra, and spoken to wise Sellen. Now all threads have come together — it's time to check how the castle courtyard buzzes with warriors!

quests.title: Path to the Castle via Teleport
quests.summary: Activate the grace and use the teleport to the inner courtyard.
quests.directions: Now that the festival has begun, return to the Impassable Greatbridge and use the teleport at the grace to reach the castle's inner courtyard.
quests.goal: We are at the Impassable Greatbridge. Here, by the grace, a teleport shimmers — it will carry us straight to the inner courtyard where the participants gather. Let's activate it and join the festival!

quests.title: Starscourge Radahn
quests.summary: Defeat Radahn using summons and tactics.
quests.directions: Enter the arena via the teleport. After talking to Jerren, step onto the wasteland. Immediately summon allies via golden signs. Dodge Radahn's arrows, use Torrent for mobility. In the second phase he will fly up — run as far away as possible. Use rot breath if you have it.
quests.goal: Jerren has announced our name! We step onto the wasteland, where Radahn rains arrows upon us. Summon everyone you see — Blaidd, Alexander, Okina, and others. Dodge the arrows, and when we close in, strike his battered legs. In the second phase he will ascend to the stars — dodge! And remember, he fears rot; it consumes him from within.

quests.title: Talking to Blaidd after the Battle
quests.summary: Find Blaidd on the arena and exhaust his dialogue.
quests.directions: After defeating Radahn, when you return to the real world, search the arena. Blaidd will be standing nearby — talk to him.
quests.goal: After the battle, when the dust settles, Blaidd will remain on the arena. Approach him — he will say that the stars are now free and the path to Nokron lies before us. This conversation is crucial for Ranni, do not miss it.

quests.title: Fia's Weathered Dagger
quests.summary: Return to the Roundtable and obtain the Weathered Dagger from Fia.
quests.directions: Return to the Roundtable Hold. Find Fia in her room (in the side corridor). Take the Weathered Dagger from her.
quests.goal: Let's go back to the Roundtable, to our quiet Fia. She will give us the Weathered Dagger and ask us to deliver it to D, the Hunter of the Dead. There is a strange, dim magic in this dagger. We will take it to help her.

quests.title: Activating Radahn's Great Rune (via Enia)
quests.summary: Speak to Enia in the Roundtable to activate the Rune.
quests.directions: Speak to Enia, who sits by the fireplace in the main hall of the Roundtable. She will tell you how to activate the rune.
quests.goal: We hold Radahn's Great Rune, but it sleeps. Let's go to Enia, the Finger Reader, by the fire. She will tell us how to awaken the rune's power at the Divine Tower of Caelid. This will grant us immense power!

quests.title: Divine Tower of Caelid — Full Activation
quests.summary: Reach the tower and activate Radahn's Great Rune.
quests.directions: Travel to Dragonbarrow. Climb the Divine Tower, fighting through strong enemies. At the summit, activate the rune at the altar.
quests.goal: Let's head to Dragonbarrow, where the Divine Tower of Caelid hides among the cliffs. There are many strong foes there, but we are not the same as before. We will climb to the top and place the rune on the altar. Its power will remain with us forever.

quests.title: Redmane Castle — Re‑exploration
quests.summary: Return to the castle after the festival to collect loot and open doors.
quests.directions: Return to Redmane Castle after the festival. Now all doors are open. Search the castle to find the Flamberge, armour, and runes.
quests.goal: The festival is over, and the castle is empty. Now we can calmly walk through its halls and take everything that was locked: the legendary Flamberge, knight armour, and rune arcs. Let's enjoy the quiet after the storm and harvest the spoils.

chapters.name: After Radahn — Tying Up Loose Ends
chapters.mainGoal: Complete the quests of Ranni, Fia and Sellen, clear the Carian Study Hall and Deeproot Depths, collect all key items and prepare for Altus.
chapters.summary: From delivering the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni to defeating the Lichdragon Fortissax — we will complete all storylines and open the way to new lands.

locations.name: Ranni's Rise (after Radahn)
locations.summary: Ranni's tower, where we return with the Fingerslayer Blade.

locations.name: Carian Study Hall
locations.summary: A study hall that flips upside down with the statue.

locations.name: Divine Tower of Liurnia (top)
locations.summary: The top of the tower, where the Cursemark of Death lies.

locations.name: Roundtable Hold (Fia)
locations.summary: The place where Fia receives the Mark and departs.

locations.name: Witchbane Ruins (after Radahn)
locations.summary: The location of Sellen's real body.

locations.name: Deeproot Depths
locations.summary: A location beneath the Erdtree's roots, where Fia awaits.

quests.title: Fingerslayer Blade — Return to Ranni
quests.summary: Return to Ranni, deliver the Fingerslayer Blade, and receive the Carian Inverted Statue.
quests.directions: Teleport to the Three Sisters in Liurnia. Approach Ranni's Rise — it is on the left when facing the plaza from the entrance. Climb to the very top of the tower. Speak to Ranni, choose the option to give her the Fingerslayer Blade. Exhaust all her dialogue — she will give you the Carian Inverted Statue.
quests.goal: Tarnished, let's return to our lunar witch. She awaits us in her tower, surrounded by shimmering stars. Give her the Blade we obtained in Nokron — this blade can wound the very gods! Ranni will smile at us and give us the Carian Inverted Statue, which opens the path to the secrets of death.

quests.title: Carian Study Hall — Cursemark of Death
quests.summary: Use the statue to flip the hall, reach the top, and take the Cursemark of Death.
quests.directions: Find the Carian Study Hall in eastern Liurnia, on the hilltop east of the Crystal Bay. Enter the building. In the first room, find the pedestal and place the Carian Inverted Statue on it. The hall will flip — you will walk on the ceiling. Follow the new route, avoiding Miriel the Prophet (you can run past), until you reach the Divine Tower of Liurnia. At the top, find the corpse and take the Cursemark of Death.
quests.goal: We are in the Carian Study Hall — everything here breathes ancient magic. Place the Carian Inverted Statue on the pedestal in the first room, and the world will flip! Stairs will fall away, and enemies will tumble from the ceiling. Walk through this distorted hall all the way to the Divine Tower of Liurnia and take the Cursemark of Death from the corpse — it is cold as the grave itself.

quests.title: Cursemark of Death — Give to Fia
quests.summary: Return to the Roundtable, give the Cursemark of Death to Fia, and advance her quest.
quests.directions: Teleport to the Roundtable Hold. Find Fia in her room (in the side corridor, behind the main hall). Speak to her and give her the Cursemark of Death. Exhaust all dialogue — she will say she is leaving for the Deeproot Depths.
quests.goal: Let's return to the Roundtable, to our quiet Fia. She sits in her room like a sad shadow. Give her the Cursemark of Death — she will press it to her chest and whisper words of gratitude. After that, she will leave for where the Erdtree's roots go deep into the heart of the earth.

quests.title: Sellen's Primal Glintstone
quests.summary: Visit Witchbane Ruins and take the Glintstone from Sellen's real body.
quests.directions: Witchbane Ruins are in southern Caelid, southeast of the Impassable Greatbridge, by the cliffs. Find the cellar among the rubble. Inside, in a locked cell, Sellen's body is chained. Talk to her (do not attack!) and take the Primal Glintstone. After that, reload the area (rest at a grace) — Jerren will appear in the cell. Talk to him.
quests.goal: Let's visit Sellen in her prison. In Witchbane Ruins, deep underground, her real body is chained. Talk to her — she will ask us to take the Primal Glintstone, which holds her soul. Take it, and we will be able to give her a new life.

quests.title: Deeproot Depths — Fia's Quest and the Lichdragon
quests.summary: Clear the Deeproot Depths, fight Fia's Champions and the Lichdragon Fortissax, obtain the Cursemark of Death.
quests.directions: From the Siofra Aqueduct, after defeating the Valiant Gargoyles, use the coffin transport in the cave at the northern end of the aqueduct. It will carry you to the Deeproot Depths. Move to the 'Prince of Death's Throne'. Find Fia, talk to her, then choose 'Enter the Deathbed Dream'. Fight Fia's Champions (PvP‑style battle). After victory, inside the dream, the Lichdragon Fortissax will appear — defeat him. Then talk to Fia and claim the Cursemark of Death.
quests.goal: Our path lies to the very roots of the Erdtree, which we will reach through the Siofra Aqueduct. There, at the Prince of Death's Throne, Fia awaits us. She is surrounded by her faithful champions — fight them to prove our strength. Then, diving into her dream, we will face the Lichdragon Fortissax himself. Defeat him, and Fia will give us the Cursemark of Death — the final gift to complete her fate.

acts.name: Altus and Gelmir
acts.summary: The Altus Plateau — the heart of the Lands Between, where the paths of all great warriors converge. Here we will meet sages, fight monsters, and prepare for the ascent of Mt. Gelmir.
acts.lore: Altus is the land where the Erdtree is seen in all its glory. Here dwell the followers of the Golden Order, and here we will find the keys to the greatest secrets. But before entering the capital, we must grow stronger.

chapters.name: Altus Plateau
chapters.mainGoal: Enter the Altus Plateau, collect the region map, start Corhyn's and Goldmask's quests, collect all Golden Seeds and Sacred Tears, and clear all optional dungeons.
chapters.summary: From ascending the lift to activating the grace at the gates of Leyndell — we will go through all key points of the plateau, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Altus Plateau (grace)
locations.summary: The first grace after ascending the lift.

locations.name: Altus Highway Junction
locations.summary: Grace at the crossroads, near the map and Corhyn.

locations.name: Bridge over the Forest
locations.summary: The spot where Goldmask stands.

locations.name: Sainted Hero's Grave
locations.summary: A complex dungeon with the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss.

locations.name: Altus Tunnel
locations.summary: A mine with Crystalians.

locations.name: Old Altus Tunnel
locations.summary: An old mine with a Stone Digger Troll.

locations.name: Sage's Cave
locations.summary: A cave with two bosses: a Necromancer and a Black Knife Assassin.

locations.name: Unsightly Catacombs
locations.summary: Catacombs requiring 2 Stonesword Keys, with dual bosses.

locations.name: Fallingstar Beast Crater
locations.summary: The site of the battle with the Fallingstar Beast.

locations.name: Night's Cavalry (Altus)
locations.summary: The spawn point of the Night's Cavalry at night.

locations.name: Outer Wall Phantom Tree
locations.summary: Grace at the Leyndell gates, with two Golden Seeds nearby.

locations.name: Alexander at the Lava Lake
locations.summary: The spot where Alexander stands by the lava lake.

quests.title: Entering the Altus Plateau
quests.summary: Ascend the lift and activate the first grace.
quests.directions: Use the Grand Lift of Dectus (in the Forbidden Lands) with both medallion halves. After ascending, you will arrive on the plateau. Activate the 'Altus Plateau' grace right before you.
quests.goal: Let's ascend the Grand Lift of Dectus! Remember how we collected the medallion halves? Now they pay off. As soon as we step onto the plateau, we'll light the grace — let that golden flame be our first mark on this land.

quests.title: Altus Map and Meeting Corhyn
quests.summary: Find the region map and talk to Corhyn.
quests.directions: From the first grace, head east along the main road. Before the ramp, activate the 'Altus Highway Junction' grace. The map is at the stele slightly north, next to Corhyn. Talk to Corhyn and buy incantations from him.
quests.goal: We'll follow the main road until we see the map stele and a crossroads. That's the Altus Highway Junction. We'll take the map to see all the paths, then approach our old acquaintance — Corhyn! He left the Roundtable in search of Goldmask. We'll buy incantations from him while he's here.

quests.title: Altus Golden Seeds and Sacred Tears
quests.summary: Collect all Golden Seeds and Sacred Tears on the plateau.
quests.directions: Golden Seed #1: at the Minor Erdtree north of the Junction. Golden Seed #2: at the Outer Wall Phantom Tree (beyond the capital gates). Golden Seed #3: behind the Gargoyle on the path to Leyndell. Sacred Tear #1: Second Church of Marika on the western edge of the plateau. Sacred Tear #2: Church of the Stormcaller.
quests.goal: Altus is scattered with sacred gifts of the Erdtree! We need to find three Golden Seeds: at the Minor Erdtree, at the capital gates, and behind the old church. And two Sacred Tears: one at the Second Church of Marika, the other at the Church of the Stormcaller. Each one will make us noticeably stronger.

quests.title: Goldmask — Starting the Quest
quests.summary: Find Goldmask and report her to Corhyn.
quests.directions: From the Junction head north to the 'Bridge over the Forest'. Use the Waygate at the bridge to cross to the other side. After teleporting, turn around — Goldmask stands at the bridge's edge. Then return to Corhyn and tell him. After that, they will meet on the bridge.
quests.goal: Let's go north from the crossroads to the ruined bridge. There, at the very edge, stands a mysterious figure in golden robes — that is Goldmask. She gazes silently at the Erdtree. We'll return to Corhyn and tell him, then go back to the bridge to see their meeting.

quests.title: Sainted Hero's Grave
quests.summary: Clear the dungeon using a Stonesword Key, and defeat the Ancient Hero of Zamor.
quests.directions: In the centre of the plateau, south of the main road, find the entrance to the Sainted Hero's Grave. Use 1 Stonesword Key. Clear the dungeon, defeat the Ancient Hero of Zamor, and take the Godfrey Icon talisman.
quests.goal: Here, among the rocks, the Grave is hidden. It is sealed with a Stonesword Key. Inside it is dark and full of traps, but at the bottom the Ancient Hero of Zamor awaits. We'll defeat him and take his talisman — Godfrey Icon, which empowers our charged attacks.

quests.title: Altus Tunnel — Crystalians
quests.summary: Clear the mine and defeat the Crystalians.
quests.directions: South of the Minor Erdtree, by the cliffs, find the entrance to the Altus Tunnel. Inside there is a lift to the grace. Go through to the boss — the Crystalians. Use strike damage (hammer or magic) and defeat them. Take the Arsenal Charm +1 talisman.
quests.goal: Let's find the Altus Tunnel. Everything sparkles with crystals inside, but Crystalians live there — hard as diamond. Ordinary weapons bounce off them, but strike damage shatters them to dust. We'll smash them and take the Arsenal Charm +1.

quests.title: Old Altus Tunnel — Stone Digger Troll
quests.summary: Clear the old mine and defeat the Troll.
quests.directions: Northwest of the Junction, find the entrance to the Old Altus Tunnel. Go through to the boss — the Stone Digger Troll. Defeat him.
quests.goal: The abandoned Old Altus Tunnel. Everything is overgrown with cobwebs, and a Stone Digger Troll sits deep inside. He just guards his territory. Let's defeat him to clear another dungeon.

quests.title: Sage's Cave — Two Bosses
quests.summary: Clear the cave and defeat Necromancer Garris and the Black Knife Assassin.
quests.directions: In the southwestern part of the plateau, by a small pond, find the entrance to the Sage's Cave. Go through to the first boss — Necromancer Garris, then to the second — the Black Knife Assassin. Defeat both.
quests.goal: The dark Sage's Cave hides two bosses at once! First Necromancer Garris with his skeletons, and behind him — the Black Knife Assassin who lurks in the shadows. Be ready for two fights in a row, but the rewards will be double.

quests.title: Unsightly Catacombs
quests.summary: Use 2 Stonesword Keys and defeat the dual bosses.
quests.directions: Southwestern part of the plateau, at the foot of Mt. Gelmir. The entrance requires 2 Stonesword Keys. Clear the catacombs, defeat the Misbegotten Warrior and Perfumer Tricia.
quests.goal: At the very foot of Mt. Gelmir, the Unsightly Catacombs are hidden. Their door requires a full two Stonesword Keys! Inside lies ugliness and decay, and at the end — the Misbegotten Warrior and Perfumer Tricia. We'll defeat them and claim our rightful rewards.

quests.title: Fallingstar Beast
quests.summary: Defeat the Fallingstar Beast in the crater.
quests.directions: South of the Leyndell gates, southeast of the Junction, find the large crater. Inside is the Fallingstar Beast. Defeat it.
quests.goal: South of the Leyndell gates there is a crater where a celestial monster fell — the Fallingstar Beast. It is dangerous, its claws cut steel. But if we kill it, we will get the rarest smithing stones for our weapons.

quests.title: Night's Cavalry (Altus)
quests.summary: Wait for night and defeat the Night's Cavalry on the southern fork.
quests.directions: On the southern fork of the Altus Plateau (at night), the Night's Cavalry patrols. Wait for night, fight him, and defeat him.
quests.goal: As night falls, the Night's Cavalry will appear on the southern road. He charges on a black horse, swinging a halberd. Let's knock him from the saddle by striking his horse, and claim the Ash of War 'Shared Order'.

quests.title: Outer Wall Phantom Tree
quests.summary: Reach the Leyndell gates and activate the grace.
quests.directions: From the Junction, ascend the ramp guarded by Tree Sentinels. Beyond the large gates, activate the 'Outer Wall Phantom Tree' grace. Nearby, find two Golden Seeds.
quests.goal: We are almost at the gates of mighty Leyndell! We'll ascend the ramp, bypass the guardians, and light the 'Outer Wall Phantom Tree' grace. Two Golden Seeds will fall near it — the last gifts before the capital.

quests.title: Alexander on Altus
quests.summary: Find Alexander by the lava lake and talk to him.
quests.directions: In the southern part of the plateau, by the lava lake, Alexander stands. Approach and talk to him.
quests.goal: Alexander, our jar‑friend, stands by the lava lake in the south. He warms himself by the fire and is glad to see us. Let's talk to him — he will tell us where he is heading next, and his story will continue.

quests.title: Preparation for Mt. Gelmir
quests.summary: Make sure everything is ready for the ascent of Mt. Gelmir.
quests.directions: Check your inventory: at least 2 Stonesword Keys, upgraded weapons (+12–15 or +5–6), supplies for rot and poison.
quests.goal: Before leaving the plateau, let's check our gear. Do we have Stonesword Keys? Is our weapon upgraded to at least +12? Do we have supplies against poison and rot? Mt. Gelmir is a harsh place, and we must be ready for anything.

chapters.name: Mt. Gelmir
chapters.mainGoal: Ascend Mt. Gelmir, clear all key locations, find Azur, collect unique gear and talismans, and reach the gates of Volcano Manor.
chapters.summary: From the entrance to Mt. Gelmir to activating the grace at Volcano Manor — we will go through all dangerous zones, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Seethewater River
locations.summary: The first grace on Mt. Gelmir.

locations.name: Seethewater Cave
locations.summary: A hidden cave with the Mushroom Set and a talisman.

locations.name: Fort Laiedd
locations.summary: A fortress of Fire Monks with a Prelate and the Fire Scorpion Charm.

locations.name: Corpse-Stench Shack
locations.summary: The site of Anastasia's second invasion and the Golden Vow incantation.

locations.name: First Mt. Gelmir Campsite
locations.summary: Grace at the mountain foot, with runes and stones.

locations.name: Watchtower
locations.summary: A tower containing the Pulley Bow.

locations.name: Hermit Village
locations.summary: A village with armour sets and the Demi-Human Queen Maggie boss.

locations.name: Primeval Sorcerer Azur's Spot
locations.summary: The spot where Azur sits and gives a spell.

locations.name: Volcano Cave
locations.summary: An optional cave with the Demi-Human Queen Margo boss.

locations.name: Gelmir Hero's Grave
locations.summary: An optional grave with a chariot and a boss.

locations.name: Volcano Manor (entrance)
locations.summary: The gates of Volcano Manor and a grace.

quests.title: Entering Mt. Gelmir
quests.summary: Reach the Seethewater River and activate the first grace.
quests.directions: From the 'Erdtree-Gazing Hill' grace, head northwest to where the Tibia Mariner boss is. The entrance to Mt. Gelmir is to the left of that boss. Go through the narrow passage — the title 'Mt. Gelmir' will appear, along with the 'Seethewater River' grace. Activate it.
quests.goal: Tarnished, let's step onto this smoking land! We will leave the 'Erdtree-Gazing Hill' grace and go northwest, past that eerie ghost boatman. There, in a narrow pass, a river that boils like soup in a cauldron will meet us. Let's light our first grace on Mt. Gelmir — may it be our beacon in this inferno!

quests.title: Seethewater Cave — Mushroom Set
quests.summary: Use a Stonesword Key and clear the cave.
quests.directions: Follow the shallow seething river west. On the right you will notice the entrance to Seethewater Cave — it is easy to miss. It requires a Stonesword Key. Use it. Inside the cave are two Kindred of Rot bosses. Defeat them, take the Mushroom Armor Set and the Kindred of Rot's Exultation talisman.
quests.goal: Look, an entrance hides in the cliff, overgrown with mushrooms! To open it, we need our trusty Stonesword Key. Inside, among spores and mould, the Kindred of Rot dwell. Let's defeat them — and we'll get the wonderful Mushroom Set, in which we'll look like forest fairies, and a talisman that makes rot sing with joy!

quests.title: Fort Laiedd — Prelate and Fire Scorpion Charm
quests.summary: Clear the fort, defeat the Prelate, and take the talisman.
quests.directions: Continue following the river west to the 'Seethewater Terminus' grace. From here, the climb to Fort Laiedd begins. Fire Monks and Fire Chariots patrol the fort. Inside the fort is a Prelate (mini-boss). Defeat him, then climb to the top of the fort. Jump over the railing on the left — next to a phantom lies the Fire Scorpion Charm. Take it.
quests.goal: Before us is Fort Laiedd, where fire monks pray. At the very top sits a huge Prelate with a hammer white-hot. Let's defeat him! And then, look, don't miss it: right over the railing on the left, on a balcony, lies the Fire Scorpion Charm. It will boost our fire magic but make us a bit more fragile.

quests.title: Corpse-Stench Shack — Anastasia and Golden Vow
quests.summary: Survive Anastasia's invasion and take the incantation.
quests.directions: From Fort Laiedd, head northwest along the road. You will encounter several Abductor Virgins — it is best to lure them one by one. As you approach the shack, Anastasia's invasion will begin (second meeting). Defeat her. Inside the shack, take the 'Golden Vow' incantation. Behind the shack, on the bridge, lies a Stonesword Key — also take it.
quests.goal: Do you smell that? It smells of rotten meat and danger. This is the Corpse-Stench Shack, and our old acquaintance, the Tarnished-Eater Anastasia, will leap out of ambush again! She's grown meaner, but we're stronger. Let's fight her, and inside the shack, on the altar, lies the sacred incantation 'Golden Vow'. It will surround us with radiance and make us stronger and tougher!

quests.title: First Mt. Gelmir Campsite
quests.summary: Activate the grace and collect runes and stones.
quests.directions: Return to the camp with the three Abductor Virgins and climb the stairs to the southwest. At the top, activate the 'First Mt. Gelmir Campsite' grace. In coffins and near a wolf, find Golden Runes and a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
quests.goal: We've climbed even higher! Here's the first camp — we can catch our breath. Let's light the grace and look around: golden runes and even a rare somber smithing stone are scattered about. Let's collect everything like little hoarding mice!

quests.title: Pulley Bow
quests.summary: Reach the watchtower and take the bow.
quests.directions: Head north to the camp at the foot of the watchtower. On corpses — Beast Blood. At the top of the tower — Fire Arrows x10 and the Pulley Bow. Take them.
quests.goal: Do you see that tall tower that pierces the sky? That's a watchtower, and at its top the Pulley Bow awaits — an amazing weapon that fires fast, like lightning! Let's climb up and take it.

quests.title: Hermit Village — Demi-Human Queen Maggie
quests.summary: Clear the village and defeat Demi-Human Queen Maggie.
quests.directions: Continue the ascent to the 'Craftsman's Shack'. Just above the road is Hermit Village. At the end of the village, you will find the Demi-Human Queen Maggie. Defeat her, then take the Battle Mage Set and the Meat Dumpling from the building. Also on the body near the village entrance — two Boluses.
quests.goal: Мы подошли к Деревне Отшельников, где живут чародеи-отшельники. Их королева Мэгги — огромная получеловеческая ведьма с посохом. Победим её, и она отдаст нам свой сет боевого мага и полезные снадобья. Всё пригодится в бою с огнём!

quests.title: Primeval Sorcerer Azur — Comet Azur
quests.summary: Find Azur and obtain the legendary sorcery.
quests.directions: After defeating Maggie, in the corner behind her arena, find the 'Primeval Sorcerer Azur' grace. Azur sits on the cliff edge north of Hermit Village. Speak to him — he will give you the sorcery 'Comet Azur'.
quests.goal: Tarnished, let's go to the cliff edge, where the wind howls and the sky kisses the earth. There sits Azur — one of those who created the magic we know. He will give us 'Comet Azur' — a sorcery that rains down the very fury of the stars upon our foes! And then we will surely show it to Sellen to help her.

quests.title: Volcano Cave — optional
quests.summary: Clear the cave and defeat Demi-Human Queen Margo.
quests.directions: From the 'First Mt. Gelmir Campsite' grace, go northwest to the siege tower, then cross the rock above the chasm to the wooden stairs, climb up, and continue north to the cave. At the end of the cave is the boss Demi-Human Queen Margo. Defeat her.
quests.goal: Along the way there is another cave where Demi-Human Queen Margo hides. She's optional, but for a full sweep, let's pop in and show who's boss in these mountains!

quests.title: Gelmir Hero's Grave — optional
quests.summary: Clear the grave, avoid the chariot, and defeat the boss.
quests.directions: From the 'First Mt. Gelmir Campsite' grace, run northwest to the siege tower, climb up, turn south, and walk all the way to the grave entrance. Inside, dodge the chariot by hiding in alcoves. At the end of the grave, a boss awaits. Defeat it.
quests.goal: Among the cliffs hides a grave where a ghostly chariot races through the corridors, ready to crush everything in its path. If we are nimble and dodge it, we will reach the boss and claim a well‑deserved reward!

quests.title: Volcano Manor — End of the Ascent
quests.summary: Reach the Manor gates and activate the grace.
quests.directions: From Hermit Village, continue climbing northwest. At the end of the path you will see Volcano Manor. Activate the 'Volcano Manor' grace at the entrance.
quests.goal: Tarnished, we did it! Before us are the gates of Volcano Manor — huge, grim, but alluring. Let's light the grace at the entrance. We passed through fire and ash, and now we are ready to enter and learn what secrets this place holds.

chapters.name: Volcano Manor
chapters.mainGoal: Join Volcano Manor, complete all contracts, advance NPC quests, find the secret passage, and defeat Rykard while preserving all rewards.
chapters.summary: From entering the manor to the final battle with Rykard — we will go through all halls, contracts and quests, not missing a single item or NPC.
