locations.summary: The main hall with a round table and grace.

locations.name: Guest Rooms
locations.summary: A corridor with rooms unlocked by the Drawing‑Room Key.

locations.name: Parlor with a Long Table
locations.summary: Room with NPCs: Bernahl, Diallos, Rya.

locations.name: Patches at the Entrance
locations.summary: The spot where Patches appears after reloading.

locations.name: Istvan Contract Spot (Limgrave)
locations.summary: Red sign under the bridge in Stormhill.

locations.name: Bridge of Iniquity (Altus)
locations.summary: Red sign on the bridge where Riley awaits.

locations.name: Mountaintops of the Giants (third contract)
locations.summary: Location for the third contract (later).

locations.name: Secret Passage to Rykard
locations.summary: Illusory wall behind the table in the parlor.

locations.name: Rykard's Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

quests.title: Joining Volcano Manor
quests.summary: Enter the manor, speak to Tanith, and join her ranks.
quests.directions: Approach the main doors of the manor and enter. Walk down the corridor to the round table, speak to Tanith, and agree to join the manor.
quests.goal: Tarnished, let's step into this majestic manor that smells of sulphur and intrigue! Tanith, the lady of these halls, will greet us and offer us a place in her family. Agree, and she will give us the Drawing‑Room Key, and we will light the grace beside her throne — this will be our new home for a while.

quests.title: Exploring the Manor Rooms
quests.summary: Open the rooms with the Drawing‑Room Key and collect items.
quests.directions: Use the Drawing‑Room Key to open all doors in the corridor to the right of the main hall. Enter the first room on the right and the last one on the left.
quests.goal: We have the Drawing‑Room Key! Let's walk down the corridor and open all the doors. In the first room on the right we'll find a useful Spirit Ashes flask, and in the last room on the left our new acquaintances — Bernahl, Diallos, and Rya — will gather. Let's talk to them and take the letter waiting for us on the table.

quests.title: Dialogues with NPCs and Preparing for Contracts
quests.summary: Exhaust dialogues with Bernahl, Diallos, and Rya.
quests.directions: In the parlor with the long table, speak to each NPC — Bernahl, Diallos, Rya — until their dialogue is exhausted.
quests.goal: Let's sit down at the long table and speak with each of our new companions. Bernahl will speak of his warrior past, Diallos of his lost servant, and Rya will worry about something hidden in the walls. We'll listen to them to the last word, so their hearts open to us.

quests.title: Contract 1: Old Knight Istvan
quests.summary: Find the red sign in Limgrave, defeat Istvan, and claim the rewards.
quests.directions: Take the contract letter from Tanith. Teleport to the Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave, find the red sign under the bridge, and activate it.
quests.goal: Our first contract is in hand! We need to return to our home Limgrave, to where we once trained at the Warmaster's Shack. Under the bridge, in the shadows, a red sign glows. Let's summon Old Knight Istvan and show him we are worthy of the title of hunters!

quests.title: Contract 2: Rogue Knight Riley
quests.summary: Find the red sign on the Bridge of Iniquity, defeat Riley, and claim the reward.
quests.directions: Take the second letter from the parlor. Head to the Bridge of Iniquity on Altus, find the red sign, and activate it.
quests.goal: The second letter calls us to the Bridge of Iniquity on Altus. There, under a grey sky, Rogue Knight Riley awaits, whose halberd drinks blood. Let's activate the red sign and fight him to earn new gifts from Tanith and advance into the manor's secrets.

quests.title: Meeting Patches
quests.summary: Reload the area, find Patches at the entrance, and talk to him.
quests.directions: Rest at the grace in the main hall, then approach the entrance door — Patches will appear. Talk to him.
quests.goal: Oh, look who's lurking by the entrance! It's our old rogue Patches. Let's talk to him — he always has something to sell or a contract to offer. We'll take his letter — it smells of a new adventure.

quests.title: Third Contract (preparation)
quests.summary: Take the third contract from Tanith, but complete it later.
quests.directions: Return to Tanith after the second contract and take the third letter.
quests.goal: Hooray, we earned the third contract! But this target hides far to the north, in the snows of the Mountaintops of the Giants. Let's just take the letter and keep it for now — we'll complete it when the time comes, and for now focus on the manor's secrets.

quests.title: Rya's Quest — Uncovering the Secret
quests.summary: Advance Rya's quest through dialogues and find the Serpent's Amnion.
quests.directions: After the first contract, speak to Rya about the strange sounds. Then go to the adjacent room (opposite the parlor) and speak to the serpent. After that, return to Tanith and discuss the Zorayas form. Later, upon finding the Serpent's Amnion (in the Temple of Eiglay), give it to Rya.
quests.goal: Our sweet Rya hears strange whispers in the walls. Let's help her! We'll go into the adjacent room — there we'll find the serpent, her true form. We'll talk to her and to Tanith about it, and later, when we set out, we'll find the Serpent's Amnion for Rya in the Temple of Eiglay. That way we'll help her accept herself.

quests.title: Bernahl's Quest — Invasion of Leyndell
quests.summary: Advance Bernahl's quest by completing the invasion in Leyndell.
quests.directions: After completing the contracts, speak to Bernahl in the parlor and agree to the invasion of Leyndell. The summon sign will be in the centre of the Roundtable in Leyndell.
quests.goal: Bernahl calls us to the capital! He wants us to help him invade Leyndell. This is a dangerous step, but it will strengthen our friendship and earn us his combat skill 'Gelmir's Fury' — a fiery whirlwind that sweeps everything away.

quests.title: Secret Passage to Rykard
quests.summary: Find and open the illusory wall in the parlor.
quests.directions: After completing all contracts and NPC quests, in the parlor strike the wall behind the long table to open the secret passage.
quests.goal: Now that all contracts and business are settled, we can uncover the main secret! Approach the wall behind the long table in the parlor and strike it. It will vanish, revealing the path down to the lair of Rykard himself. But remember: bring your best gear, for ahead lies a battle with a demigod!

quests.title: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
quests.summary: Defeat Rykard using the Serpent-Hunter.
quests.directions: Descend through the secret passage down to Rykard's arena. At the entrance, take the Serpent-Hunter, then enter the fog and fight the boss.
quests.goal: Here he is, Tarnished! The huge serpent that was once a demigod. At the entrance lies the 'Serpent-Hunter' — take it, for only this weapon can wound the blasphemer. Strike him, dodging the waves of fire, and we will cleanse this place of taint!

quests.title: After the Victory — Tanith's Fate
quests.summary: Talk to Tanith after the victory, find her in Rykard's hall.
quests.directions: After defeating Rykard, return to the main hall, speak to Tanith, then find her in Rykard's hall (she will be eating the body). Decide her fate.
quests.goal: It's over, but where is Tanith? She has left the throne room. Let's search for her — loyal to the end, she went to the body of her lord. You will find her bent over the serpent's remains. We can leave her in peace or grant her release from this mad grief. The choice is ours.

acts.name: Leyndell and Mountaintops of the Giants
acts.summary: Leyndell, the Royal Capital — the heart of the Lands Between. Here, at the foot of the Erdtree, all paths converge. We must enter the capital, gather its treasures, and face those who guard the way to the Tree.
acts.lore: Leyndell is the greatest city of the Lands Between, built around the Erdtree. Here kings and queens ruled, here the fates of the world were decided. But now the capital has fallen, and its streets are filled with shadows of the past. We must pass through its halls to reach the Tree and continue our journey.

chapters.name: Leyndell, Royal Capital
chapters.mainGoal: Enter the capital, clear all surface zones, collect all unique items (including the Bolt of Gransax), advance key NPC quests, defeat mandatory bosses, and obtain the Rold Medallion.
chapters.summary: From entering the capital through the Draconic Tree Sentinel to obtaining the Rold Medallion — we will go through all key points of Leyndell, not missing a single item or quest.

locations.name: Draconic Tree Sentinel (arena)
locations.summary: The battleground with the Draconic Tree Sentinel at the capital's entrance.

locations.name: East Capital Rampart
locations.summary: Grace at the capital entrance, where Melina and Boc meet you.

locations.name: Avenue Balcony
locations.summary: The central grace of the capital, from which paths open to all zones.

locations.name: Fortified Manor
locations.summary: The former Roundtable Hold, where you can find the Sacred Whetblade and the Coded Sword.

locations.name: Bolt of Gransax
locations.summary: The location of the Legendary Armament — Bolt of Gransax.

locations.name: Godfrey's Shade Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with Godfrey's Golden Shade.

locations.name: Morgott's Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with Morgott, the Omen King.

locations.name: Erdtree Sanctuary
locations.summary: Grace after defeating Godfrey, leading to Morgott and the Bolt.

quests.title: Draconic Tree Sentinel
quests.summary: Defeat the Draconic Tree Sentinel at the capital's entrance.
quests.directions: From the Altus Plateau, head to the northeastern entrance to the capital, following the main road to the Outer Wall. On the bridge at the gate, the Draconic Tree Sentinel will meet you.
quests.goal: Tarnished, we are right at the gates of Leyndell! But the path is barred by the Draconic Tree Sentinel, whose hammer strikes with lightning and whose horse breathes fire. Let's fight him, for beyond him lies the grandeur of the capital!

quests.title: East Capital Rampart — Meeting Melina
quests.summary: Ride the lift and activate the grace, speak to Melina.
quests.directions: After defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel, enter the door behind him, cross the bridge, and enter the building. Inside, use the lift in the room on the left to go up. Exit outside, then into the room on the right — there activate the 'East Capital Rampart' grace and speak to the appearing Melina.
quests.goal: Let's ride the lift in the room on the left and step out into the fresh air. There, in a little room on the right, a grace glows — let's light it! Then Melina will come to us to thank us for bringing her home, to the capital.

quests.title: Saving Boc
quests.summary: Use the 'You're Beautiful' Prattling Pate to save Boc.
quests.directions: Next to the 'East Capital Rampart' grace, you will find Boc. In the dialogue, choose 'Use You're Beautiful Prattling Pate' to convince him not to use the Larval Tear.
quests.goal: Oh, look, Boc is sitting by the grace and crying! He wants to become beautiful and thinks a Larval Tear will help him. But that would kill him! Instead, let's use the Prattling Pate we found in the Hermit Village. It will tell him: 'You're beautiful!' — and he will stay alive and happy.

quests.title: Path across the Rooftops to the Avenue
quests.summary: Cross the rooftops, clear enemies, and activate the grace.
quests.directions: From the 'East Capital Rampart', follow the corridor to the right, then the path to the left across the rooftops, clearing Oracle Envoys and Gargoyles. At the end, activate the 'Avenue Balcony' grace.
quests.goal: We need to get to the city centre! Let's go across the rooftops — here are trumpeting Oracles and stone Gargoyles. But along the way, we'll find a golden rune, a smithing stone, and even a Stonesword Key. And at the end, a cosy balcony with a grace awaits, from where you can see the whole avenue!

quests.title: Clearing the Avenue and Seedbed Curse #1
quests.summary: Descend to the avenue, find the scarab with an Ash of War, and collect the Seedbed Curse.
quests.directions: Descend from the balcony to the main street, clear Leyndell Knights and Perfumers. Find the scarab (it drops the Ash of War 'Thunderbolt'), then in the arched passage to the northwest, find Seedbed Curse #1.
quests.goal: Let's descend to the main street — it is full of knights and masked perfumers. We need to find a little scarab, which will drop the Ash of War 'Thunderbolt'. And in the arched passage to the northwest, a 'Seedbed Curse' is hidden — a dark item for a very important quest.

quests.title: Fortified Manor — Sacred Whetblade and Coded Sword
quests.summary: Traverse the manor, collect the Sacred Whetblade, survive invasions, and take the Coded Sword.
quests.directions: From the 'Avenue Balcony', climb the Dragon's Wing to the northwest to the copy of the Roundtable Hold. Inside, at the anvil, find the Sacred Whetblade. Then survive the invasions (Wandering Sorcerer Wilhelm and Vargram). Climb to the upper floor and take the Coded Sword from the throne.
quests.goal: Tarnished, here, on the dragon's wing, we can climb into the Fortified Manor! It looks exactly like our Roundtable Hold, only abandoned. At the anvil where Hewg used to sit lies the Sacred Whetblade, and upstairs, on the throne, the Coded Sword. But be careful: two invasions await us inside!

quests.title: Bolt of Gransax — Legendary Armament
quests.summary: Claim the Bolt of Gransax — a critically important item.
quests.directions: From the Erdtree Sanctuary (after defeating Godfrey), exit through the western door, descend the stairs to the lift, ride down, approach the giant spear, and climb it all the way to the top to claim the Bolt of Gransax.
quests.goal: Listen carefully, Tarnished! This is the MOST important item in the city. The huge stone lightning bolt that pierced the building is a Legendary Armament! We must climb it after we pass the Erdtree Sanctuary. If we don't do it now, it will be too late — the capital will change, and the bolt will disappear forever!

quests.title: Corhyn and Goldmask's Quest — Capital Stage
quests.summary: Find Corhyn and Goldmask at the Colosseum and exhaust their dialogue.
quests.directions: In the southwestern part of the city, at the large Colosseum, find Corhyn and Goldmask. Speak to Corhyn, exhaust all dialogue.
quests.goal: Let's go to the big Colosseum in the southwest. There, in the silence, Goldmask stands gazing at the Erdtree, and nearby is our friend Corhyn. Let's talk to them — they are pondering the nature of Radagon, and this will help us on the path to the 'Age of Order'.

quests.title: Godfrey's Shade (Golden Shade)
quests.summary: Defeat Godfrey's Golden Shade.
quests.directions: From the 'Avenue Balcony', head northeast to the massive doors before the Erdtree, climb the branches, and enter the arena. Defeat Godfrey's Shade.
quests.goal: Right before the Tree itself, a Golden Shade awaits — the shadow of the First Lord himself, Godfrey! He is slow, but every swing shakes the ground. Dodge sideways and strike his back. Defeating him will give us the third talisman slot and access to the Sanctuary.

quests.title: Morgott, the Omen King
quests.summary: Defeat Morgott and obtain his Great Rune and Remembrance.
quests.directions: After defeating Godfrey's Shade, exit onto the balcony on the east side, climb the roots to the 'Queen's Bedchamber', and enter the mist wall. Summon Melina at the entrance if you wish, and fight Morgott.
quests.goal: Here he is, Tarnished! Morgott, the Omen King, the last guardian of the Erdtree. He leaps like lightning and showers us with light blades. Summon Melina at the entrance — she will fight beside us! And remember: keep your distance, and attack after his jumps! This is our most important fight in the capital!

quests.title: Inspecting the Tree and the Rold Medallion
quests.summary: Approach the Tree, speak to Melina, and obtain the Rold Medallion.
quests.directions: After defeating Morgott, approach the Erdtree, speak to Melina, and receive the Rold Medallion. Then return to the Roundtable Hold and exhaust dialogues with NPCs.
quests.goal: We are at the very foot of the Erdtree, but the entrance is blocked by thorns. Melina will give us the Rold Medallion and tell us we need to go to the Mountaintops of the Giants to kindle the flame. Let's take the medallion, return to the Roundtable, and tell everyone about our victory!

chapters.name: Subterranean and Hidden Zones
chapters.mainGoal: Explore the Leyndell sewers, start the Dung Eater's quest, clear the catacombs, defeat Mohg, the Omen, make a choice at the Three Fingers, explore the Deeproot Depths, and complete Fia's quest.
chapters.summary: From entering the sewers to defeating Lichdragon Fortissax — we will go through all underground zones of the capital, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Underground Roadside
locations.summary: Grace at the entrance to the Leyndell sewers.

locations.name: Dung Eater's Cell
locations.summary: The place where the Dung Eater is imprisoned.

locations.name: Leyndell Catacombs
locations.summary: Catacombs beneath the capital with the boss Esgar.

locations.name: Cathedral of the Forsaken
locations.summary: Arena of Mohg, the Omen, and passage to the Three Fingers.

locations.name: Three Fingers Chamber
locations.summary: The place where you can receive the Frenzied Flame Seal.

locations.name: Deeproot Depths
locations.summary: A location beneath the Erdtree's roots, where Fia's quest concludes.

locations.name: Prince of Death's Throne
locations.summary: The meeting place with Fia and the battle against her champions and Fortissax.

quests.title: Entering the Sewers
quests.summary: Find the well and descend into the sewers, activate the grace.
quests.directions: From the 'Avenue Balcony' grace, descend the stairs to the west, pass through the door into an open area with three Leyndell Knights. In the western part of the ruins, by the wing of a dead dragon, find a well. Descend the stairs down and follow the tunnels to the 'Underground Roadside' grace.
quests.goal: Tarnished, let's descend into the underbelly of the capital! From our balcony, go west, through the ruins that smell of damp. There, among the stones, an old well is hidden, leading into the sewers. We'll climb down the slippery stairs, pass by the rats, and light a grace — may its glow dispel this eternal gloom!

quests.title: Dung Eater's Quest — Beginning
quests.summary: Find the Dung Eater's cell and start his quest.
quests.directions: From the 'Underground Roadside' grace, exit into the corridor with three Omen, go to the end and drop into the pit by the left wall. Follow the tunnel (ignore the first passage on the right), pass the poison plants, and climb the stairs. Turn right — at the end of the corridor is the Dung Eater's cell. Open it with the Sewer Gaol Key and speak to him.
quests.goal: We need to find the one called the Dung Eater. His cell is hidden deep within. We'll go down the corridor with three huge Omen, then drop into the pit by the left wall — yes, straight down! There, past the poison plants and up the stairs, at the end of the tunnel, we'll open his door with the Sewer Gaol Key and talk to him.

quests.title: Leyndell Catacombs — Esgar, Priest of Blood
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs, collect Ghost Glovewort, and defeat Esgar.
quests.directions: In the sewers, in the room with the Giant Crayfish, find the stairs down from the 'Underground Roadside', then follow the pipes to the southwest. On the lower level, find the entrance in the wall — this is the entrance to the Leyndell Catacombs. Clear the dungeon, collecting Ghost Glovewort (6, 9, 8), and at the end defeat Esgar, Priest of Blood.
quests.goal: In the room with the giant crayfish, there is a descent — we'll go through the pipes to the southwest and find an entrance in the wall. These are the catacombs, full of blood and secrets. There, Esgar, Priest of Blood, awaits us, summoning dogs and attacking with blood magic. Let's defeat him and take the talisman that enhances our bleed attacks!

quests.title: Mohg, the Omen
quests.summary: Defeat Mohg, the Omen, and obtain Mohg's Shackle and the talisman.
quests.directions: Reach the Cathedral of the Forsaken (from the catacombs or through the sewer labyrinth). Activate the grace. Enter the arena with Mohg. Use the Purifying Crystal Tear in the Flask of Wondrous Physick to block the 'NIHIL' curse. Defeat the boss. Behind the arena, in a chest, find the Erdtree's Favor +1 talisman.
quests.goal: We have reached the Cathedral of the Forsaken, where Morgott's twin brother hides — Mohg, the Omen. His power lies in cursed blood. To survive, we need the Purifying Crystal Tear in our physick — it will block his deadly 'NIHIL'! Let's defeat him and claim Mohg's Shackle and the ancient talisman hidden behind the altar.

quests.title: Three Fingers — A Choice of Fate
quests.summary: Accept or ignore the touch of the Three Fingers.
quests.directions: Behind the chest in the boss room (Cathedral of the Forsaken) is an illusory altar. Strike it to open the passage, and descend along the roots down to the giant doors. Remove all armour to open the doors. Inside — the Three Fingers. You may allow them to touch you (receive the Frenzied Flame Seal) or simply take the items in the area and leave.
quests.goal: Behind the chest in Mohg's room lies an illusory altar. Strike it, and we will descend along the roots to a giant stone door. But to enter, you must remove all armour! Beyond it — the Three Fingers, the embodiment of the Frenzied Flame. If they touch us, we will receive a Seal for a special ending, but it will change us forever. The choice is yours alone, Tarnished.

quests.title: Deeproot Depths — Exploration
quests.summary: Explore the Deeproot Depths, collect items, and find Fia.
quests.directions: Reach the Deeproot Depths (via the Siofra Aqueduct after the Gargoyles or from the sewers after Mohg). Activate the 'Waterfall Crest' grace. Explore the area: kill the Erdtree Avatar, collect Ghost Glovewort 4, find the scarab with the Ash of War 'Golden Land', find the incantation 'Erdtree Stars', collect the 'Mausoleum Soldier Ashes'. Then proceed to the Prince of Death's Throne and find Fia.
quests.goal: We have reached the Deeproot Depths — a place where the Erdtree itself stretches into infinity. It is quiet and sorrowful here. Let's explore everything around: kill the Erdtree Avatar, find ancient incantations and ashes, and then head to the Prince of Death's Throne, where Fia has been waiting for us.

quests.title: Fia's Quest Finale — Champions and Lichdragon Fortissax
quests.summary: Speak to Fia, defeat her champions and the Lichdragon, obtain the Cursemark of Death.
quests.directions: At the Prince of Death's Throne, speak to Fia, give her the Cursemark of Death (from the Carian Study Hall). Speak several times, then choose 'Enter the Deathbed Dream'. Fight Fia's Champions (PvP-style battle). After victory, inside the dream the Lichdragon Fortissax will appear — defeat him. Then speak to Fia and claim the Cursemark of Death.
quests.goal: Fia asks us to give her the Cursemark of Death to complete the ritual. Let's give it to her, then enter her dream. There, three of her loyal champions await — as dangerous as true warriors. And when they fall, the Lichdragon Fortissax himself will appear, an ancient beast whose breath is death itself. Defeat him, and Fia will give us the Cursemark of Death.

acts.name: Forbidden Lands and Mountaintops of the Giants
acts.summary: The Forbidden Lands are the last frontier before the snowy expanses. Here, among mists and ambushes, we will find the keys to great power and open the way to the Mountaintops of the Giants.
acts.lore: The Forbidden Lands are a wasteland separating Leyndell from the Mountaintops of the Giants. Here, in the fog, vulgar militiamen and ancient guardians roam. But it is here that the Blade of Calling is hidden — a weapon tied to Melina's fate.

chapters.name: Forbidden Lands
chapters.mainGoal: Traverse the Forbidden Lands, collect the Blade of Calling, defeat optional and mandatory bosses, and activate the Grand Lift of Rold.
chapters.summary: From entering the Forbidden Lands to activating the Grand Lift of Rold — we will go through all key points of the zone, not missing a single item or boss.

quests.title: Entering the Forbidden Lands
quests.summary: Descend on the lift from Leyndell and activate the grace.
quests.directions: After defeating Morgott in Leyndell, open the locked door in the east of the capital and approach the massive lift. Ride it down. Upon exiting, activate the 'Forbidden Lands' grace.
quests.goal: Tarnished, we leave the golden capital via the old lift. It will carry us down into the misty wasteland where no ordinary traveller has set foot. Once we are at the bottom, let's immediately light the grace — here it is so gloomy that its light will be our anchor in this sea of fog.

quests.title: Blade of Calling — THE MOST IMPORTANT ITEM
quests.summary: Find the hidden room in the lift shaft and claim the Blade of Calling.
quests.directions: From the 'Forbidden Lands' grace, turn toward the lift. Face southwest before activating the lift. Start the lift and, as soon as it begins to rise, watch the wall — a gap will soon appear. Immediately jump into it. You will enter a hidden room in the shaft. On the table lies the Blade of Calling.
quests.goal: Now, Tarnished, pay attention! This is one of those moments they sing legends about. Return to the lift and face southwest. When the lift goes up, keep your eyes peeled! A gap will flash in the wall, like a secret entrance to another world. Jump in without hesitation! Inside, on a dusty table, lies the Blade of Calling — a weapon inextricably linked to our Melina. We cannot miss it!

quests.title: Golden Seed and Somber Smithing Stone
quests.summary: Collect the Golden Seed and Somber Smithing Stone 7 on the road.
quests.directions: From the 'Forbidden Lands' grace, head east along the main road. You will see a phantom tree by the roadside — next to it lies a Golden Seed. A little further, inside a giant skull, lies a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
quests.goal: Let's walk along this old road to the east. Here, by the phantom tree glowing in the fog, another Golden Seed will drop. A bit further, a giant skull stands — inside it hides a precious Somber Smithing Stone [7]. Let's collect them to grow stronger before the snows.

quests.title: Night's Cavalry (Forbidden Lands)
quests.summary: Wait for night and defeat the Night's Cavalry.
quests.directions: On the same road where you collected the seed and stone, wait for nightfall (you can rest at the grace and choose 'Pass time until night'). The Night's Cavalry will appear on the road, patrolling it. Fight and defeat it.
quests.goal: As soon as darkness falls, a rider in black armour will appear on this misty road. This is the Night's Cavalry, which has patrolled the forbidden path for ages. Let's fight him, aiming for the horse, and claim the rare Ash of War 'Phantom Slash' — it will make our weapon sing in the night.

quests.title: Black Blade Kindred
quests.summary: Defeat the Black Blade Kindred at the lift entrance.
quests.directions: Continue east along the road to the very end. You will reach a massive lift platform, before which stands a huge stone gargoyle — that is the Black Blade Kindred. Engage and defeat it.
quests.goal: At the end of the road, right by the lift, a stone guardian awaits — a huge gargoyle named the Black Blade Kindred. It stands motionless like a statue, but as soon as we approach, it will come alive! Let's summon our spirits to distract it, and strike with lightning and magic. This is the last enemy before the Mountaintops!

quests.title: Grand Lift of Rold — Path to the Mountaintops of the Giants
quests.summary: Activate the grace and use the Rold Medallion to ascend.
quests.directions: After defeating the Black Blade Kindred, approach the lift platform. Activate the 'Grand Lift of Rold' grace, then use the Rold Medallion to ascend to the Mountaintops of the Giants.
quests.goal: Here it is, Tarnished — the great lift that rises straight into the heavens. Let's light the grace at its base, then place the Rold Medallion that Melina gave us. The platform will shudder and slowly carry us upward, toward the snowy peaks where the eternal flame burns.

chapters.name: Mountaintops of the Giants
chapters.mainGoal: Fully explore the Mountaintops of the Giants, clear all dungeons, complete contracts, obtain the left half of the Haligtree Medallion, defeat the Fire Giant, and reach the Forge of the Giants.
chapters.summary: From entering the region to activating the Forge of the Giants — we will go through all key zones, not missing a single item or quest.

quests.title: West Map and Zamor Ruins Grace
quests.summary: Collect the west map and activate the grace.
quests.directions: Step off the Grand Lift of Rold and immediately take the map from the stele. Then follow the path to the Zamor Ruins and activate the grace.
quests.goal: Tarnished, we are in the Mountaintops of the Giants! Everything is white around us, and the wind sings icy songs. Right by the lift stands a stele — take the first map there so we don't get lost in this snowy silence. Then ride along the path to the Zamor Ruins, where a grace fire and an unexpected encounter await us.

quests.title: Meeting Shabriri
quests.summary: Talk to or kill Shabriri at the grace.
quests.directions: At the grace in the Zamor Ruins, you will meet Shabriri. Talk to him (or kill him). Take the Ronin's Set.
quests.goal: By the fire of the Zamor Ruins, someone awaits us… Yura? No, it's Shabriri, having taken his body. His eyes burn with yellow flame, and he will speak of saving Melina through the Frenzied Flame. Listen to him if you wish, or kill him — either way, the Ronin's Set will be ours.

quests.title: Miner's Bell Bearing 3
quests.summary: Collect the bell bearing and incantation in the ruins.
quests.directions: Search the Zamor Ruins, find the Miner's Bell Bearing 3, the incantation 'Zamor Ice Storm', and kill the scarab with a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
quests.goal: These ruins are full of treasures! We need to find the Miner's Bell Bearing 3 here — it will let us buy stones [5] and [6] from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable! Also, there's an ice incantation and a scarab with a rare stone.

quests.title: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs, find the hidden lever, defeat the Grave Warden, and obtain the Deathroot.
quests.directions: Find the catacombs before the first Chain Bridge. Go through the dungeon, find the hidden lever above the statue on the upper level, then pass through the room with falling blades and defeat the Grave Warden.
quests.goal: Let's descend into the catacombs, full of creepy imps and traps. There is a hidden lever above a statue — it will open the way through the room with falling blades. At the end, a Grave Warden awaits. Let's defeat him and take the Deathroot for our old beast friend Gurranq!

quests.title: Crossing the Bridges and East Map
quests.summary: Cross two chain bridges, pass the garrison, and take the east map.
quests.directions: Cross the first Chain Bridge, pass through the Guardians' Garrison, then cross the second Chain Bridge and find the stele with the east map.
quests.goal: Ahead are two massive chain bridges! We'll pass through the Guardians' Garrison, where fire monks still burn their fires, collect everything useful, and reach the eastern stele with the map. It will reveal the path to Castle Sol and the volcanoes.

quests.title: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
quests.summary: Clear a difficult dungeon using Stonesword Keys, and obtain a unique weapon.
quests.directions: Find the grave and enter. Use two Stonesword Keys to access valuable rooms. Navigate traps and defeat guardians. At the end, get the Cranial Vessel Candlestand.
quests.goal: In this grave lie heroes who slew giants. It is full of traps and illusory walls. We'll need two Stonesword Keys to unlock all secrets and claim the legendary Cranial Vessel Candlestand — a weapon that sings songs of war!

quests.title: Castle Sol — Left Half of the Haligtree Medallion
quests.summary: Clear the castle, defeat Commander Niall, and take the left half of the Haligtree Medallion.
quests.directions: Enter Castle Sol, fight through the Banished Knights, climb to the top, and battle Commander Niall. Defeat him, then take the medallion at the cliff edge beyond the arena.
quests.goal: Here it is, Castle Sol, where eternal winter rules. At its peak stands Commander Niall, an old warrior with a prosthetic leg, and his spectral knights. First kill the two swordsmen he summons, then fight him! After the battle, climb to the cliff and take the left half of the Secret Haligtree Medallion — without it, we cannot reach Malenia!

quests.title: Spiritcaller's Cave
quests.summary: Clear the cave, kill the Spiritcaller Snails, and defeat the Godskin duo.
quests.directions: Find the cave (requires 2 Stonesword Keys). Inside, kill the spiritcaller snails, then fight the Godskin duo (Apostle and Noble) and obtain the talisman.
quests.goal: To enter this cave, we need two Stonesword Keys. Inside, tricky snails summon ghosts. Kill them first to make the spirits vanish! And at the end, a Godskin duo awaits — the Apostle and the Noble. Defeat them and claim the talisman that heals us in battle!

quests.title: Final Contract — Juno Hoslow
quests.summary: Complete the final Volcano Manor contract.
quests.directions: Find the red summon sign at the Shack of the Lofty. Activate it and defeat Juno Hoslow. Return to Tanith (or the reward will come later) for the 'Taker's Cameo'.
quests.goal: At the Shack of the Lofty, a red sign glows. This is Juno Hoslow, Diallos' brother, and the last target of Volcano Manor. He is fast and inflicts bleed, but we must defeat him to finish all of Tanith's contracts and receive the 'Taker's Cameo'. This must be done BEFORE we burn the Erdtree!

quests.title: Fire Giant
quests.summary: Defeat the Fire Giant and obtain his Great Rune and Remembrance.
quests.directions: Reach the Fire Giant's arena. Use Torrent for mobility. In phase one, attack his left leg. In phase two, stay behind him and hit his arms and legs. Summon Alexander if available.
quests.goal: Here he is, Tarnished — the last Fire Giant! His left leg is bandaged, that's his weak spot in phase one. Hit it, dodge the fire pots, and summon Alexander if he's here! In phase two, the giant will open an eye on his chest and spew flame — stay behind him. Torrent will help you catch up. Defeat him, and the path to the Forge will be ours!

quests.title: Forge of the Giants — Point of No Return
quests.summary: Reach the Forge, activate the grace, decide whether to burn the Erdtree.
quests.directions: After defeating the Giant, head northeast to the Forge. Climb the chain and activate the grace. Make sure all quests are closed, then make your decision to burn the Erdtree.
quests.goal: We are at the Forge of the Giants! Here, at the edge of the bowl, a grace awaits. But remember, Tarnished: this is the point of no return. If we go further and let Melina burn the Erdtree (or do it ourselves), the whole world will change, and many of our friends will leave. Check all your quests, finish your business… and then we'll take this step together.

chapters.name: Consecrated Snowfield
chapters.mainGoal: Enter the Consecrated Snowfield, explore all locations, clear dungeons, solve the Ordina puzzle, open the portal to the Haligtree, and complete Latenna's quest.
chapters.summary: From activating the Secret Medallion to opening the portal to the Haligtree — we will go through all key zones of the region, not missing a single item or quest.

quests.title: Entering the Consecrated Snowfield
quests.summary: Use the Secret Haligtree Medallion at the Grand Lift of Rold and enter the region.
quests.directions: Return to the Forbidden Lands at the Grand Lift of Rold. Step onto the lift platform and switch the action from 'Hoist Medallion' to 'Hoist Secret Medallion'. The lift will take you to the corridor dungeon 'Secret Path to the Haligtree'. Go through it to the end and emerge outside — you will be in the Consecrated Snowfield. Activate the grace right before you.
quests.goal: Tarnished, let's return to the Grand Lift of Rold! We have both halves of the secret medallion, which we collected from across the world. We'll place it in the lift, and it will open a hidden passage, concealed from prying eyes. We'll walk through the mysterious corridor, emerge into the blizzard, and light a grace on this sacred snow.

quests.title: Map and Inner Grace
quests.summary: Reach the inner part of the field and take the map.
quests.directions: From the first grace, head north. Cross the frozen river. On the opposite bank, find the 'Inner Consecrated Snowfield' grace. Slightly north, at the stele, take the Map: Consecrated Snowfield.
quests.goal: Let's cross the frozen river to the north. There, on the other bank, another grace glows, and next to it — a stele with a map. Without it, we'll simply drown in this white shroud! We'll light the fire and take the map to see all the secret paths.

quests.title: Anastasia's Third Invasion
quests.summary: Defeat Anastasia in the third and final invasion.
quests.directions: From the 'Inner Consecrated Snowfield', head west along the frozen river. The third invasion of Anastasia will begin. Defeat her.
quests.goal: She's back! The Tarnished-Eater tracked us even here, to the edge of the world. She'll leap out of the blizzard on the frozen river — furious, hungry, but already familiar. This is her final attempt. Let's put an end to it and claim her last gift.

quests.title: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs and defeat the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist.
quests.directions: From the 'Inner Consecrated Snowfield', head north along the eastern wall. Find the catacomb entrance. Activate the grace, clear the dungeon, and defeat the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist at the end.
quests.goal: Let's descend into the catacombs hidden by the northern cliffs. There, among rot and falling blades, the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist prowls. He is soaked in blood, but we know how to handle him! We'll defeat him and claim his stylish cloak.

quests.title: Cave of the Forlorn and the Golden Epitaph
quests.summary: Clear the cave and defeat the Misbegotten Crusader.
quests.directions: In the southeastern part of the region, by the cliffs, find the entrance to the Cave of the Forlorn. Go through to the end and defeat the Misbegotten Crusader.
quests.goal: In the southeast, the Cave of the Forlorn is hidden, home to the forgotten Misbegotten Crusader. He guards the 'Golden Epitaph' — a sword that shines with holy light and incinerates the undead. Let's take it so it may serve a good purpose!

quests.title: Yelough Anix Tunnel — Astel, Stars of Darkness
quests.summary: Defeat Astel in the Yelough Anix Tunnel.
quests.directions: On the far southwest of the region, beyond the Yelough Anix Ruins afflicted by Frenzy, find the entrance to the Yelough Anix Tunnel. Go through to the end and defeat Astel, Stars of Darkness.
quests.goal: On the far southwest, there is a tunnel where a star fell. And not just any star — Astel, Stars of Darkness himself! He is even stronger than the one we faced before. Stay under him, attack the head, and we will prove that even cosmic monsters fall before us!

quests.title: Night's Cavalry x2
quests.summary: Defeat two Night's Cavalry and claim their set.
quests.directions: Find the carriage guarded by two Night's Cavalry (appear at night). Defeat them both.
quests.goal: As soon as night falls, two Night's Cavalry will appear on the road! They guard an old carriage with treasures. This will be a heated battle, but if we defeat both, we will earn their black armour — and look like true guardians of the night!

quests.title: Putrid Avatar at the Minor Erdtree
quests.summary: Defeat the Putrid Avatar and claim the tears.
quests.directions: Approach the Minor Erdtree in the southern part of the region. The battle with the Putrid Avatar will begin. Defeat him.
quests.goal: See that twisted Minor Erdtree? At its roots sits the Putrid Avatar, covered in sores. It spits rot, but inside it holds precious tears for our Flask of Wondrous Physick. Let's fight him and claim these gifts!

quests.title: Ordina Puzzle — Lighting the Torches
quests.summary: Solve the puzzle in the Eternal Prison of Ordina, light 4 torches, and open the portal to the Haligtree.
quests.directions: Enter Ordina. Find the Eternal Prison portal on the western side of the town. Enter it. Inside, light 4 torches on the statues: torch 1 in the town centre, torch 2 on the western tower, torch 3 to the right of the stairs, torch 4 on the roof behind the third torch. Use the Sentry's Torch to see invisible Black Knife Assassins. After lighting all torches, the barrier will vanish, and a portal to the Haligtree will open by the stairs.
quests.goal: Tarnished, we are in Ordina, the town of eternal night! To open the path to the Haligtree, we must enter the Eternal Prison and light four torches on the statues. But be careful: invisible Black Knife Assassins are everywhere! Use our Sentry's Torch to see them. Light all four — and the path to Malenia will open!

quests.title: Black Knife Armour Set
quests.summary: Collect the armour set in the town.
quests.directions: While exploring Ordina, find the Black Knife Armour Set hidden in the town.
quests.goal: As we wander through Ordina, let's find the hidden Black Knife Armour Set. This armour belonged to the very assassins who killed demigods, and it will make us invisible to enemies! Let's search the dark corners and rooftops.

quests.title: Latenna's Quest — Completion
quests.summary: Summon Latenna at the Apostate Derelict and complete her quest.
quests.directions: Follow the frozen river northwest to the end. Enter the 'Apostate Derelict' church. Summon Latenna (if you have her ashes) to complete the quest.
quests.goal: We have reached the Apostate Derelict — an old church where albinaurics live. Here, Latenna, our faithful companion, must complete her journey. We will summon her ashes, and she will find peace, leaving us her final gift.

quests.title: Portal to Moghwyn Palace
quests.summary: Find and activate the portal to Moghwyn Palace.
quests.directions: On the far west of the region, at the portal guarded by Putrid Bears. Defeat the guards and enter the portal to open access to Moghwyn Palace.
quests.goal: To the west, among blood‑stained cliffs, a portal to Moghwyn Palace, home of Mohg, Lord of Blood, is hidden. A great and dangerous battle awaits us there, but we can just open the portal now and return later. Let's activate it, and it will wait for us!

chapters.name: Haligtree
chapters.mainGoal: Traverse the Haligtree from canopy to roots, clear all zones, defeat Loretta and Malenia, complete Millicent's quest.
chapters.summary: From entering the Haligtree to the final battle with Malenia — we will go through the canopy, town, promenade and Elphael, not missing a single item or quest.

locations.summary: The upper part of the tree, full of branches and Oracle Envoys.

locations.name: Haligtree Town
locations.summary: A town on the branches, inhabited by zombies and Misbegotten.

locations.name: Haligtree Town Plaza
locations.summary: The central plaza with rooftops and secret rooms.

locations.summary: The site of the final battle with Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

quests.title: Haligtree Canopy — Path to the Town
quests.summary: Explore the canopy, clear enemies and collect key items.
quests.directions: Activate the 'Haligtree Canopy' grace. Climb the branch on the right — at the end lies a Stonesword Key. Look down, you'll see a branch with Envoys — jump down, kill them, take the Sacramental Bud. Follow the branch to the spot with several Envoys by the cliff, kill them. At the end of the branch, down to the right — another branch with a large Envoy. Jump down, fight it, take the Golden Rune (10) nearby. Return up, jump to the branch below with three Envoys, kill them, take the Prattling Pate 'My Beloved' from the mushrooms. Follow the branch to the junction with the main branch, take Warming Stones x4 from the mushrooms. Climb the central branch, kill giant ants. At the top the branch splits: left thin branch — run, dodging bubbles, kill Envoys, at the right fork — Aeonian Butterfly, at the end — Preserving Boluses by the mushrooms; right branch — kill two Envoys, take Spotted Rowa along the way, left — Smithing Stone (8); central branch — go straight, left — Golden Rune (10), at the end — a large Envoy, kill it, take the Envoy's Crown. Return to where you took Warming Stones, down to the right — a giant Envoy on a high branch, jump to the thin branch below, run dodging bubbles, reach the enemy, kill it — take the Lost Ash of War. Return to the giant Envoy spot, climb higher, kill the group of Envoys, take the Oracle Envoy Ashes. Return along the thin branch — at the end a Golden Rune (13). Jump to the main branch, take the Numen's Rune and Fire Bolts x10. At the end of the branch is a platform with a ladder, descend — you will enter a hut with the 'Haligtree Town' grace.
quests.goal: We are at the top of the sacred tree, Tarnished! The branches stretch into infinity, and below the Envoys' horns sing. We need to walk these slippery paths, grab everything not nailed down — keys, heads, ashes — and find the way down to the town. Hold tight, it's easy to slip here!

quests.title: Haligtree Town — Clearing Zones
quests.summary: Explore the town, clear Misbegotten and zombies, collect all items.
quests.directions: Exit the hut through the back door — you are on the path at the tree's edge. A Misbegotten attacks you. Descend the stairs — two Misbegotten pray, nearby a corpse with a Golden Rune (10). Find the ladder in the corner of the platform, climb up. Above — rotting zombies, kill them and the nearby Misbegotten, take Rot Grease x2. Jump to the adjacent platform with a Leonine Misbegotten, kill it, take the Pearldrake Talisman +2. Return, jump to the branch below, cross to the roof with a crowd of zombies, pass the ladder, at the end another ladder, descend, take Fire Grease x5 on the bridge. Jump down, kill the large plants, climb the southern stairs into the building, kill the axe-wielding Misbegotten, take Heavy Beast Bone x6. Climb the stairs, take Smithing Stone (8). Go out onto the balcony — Golden Rune (13). Descend, climb the northern stairs, backstab the Misbegotten, then kill the Leonine, take the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Exit through the building, left on the balcony — Somber Smithing Stone (8). Cross the bridge to the platform with the 'Haligtree Town Plaza' grace and a Golden Rune (12). Jump down to the ants — take Aeonian Butterflies x4.
quests.goal: We are in the town perched on the branches. Rotting zombies and Misbegotten roam here. But look — an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone glitters on the heights! We need to fight through the hordes and grab this rarest resource, along with the Pearldrake Talisman +2 and everything that shines.

quests.title: Town Plaza — Rooftops and Secrets
quests.summary: Explore the plaza, clear spiritcaller snails and find the shortcut lift.
quests.directions: Jump from the platform onto the rooftops. Below to the right — Smithing Stone (6). On the ledge to the right — a snail summoning a Crystalian. Kill it. Run to the adjacent roof — another snail, kill it too. To the right — a third snail, kill it. Return to the first, jump into the house with zombies, kill them, take Somber Smithing Stone (9). Exit, take Golden Rune (10). Jump to the next large roof, kill all zombies, in the centre — Smithing Stone (6). From the small roof, jump into a room with zombies, kill them, take Golden Rune (12) and in a chest the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2. Climb the stairs to the large roof, from the left edge jump between buildings, enter the building — kill Misbegotten, take Sacramental Bud. In the adjacent building — two more Misbegotten. The room has a door to the bridge and an open window to a branch. Use the branch to reach the first mage, kill him, take Hero's Rune (4). Then kill the second mage, take Smithing Stones (7) and (8). Cross the bridge to the small platform, there is a shortcut lift back to the 'Haligtree Town' grace.
quests.goal: On the plaza, among the rooftops, cunning spiritcaller snails are hiding. They send spirits at us, so let's kill them first! Then search every gap: we'll find the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2 and open the lift that will cut our path back to the grace.

quests.title: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree
quests.summary: Defeat Loretta and open the path to Elphael.
quests.directions: Take the lift back down, enter the large area. At the end — Loretta. Use talismans against magic. She attacks with a halberd and magic: flying swords — back off and dodge; magic bow — run toward her, dodge, land 1–2 hits; halberd combos — dodge through attacks. On the wind‑up with glow — roll away. At ~50% HP she enhances magic. Defeat her and activate the 'Haligtree Promenade' grace.
quests.goal: At the end of the promenade, a familiar figure awaits — Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree! Like in Caria, she fights with magic and a halberd. But we already know her moves! Dodge her phantom blades and bow, strike back, and the path to Elphael will be ours.

quests.title: Secret on the Promenade Roof
quests.summary: Take the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone on the roof before the lift.
quests.directions: After defeating Loretta, do not enter the building with the lift. Go around it, climb the stairs to the roof, take Aeonian Butterflies and the chest with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
quests.goal: Don't rush to jump into the lift! Let's first climb onto the roof of this building — in a chest lies another Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone! It would be a crime to leave it behind, since it will let us make another weapon incredibly strong.

quests.title: Millicent — Final Stage
quests.summary: Talk to Millicent in the Prayer Room and advance her quest.
quests.directions: Take the lift in the building — it will carry you down to Elphael. Walk down the corridor to the 'Prayer Room' grace. Speak to Millicent, exhaust her dialogue.
quests.goal: In Elphael, in the quiet Prayer Room, Millicent awaits us. She looks so pale and tired, but her eyes burn with determination. Let's talk to her — her story is drawing to a close, and we need to be by her side.

quests.title: Millicent's Finale — A Choice of Fate
quests.summary: Help Millicent against her sisters or fight her.
quests.directions: Go to the Drainage Channel. Defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit. Then activate the golden summon sign (help Millicent). Help her defeat her sisters, talk to her by the toxic lake, then take Miquella's Needle.
quests.goal: The decisive moment, Tarnished! First, kill the loathsome tree spirit guarding the lake. And then... you will see two signs. Please, choose the golden one! Let's help Millicent defeat her cruel sisters. She will find peace, and we will gain Miquella's Needle — a thing capable of countering the Frenzied Flame itself!

quests.title: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
quests.summary: Defeat Malenia and obtain her Great Rune and Remembrance.
quests.directions: From the Drainage Channel, go to the Haligtree roots, enter the mist wall. Use light load for mobility, bleed weapons. In phase one, dodge Waterfowl Dance (roll back from the first wave, sideways from the rest). In phase two, avoid scarlet rot, attack after combos. After victory, claim the rewards.
quests.goal: Here she is, Tarnished. Malenia, Blade of Miquella, who has never known defeat. She is beautiful as a dream and deadly as a thousand blades. Her Waterfowl Dance tears the air, and in phase two she will become the Goddess of Rot. Dodge, be patient, use bleed. We've come all this way, and we will win!

acts.name: Farum Azula and the Ashen Capital
acts.summary: Farum Azula — a crumbling city in the sky, where time flows differently. Here dwell ancient dragons and beastmen, and at its centre is Maliketh, the Black Blade — guardian of the Rune of Death. We must traverse this place to complete our journey.
acts.lore: Farum Azula is a place outside of time, where the remains of great dragons rest among the clouds. Here lie secrets that could change the course of history. We must fight Maliketh to free the Rune of Death and complete our mission.

chapters.name: Farum Azula
chapters.mainGoal: Clear Farum Azula, clear all zones, complete Alexander and Bernahl's quests, defeat optional Placidusax and mandatory Maliketh, open the path to the Ashen Capital.
chapters.summary: From entering Farum Azula to defeating Maliketh — we will go through all key points, not missing a single item or quest.

locations.summary: The first grace after teleporting to Farum Azula.

locations.name: Crumbling Beast Grave Depths
locations.summary: The second grace, near an Ash of War.

locations.name: Dragon Temple
locations.summary: Grace before the Godskin Duo boss.

locations.name: Dragon Temple Altar
locations.summary: Grace after the Godskin Duo, leading to Alexander and Bernahl.

locations.summary: Grace before Maliketh.

locations.name: Placidusax's Arena
locations.summary: A hidden arena where the Dragonlord dwells.

locations.name: Maliketh's Arena
locations.summary: The site of the battle with Maliketh, the Black Blade.

quests.title: Entering Farum Azula
quests.summary: Arrive in Farum Azula after burning the Erdtree and activate the first grace.
quests.directions: Here we are, Tarnished! Right in the storm, in the crumbling city of dragons. As soon as you come to your senses, light the grace — it will be our anchor in this chaos. In the meantime, look around: nearby lie a gleaming Smithing Stone [8] and a Golden Rune. Don't forget to pick them up before the wind blows us away!
quests.goal: Activate the grace and collect nearby items.

quests.title: Beast Grave — Clearing and Ash of War
quests.summary: Clear the rooms, kill the Beastmen, and activate the second grace.
quests.directions: Beastmen lurk in these dark corridors. Let's creep quietly, like mice, and take them out one by one. First, check the room on the right from the entrance — there are Gravity Stones there. Then carefully walk down the main corridor, killing the guards. At the end of the tunnel, behind the chest, you'll find the second grace and the Ash of War 'Beast's Roar'. Watch out for floor traps — some tiles collapse!
quests.goal: Clear the grave, collect all items, and activate the grace.

quests.title: Path Past the Ancient Dragon
quests.summary: Run past the dragon to the building and activate the grace.
quests.directions: A huge Ancient Dragon lies ahead! It's raining fire and lightning, but we don't have to fight it. As soon as you exit the grave, immediately run left, to the ruined building. Dodge the lightning bolts striking the ground, and don't stop — the dragon hits right over the plaza. Reach the building's doors and light the grace inside. There we are safe.
quests.goal: Reach the building and activate the grace without engaging the dragon.

quests.title: Godskin Duo
quests.summary: Defeat the Godskin Apostle and Noble using Sleep Pots.
quests.directions: Before us are two fat men in skin — the Apostle and the Noble! They are very angry, but desperately want to sleep. Approach the mist wall, prepare Sleep Pots (if you have them), and enter. Immediately throw a pot at one to make it sleep, and focus on the other. If you see a golden summon sign for Bernahl — don't be shy, call for help! After victory, light the grace at the altar.
quests.goal: Defeat the duo boss and open the passage onward.

quests.title: Alexander's Quest — Finale
quests.summary: Find Alexander and fight him for the 'Alexander's Shard'.
quests.directions: Look, there, beyond the mist wall we will open with a Stonesword Key, our old friend Alexander awaits! From the 'Altar' grace, go left, there will be a door requiring a key (you should have it from the quest in Liurnia). Open it and enter the arena. Alexander waits — he wants one last honourable fight with us. Accept the challenge, fight him, and claim his shard.
quests.goal: Defeat Alexander and obtain his talisman.

quests.title: Bernahl the Recusant's Invasion
quests.summary: Find and defeat Bernahl, obtain the Blasphemous Claw and other rewards.
quests.directions: Now a sad meeting awaits us. From the 'Altar' grace, go right and descend the stairs to the lower bridge. There, on the platform, you will see a red invasion sign — this is Bernahl. Activate it and fight him. He has become an enemy, so show no mercy. After victory, be sure to check the tower to the right of the bridge — in a chest lies the Old Lord's Talisman, which extends our spell durations.
quests.goal: Defeat Bernahl and collect all rewards from him and the tower.

quests.title: Dragonlord Placidusax
quests.summary: Defeat the optional boss Placidusax and use Miquella's Needle (if needed).
quests.directions: In this strange place, outside time, the Dragonlord Placidusax sleeps! To reach him, from the 'Altar' grace descend the stairs, then walk along the cliff edge until you find a lying coffin. Lie down in it — and you will be transported to the arena. There, in the centre, the Lord himself awaits. Our Blasphemous Claw will help parry his attacks. And remember, Tarnished: only here, on this arena, can you use Miquella's Needle to remove the Frenzied Flame curse, if you accepted it. This is your chance to cleanse yourself!
quests.goal: Defeat Placidusax and, if necessary, use Miquella's Needle.

quests.title: Path to Maliketh
quests.summary: Activate the 'Beside the Great Bridge' grace and prepare for the final fight.
quests.directions: We are almost at our goal! From the Altar, descend, climb the other stairs to the large statue with an imp. Behind the statue is a passage — go through it and step onto the bridge. Walk to the end of the bridge, and on the right you will see the 'Beside the Great Bridge' grace. Activate it, Tarnished, and let's check if we're ready: flasks full, weapons gleaming? Ahead lies Maliketh, and this battle will be legendary.
quests.goal: Reach the last grace before Maliketh and prepare.

quests.title: Maliketh, the Black Blade
quests.summary: Defeat Maliketh and free the Rune of Death.
quests.directions: Here he is, Tarnished! Maliketh, the Black Blade, guardian of the Rune of Death. He awaits us in the great circular hall. Climb the stairs from the grace and enter the mist. He is fast as lightning, and his attacks carry true death. Dodge his strikes, use the Blasphemous Claw to parry, and remember: in the second phase he becomes even fiercer. After victory, the world will change, and we can move toward the finale. This is the last fight in Farum Azula — give it everything we have!
quests.goal: Defeat Maliketh and free the Rune of Death.

chapters.name: Ashen Capital and the Ending
chapters.mainGoal: Traverse the final stretch in the Ashen Capital, collect the last legendary items, defeat the final bosses, and choose one of six endings.
chapters.summary: From awakening in the Ashen Capital to choosing the ending — we will take the final steps, not missing a single item or quest.

quests.title: Awakening in the Ashen Capital
quests.summary: Wake up in the ruined capital and activate the grace.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we have woken up... Look, Leyndell lies in ashes, like a sleeping giant. All around is silence and the smell of smoke. Let's light our first grace in this new, terrifying world, so it shines like a candle of hope among the ruins. Approach the glowing spot on the rise and activate it.
quests.goal: Activate the grace and take a look around.

quests.title: Crimson Amber Medallion +2
quests.summary: Find the talisman in the sewer.
quests.directions: Let's peek into the old sewer — right under the ash, in the darkness, a wonderful Crimson Amber Medallion +2 is hidden. From the grace, descend the stairs to the west, find the entrance to the dungeon. Drop down onto the beam below, and it will be ours — lying on a corpse. Beware of rats and poison gas, they are everywhere.
quests.goal: Collect the Crimson Amber Medallion +2 from the old sewer.

quests.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
quests.summary: Take the stone at the entrance to the former Roundtable Hold.
quests.directions: See that huge dead dragon? Climb up its leg to the walls, and at the entrance to what remains of our Roundtable Hold, the rarest Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone lies. Grab it quickly — a mean Gargoyle prowls nearby! It might attack, so be ready.
quests.goal: Take the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from the dragon corpse.

quests.title: Erdtree's Favor +2
quests.summary: Defeat two Tree Spirits and claim the legendary talisman.
quests.directions: We need to return to the Forbidden Lands and take the lift up to the surviving part of the capital. There, by a charred root, lies the legendary 'Erdtree's Favor +2'. But it is guarded by two vile Ulcerated Tree Spirits! Fight them — they spit poison and strike with roots, but we are stronger. After victory, take the talisman, which gleams gold.
quests.goal: Defeat two Ulcerated Tree Spirits and take 'Erdtree's Favor +2'.

quests.title: Completing Corhyn and Goldmask's Quest
quests.summary: Take the Rune of Perfect Order and the armour.
quests.directions: Let's find Goldmask — she lies at rest by the roots, with Corhyn mourning nearby. Approach the body and take the Rune of Perfect Order and her armour. This will complete their long journey and give us the chance to choose order for this world. There are no enemies here, but the moment is very solemn.
quests.goal: Take the Rune of Perfect Order and the armour from Goldmask's body.

quests.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All‑Knowing
quests.summary: Defeat Gideon and open the path to Godfrey.
quests.directions: An old friend has become an enemy! Gideon, the All‑Knowing, has blocked our path in the Sanctuary. Go to the centre of the capital, enter the large building — there is the mist wall. He will shower us with all the incantations we collected for him! Don't let him speak, attack relentlessly, use pillars as cover. Let's show him that knowledge isn't everything! After victory, the path to Godfrey will open.
quests.goal: Defeat Gideon Ofnir in the Erdtree Sanctuary.

quests.title: Godfrey, the First Elden Lord
quests.summary: Defeat Godfrey and Hoarah Loux.
quests.directions: Here he is, Tarnished! The First Elden Lord, Godfrey, has returned to reclaim his throne. After Gideon, go down the corridor and climb onto the arena where Morgott once was. He has his loyal lion Serosh, but in the second phase he will kill it and become Hoarah Loux, the wild warrior. Dodge his mighty grabs and stomps, summon our spirits — and we will show who is now worthy of the crown!
quests.goal: Defeat Godfrey and his second phase — Hoarah Loux.

quests.title: Radagon of the Golden Order and the Elden Beast
quests.summary: Defeat Radagon and the Elden Beast.
quests.directions: Inside the Tree, a god himself awaits — Radagon, and behind him — the Elden Beast, the embodiment of the Greater Will! After Godfrey, head to the glowing entrance to the Erdtree and enter. Radagon strikes with a holy hammer, but he is weak to fire. And when the cosmic beast appears, hide from its fire breath and strike its golden belly. This is our last fight, and we will emerge victorious!
quests.goal: Defeat Radagon and the Elden Beast inside the Erdtree.

quests.title: Choosing the Ending
quests.summary: Choose one of six endings.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we stand at the remains of Marika. Everything is decided here. After defeating the Beast, walk forward to the giant head of the goddess. Look back on our journey: we can simply repair the Ring, we can grant it Order, Curse, Despair, leave for the stars with Ranni, or burn everything to the ground. Listen to your heart and make your choice. I will be by your side, whatever you choose.
quests.goal: Make the final choice at Marika's remains.

acts.name: Realm of Shadow (Shadow of the Erdtree)
acts.summary: We have stepped into the Realm of Shadow — a world hidden behind a veil, where time flows differently. Here new enemies, ancient secrets, and Miquella himself await us. The first chapter — Gravesite Plain — will become our foothold.
acts.lore: The Realm of Shadow is where Miquella tried to create his own order, free from the influence of Outer Gods. Everything here is saturated with his will, but the dangers here are also incomparably greater. We must get our bearings and gather our strength before going further.

chapters.name: Gravesite Plain
chapters.mainGoal: Get your bearings in the Realm of Shadow: collect the region map, Scadutree Fragments and Revered Spirit Ashes, meet all key NPCs, clear early locations, defeat optional bosses, and prepare for the first legacy dungeon — Belurat Tower.
chapters.summary: From entering the DLC to the threshold of Belurat — we will go through ruins, temples, villages and mausoleums, gathering everything that will help us in this new world.

locations.summary: The first grace after entering the DLC, at the cave exit.

quests.title: Entering the Realm of Shadow
quests.summary: Enter the DLC and activate the first grace.
quests.directions: Tarnished! We're here! Remember how we defeated Radahn and Mohg? Now their power has opened the way for us. Walk out of the cave into the light — and immediately light the grace, it will be our anchor in this new, strange world. Just don't yawn — this world is dangerous, but we'll manage!
quests.goal: Activate the 'Gravesite Plain' grace.

quests.title: Gravesite Plain Map
quests.summary: Find the region map in the Scorched Ruins, avoiding the Cursed Ascetic.
quests.directions: Look, Tarnished! Over there, among the debris, stands a stele with a map. But be careful — a Cursed Ascetic lurks on the arch above it, leaping and spinning chakrams like a madman. If you don't want to fight, dash past, grab the map, and run! If you choose to fight, remember he is very fast but vulnerable to backstabs.
quests.goal: Take the Map: Gravesite Plain from the stone stele.

quests.title: Scorched Ruins — Item Collection
quests.summary: Search the ruins and collect valuable items.
quests.directions: While we are here, let's search the ruins. To the southeast, by a corpse, lies a Heavy Cracked Pot — it will come in handy for throwing projectiles. Nearby, on the steps, find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook — it will teach us to make new pots. And on the roof of the right‑hand debris lies the Dagger of Mercy talisman — it increases damage after a critical hit. And don't forget to activate the grace on the north side — it will be our base in this area.
quests.goal: Find the Heavy Cracked Pot, the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1], the Dagger of Mercy, and activate the grace.

quests.title: Church of Consolation — Black Knight and Fragments
quests.summary: Defeat the Black Knight and take two Scadutree Fragments.
quests.directions: Inside the church, a Black Knight with a huge hammer awaits us. He is strong and strikes with holy magic, but he has a weakness — he is clumsy and his attacks can be parried. Use a spirit summon to distract him, and strike with lightning — it stings him like a wasp. When he falls, approach the altar — there lie two Scadutree Fragments. This is our main prize!
quests.goal: Defeat the Black Knight, obtain the Black Steel Greatshield and two Scadutree Fragments.

quests.title: Three‑Path Cross — Meeting NPCs
quests.summary: Activate the grace, talk to Freyja and Hornsent, receive the map with crosses and a Fragment.
quests.directions: Approach the grace at the crossroads — Redmane Knight Freyja and Hornsent stand here. Talk to them several times, they will tell you about Miquella. Hornsent will give you the Map with Crosses — it marks all of Miquella's Crosses, a very useful item. And don't forget to pick up the Scadutree Fragment lying right at the feet of the grace.
quests.goal: Exhaust dialogues with both NPCs and take the Fragment at the grace.

quests.title: Abandoned Ailing Village — Revered Spirit Ash
quests.summary: Find the Revered Spirit Ash in the village.
quests.directions: From the Three‑Path Cross, head northwest towards the village. There, on top of the hill, you will find ruined houses. Walk past the tents, and in the central square lies a Revered Spirit Ash — it will strengthen your summoned spirits in this world. Just beware of shadows, they hide in the houses.
quests.goal: Take the Revered Spirit Ash from the village's central square.

quests.title: Main Gate Cross — Ansbach and Moore
quests.summary: Talk to Ansbach and Moore, take the Scadutree Fragment.
quests.directions: Approach the gates of Belurat — there, by the grace, stand Sir Ansbach and Moore. Talk to each of them until they start repeating themselves. You can buy something useful from Moore, then talk again — this will advance his quest. And don't forget to pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to the grace.
quests.goal: Exhaust dialogues with both NPCs and take the Fragment at the grace.

quests.title: Plateau — Second Revered Spirit Ash
quests.summary: Find the plateau and take the Revered Spirit Ash by the pond.
quests.directions: From the Main Gate Cross, turn southwest along the ledge. Walk along the stone path until you reach the plateau with a grace. Light it immediately, then go to the pond to the southeast — there, by the water, lies another Revered Spirit Ash. Don't fall off the cliff!
quests.goal: Activate the 'Cliffroad Terminus' grace and take the Ash.

quests.title: Blessed Blue Dew Talisman
quests.summary: Find the church above the starting point and take the talisman.
quests.directions: Remember the cave we came from? Above it, on the cliff, stands a small church. Climb up there — enter inside, and on the altar you will find the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman. It slowly restores magical energy, a very useful item!
quests.goal: Take the talisman from the altar.

quests.title: Western Nameless Mausoleum — Lonely Knight
quests.summary: Defeat the optional boss and obtain his set and weapon.
quests.directions: To the northwest of the first grace, past the dead trees, stands a mausoleum. Inside, the Lonely Knight awaits — a white shade with a sword and a crossbow that fires fire. He is very dangerous, but he has a weakness: he can be parried, and he is vulnerable to lightning. Summon spirits to distract him, and strike while dodging his shots. If you win, you will get one of the best armour sets in the game and 70,000 runes! This trial is not for the weak, but the reward is worth it.
quests.goal: Defeat the Lonely Knight, obtain the Solitude Set and the Great Sword of Solitude.

quests.title: Additional Fragments and Ashes (optional)
quests.summary: Collect the remaining Scadutree Fragments from Potentates and the third Revered Spirit Ash.
quests.directions: In Gravesite Plain, there are two Potentates — one east of the Scorched Ruins, another southwest of the Main Gate Cross. If you use Rejection or a strong push on them, they will kneel and vanish, leaving a Scadutree Fragment. Also, on the eastern cliff opposite the Church of Consolation, by the waterfall, on an altar lies the third Revered Spirit Ash. Collect everything you missed — it will help before entering Belurat.
quests.goal: Find and collect all remaining resources in the region.

quests.title: Preparation for Belurat Tower
quests.summary: Check all dialogues, ensure you have resources, and move to the next chapter.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we are almost ready to enter Belurat Tower. But first, let's check: you should have at least 4 Scadutree Fragments and 3 Revered Spirit Ashes. If not — go back and collect everything we missed. Also, talk to Freyja, Hornsent, Ansbach and Moore one more time — their dialogues must be fully exhausted. Only then can we move on. Remember: Belurat will be tough, but we'll manage!
quests.goal: Make sure you have at least 4 Fragments and 3 Spirit Ashes, and all NPC dialogues are exhausted.

chapters.name: Belurat, Tower Settlement

quests.title: Entering Belurat and First Clear
quests.summary: Enter Belurat, clear the scorpion room, and take the Revered Spirit Ash.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we are at Belurat's gates! Open these heavy doors and be ready — huge spider-like scorpions await us inside. They're not as scary as crabs, but they still bite hard. Use a jumping attack to stagger the first one — and don't let it recover. Behind the first scorpion is a room with an altar — there lies a Revered Spirit Ash, take it. Then climb the stairs, kill another scorpion, and exit to the plaza. There, activate the grace.
quests.goal: Reach the 'Belurat Tower Settlement' grace.

quests.title: Path to the Small Private Altar
quests.summary: Cross the plaza with the fountain and activate the 'Small Private Altar' grace.
quests.directions: From the plaza with the fountain, go straight across the bridge to the east. There are Wraiths roaming there — they are weak, so a couple of hits will suffice. At the end of the bridge, enter the doorway on the left and climb the stairs — there is the 'Small Private Altar' grace. Light it to secure your position.
quests.goal: Reach the 'Small Private Altar' grace.

quests.title: Fire Knight Quelign's Invasion
quests.summary: Survive Quelign's invasion on the main plaza and obtain the 'Crossed‑Tree Talisman'.
quests.directions: Exit the room with the grace and turn right. Beware of the Hornsent Warrior — he patrols the area. Walk through the debris onto the main plaza — and then! Fire Knight Quelign will attack us. He is fast and dangerous, but he has a weakness to physical attacks. Defeat him — after victory you will get the 'Crossed‑Tree Talisman', a very useful trinket. If you miss it now, you'll lose the reward forever!
quests.goal: Defeat Quelign in the first invasion.

quests.title: Ash of War: Wailing Skull
quests.summary: Take the Ash of War on the main plaza.
quests.directions: While we're on the main plaza, don't miss the moment — in the centre, behind the altar, lies the Ash of War 'Wailing Skull'. It's very powerful, especially against enemies with low health. Walk up and take it.
quests.goal: Take the Ash of War from the altar.

quests.title: Storeroom Key
quests.summary: Find the Storeroom Key on the rooftops.
quests.directions: Return to the entrance of the main plaza and take the path along the debris to the right, onto the rooftops. Go through the small passage, descend into the sewer, turn left, then into the room on the right, climb the stairs — on a corpse lies the Storeroom Key. This key will open the door to Hornsent Grandam, so don't lose it!
quests.goal: Take the Storeroom Key.

quests.title: Well Depths Key
quests.summary: Find the Well Depths Key.
quests.directions: From the Storeroom Key room, enter the doorway, turn left and jump onto the ledge. Jump onto the small bridge and enter the room on the right — on a corpse lies the Well Depths Key. It will open the path to the dungeons where the Ulcerated Tree Spirit hides.
quests.goal: Take the Well Depths Key.

quests.title: Belurat Gaol — Ulcerated Tree Spirit
quests.summary: Defeat the optional boss in the dungeons.
quests.directions: Descend into the dungeons using the Well Depths Key. There, in the darkness, the Ulcerated Tree Spirit awaits you. It is very aggressive, using poison attacks and grabs. Try to stay at its sides, not in front of its mouth. Summon spirits to distract it. After victory, you will get the 'Immunizing Horn Charm +2' — it boosts your resistance to poison and bleed.
quests.goal: Defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit and obtain the 'Immunizing Horn Charm +2'.

quests.title: Path to the Boss — 'Stagefront' Grace
quests.summary: Reach the 'Stagefront' grace before the final boss.
quests.directions: Return to the Small Private Altar and head east. Go through the building where the Hornsent Warrior hides — it's better to bypass him or kill him from a distance. Then descend the stairs and at the end of the path activate the 'Stagefront' grace. This is the last stop before the fight with the Dancing Lion. At the entrance to the arena, you will be able to summon Freyja — her golden sign will be waiting.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Stagefront' grace.

quests.title: Divine Beast Dancing Lion
quests.summary: Defeat the final boss of Belurat.
quests.directions: Enter the mist wall — there, among ancient stones, the Dancing Lion awaits. It is very fast, so choose speed over power. Attack it from the side or hit its tail, dodge its jaws and spins. Use Freyja's summon — she will help distract it. Land 2–3 hits after its combo attacks. When it falls, you will get the 'Divine Beast Head' — a quest item, and the 'Remembrance of the Dancing Lion'. Don't forget to activate the 'Theatre of the Divine Beast' grace.
quests.goal: Defeat the Dancing Lion, obtain the Divine Beast Head and the Remembrance.

quests.title: Hornsent Grandam and Hornsent's Quest
quests.summary: Give the Divine Beast Head to Hornsent Grandam and speak to Hornsent.
quests.directions: Immediately after the boss, open the door on the second floor with the Storeroom Key. Enter Hornsent Grandam's room — she is waiting for you. Give her the Divine Beast Head, and she will give you the incantation 'Watchful Spirit'. Then return to Hornsent at the 'Three‑Path Cross' and exhaust his new dialogue. This is very important — if you don't do it now, she may disappear, and you will lose the incantation forever!
quests.goal: Obtain the incantation 'Watchful Spirit' and advance Hornsent's quest.

quests.title: Checking NPC Quests
quests.summary: Exhaust all dialogues with Ansbach and Moore before leaving.
quests.directions: Before leaving Belurat, return to the Main Gate Cross and talk to Ansbach and Moore again. They may have new lines after we defeated the Dancing Lion. Exhaust all dialogues — this is important for their future quests.
quests.goal: Ensure all dialogues are exhausted.

chapters.name: Castle Ensis
chapters.mainGoal: Clear Castle Ensis: clear all floors, collect the Milady weapon, Rellana's Cameo talisman, Wing Stance Ash of War, Imbued Sword Key, defeat the mini-boss Moonrithyll and the main boss Rellana, open the path to Scadu Altus.
chapters.summary: From approaching the castle to defeating Rellana — we will go through walls, towers, rooftops and halls, not missing a single item or quest.
