quests.title: Crossing Ellac Greatbridge and the Camp
quests.summary: Cross the bridge, avoid the ballista, clear the camp, collect items, and activate the 'Castle Front' grace.
quests.directions: Tarnished, ahead is Ellac Greatbridge! A ballista is shooting at us like crazy, so run in zigzags like a hare. On the other side — Messmer's soldiers' camp. In the tents, valuable items are hidden: on the right, in the eastern tent, lies a Firespark Perfume Bottle, and on the left, in the western tent — Fire Knight's Cookbook (2). And don't miss the headless statue to the right of the road — there lies a Scadutree Fragment. After that, activate the 'Castle Front' grace.
quests.goal: Reach the 'Castle Front' grace and collect loot in the camp.

quests.title: Troll Knight — Gate Guardian
quests.summary: Defeat the Troll Knight at the castle entrance.
quests.directions: Before us is a huge Troll Knight! His mace shatters rocks, but he has a weakness: his legs! Attack them to trip him, and when he falls — drive your blade into his head. After victory, you will get a Somber Smithing Stone [9] — it will come in very handy for upgrading weapons!
quests.goal: Defeat the boss and obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [9].

quests.title: Milady Weapon in the Tower
quests.summary: Find and retrieve the new Milady weapon in the tower on the wall.
quests.directions: Enter the castle, turn left and climb onto the cliff overlooking the waterfall. Then turn left towards the stairs onto the wall. Climb the wall, then the stairs in the far corner to the tower — at the top, a chest with the new weapon Milady awaits! This is a light greatsword — very fast and stylish. It will definitely come in handy against Rellana!
quests.goal: Reach the tower and open the chest with Milady.

quests.title: Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Loyal Knight's Cookbook
quests.summary: Reach the checkpoint, defeat the Lesser Black Knight, take the cookbook and the Fragment.
quests.directions: Descend from the tower and follow the path through the cave. There will be another soldier and a dog — kill them. Exit into the clearing, where a Lesser Black Knight with a club will meet you. He is dangerous, but he has openings after his swings. Wait for him to miss, then strike. To the left of the path there is a tower — inside a chest with the Loyal Knight's Cookbook. Then continue climbing to Miquella's Cross and the 'Castle Ensis Checkpoint' grace. Nearby lies a Scadutree Fragment and Leda's letter.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Castle Ensis Checkpoint' grace and collect items.

quests.title: Opening the Main Gate
quests.summary: Descend into the ravine, go through the cave with dogs, and activate the lever to open the gate.
quests.directions: The main gate next to the checkpoint is closed. We need to open it. Go south from the checkpoint to the soldier by the cliff — kill him, drop onto the ledge, then into the hole in the ground. In the cave will be three angry dogs — kill them one by one. Exit the cave, follow the main path along the waterfall, jumping over gaps. Climb to the top of the waterfall via the rocks, go through the cave behind the waterfall, then climb the stairs on the right and cross the bridge into the building — inside is the lever. Pull it — the gate will open!
quests.goal: Reach the lever and open the main gate.

quests.title: Moonrithyll, Carian Knight
quests.summary: Defeat the mini-boss Moonrithyll, obtain his sword, and open the path to the church.
quests.directions: Now that the gate is open, climb the stairs beyond it and cross the bridge. At the hilltop, be careful — there are teleporting sorcerers. Deal with them, then climb the stairs — there Moonrithyll, Carian Knight, will meet you. He uses magical blades and a two‑handed sword, but he is vulnerable to bleed and heavy weapons that stagger him. Parry his attacks or simply roll — and strike back. After victory, you will get his sword and can proceed to the church.
quests.goal: Defeat Moonrithyll and obtain Moonrithyll's Knight Sword.

quests.title: Rellana's Cameo and Wolf Crest Shield
quests.summary: Take the talisman and shield in the church beyond Moonrithyll's arena.
quests.directions: Enter the church behind the arena. At the altar, on the pedestal, lies the Rellana's Cameo talisman — it enhances your stance attacks. In the room on the right, in a chest, lies the Wolf Crest Shield — beautiful and sturdy. Take it all!
quests.goal: Collect Rellana's Cameo and the Wolf Crest Shield.

quests.title: Castle Rooftops — Glintblade Trio and Stones
quests.summary: Explore the rooftops, take the sorcery and smithing stones.
quests.directions: Exit the church through the right door, go through the corridor with sorcerers and exit onto the walls. Go through the gate, drop onto the ledge on the left — there is a Dewgem. Then climb the stairs onto the roof. At the top, a Page will meet you — kill him. On the opposite side of the roof lies a Somber Smithing Stone [2]. Drop onto the platform below — there you will find the Glintblade Trio sorcery. Great magic!
quests.goal: Find the Glintblade Trio sorcery and a Somber Smithing Stone [2].

quests.title: Imbued Sword Key and Wing Stance Ash of War
quests.summary: Return to the tower, take the Imbued Sword Key, then find Wing Stance beyond the Lord's Chamber balcony.
quests.directions: Return to the stairs with the knights and dogs (near Moonrithyll's arena). Climb the stairs around the tower — at the top, a spearman awaits. Inside the tower, in a chest, lies the Imbued Sword Key — it will come in handy later for hidden zones. Then exit the tower, take the lift up to the Lord's Chamber. On the balcony at the 'Castle Lord's Chamber' grace, find a Somber Smithing Stone [4], then drop from the balcony onto the ledges below. Enter the tower, climb the stairs to the top — there in a chest lies the Wing Stance Ash of War! This is the perfect ash for Milady.
quests.goal: Obtain the Imbued Sword Key and the Wing Stance Ash of War.

quests.title: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
quests.summary: Defeat the castle's main boss — Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight.
quests.directions: Take the lift from the Lord's Chamber and enter the mist wall. Rellana is very fast and wields two swords — magic and fire. In the first phase, dodge her combos, and when she summons magical blades — roll to the side. In the second phase, at 50% health, she charges her swords with magic and fire — dodge the fire tornadoes and twin moons. Use Milady with Wing Stance — attack from stance when she opens up. Be patient. After victory, you will obtain the Remembrance and 240,000 runes.
quests.goal: Defeat Rellana, obtain the Remembrance, and open the path to Scadu Altus.

quests.title: Exit to Scadu Altus and a Warning
quests.summary: Activate the grace, collect additional items, and remember an important warning.
quests.directions: Exit the arena through the back — you will find yourself on a plateau with a grace. Activate it — this is 'Ensis Moongazing Grounds'. Right at the exit behind the grace lies a Monk's Missive, and in the small tower on the right — a Shadow Rune [2]. And now, Tarnished, listen very carefully: DO NOT APPROACH the Shadow Keep in Scadu Altus until you have exhausted all dialogues with Leda, Freyja, Hornsent, Ansbach, and Moore. As soon as you approach the Keep, their quests will automatically advance, and you may lose important stages. So first talk to everyone, and only then head to the Keep!
quests.goal: Activate the 'Ensis Moongazing Grounds' grace and prepare for the next area.

chapters.name: Scadu Altus
chapters.mainGoal: Explore Scadu Altus: find the region map, meet all key NPCs (Leda, Hornsent, Freyja, Ansbach, Moore, Dane, Count Ymir), collect 11 Scadutree Fragments, clear dungeons and forts, defeat the optional boss Metyr, and prepare for the Shadow Keep.
chapters.summary: From exiting Castle Ensis to entering the Shadow Keep — we will go through the entire plateau, not missing a single quest or item.

locations.name: Scadu Altus Map Stele

locations.name: Church of the Crusade
locations.summary: A church on the hill, where Quelign's second invasion occurs and two Fragments lie.

locations.name: Ruined Forge of Starfall
locations.summary: A dungeon southwest of Moorth Ruins, where a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone lies.

locations.name: Shadow Keep Entrance
locations.summary: The main entrance to the Shadow Keep, a lift.

quests.title: Entering Scadu Altus — Meeting Leda and Hornsent
quests.summary: Activate the grace, talk to Leda and Hornsent, receive the updated cross map and a gesture.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we have entered Scadu Altus! Look, Leda stands ahead, and beside her — Hornsent. Approach them, speak — they are waiting for us. Leda will tell us of her plans, and Hornsent will give you the 'Updated Cross Map', which marks all of Miquella's Crosses in this region. And don't forget to pick up the Scadutree Fragment lying right at the grace. On the ruined wall to the right of the road lies the gesture 'May the Best Win' — it will come in very handy!
quests.goal: Activate the 'Highroad Cross' grace and exhaust dialogues with NPCs.

quests.title: Scadu Altus Map and Second Fragment
quests.summary: Find the region map at the stone stele.
quests.directions: Let's continue north along the main road, Tarnished. At the fork, by the stone stele, lies the Scadu Altus map — take it so you can see all the paths. And while we're here, look at the statue of Marika to the right of the road — at its foot lies another Scadutree Fragment. Don't miss it!
quests.goal: Take the Map: Scadu Altus and the Fragment at the statue.

quests.title: Church of the Crusade — Quelign's Second Invasion
quests.summary: Survive the second invasion of Fire Knight Quelign, obtain the Prayer Room Key and Ash of War: Fire Serpent, as well as two Fragments.
quests.directions: Turn west, up the hill to the church. Inside, Quelign awaits us again! He has grown stronger and uses a fire spear, but we haven't stood still either. Keep your distance and strike when he opens up. After victory, you will get the 'Prayer Room Key' — it will unlock hidden zones in the Shadow Keep, and the 'Ash of War: Fire Serpent'. And don't forget to take the two Scadutree Fragments lying at the altar!
quests.goal: Defeat Quelign in the second invasion.

quests.title: Moorth Ruins — Duel with Dryleaf Dane
quests.summary: Defeat Dryleaf Dane using the gesture 'May the Best Win', obtain his weapon and hat.
quests.directions: Now let's head east, to Moorth Ruins. At the grace stands Dryleaf Dane — a warrior who respects only strength. Use the gesture 'May the Best Win' before him — this will trigger a duel. He is very fast and fights with his fists, but he has a weakness: he dislikes being attacked from range. Try using magic or a bow. After victory, you will get his 'Dryleaf Arts' — a new weapon, and his hat. Don't miss the two Fragments lying here: one at the headless statue to the west, the second right at the grace.
quests.goal: Defeat Dane in an honourable duel.

quests.title: Ruined Forge of Starfall
quests.summary: Clear the dungeon and take the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
quests.directions: To the southwest of Moorth Ruins is a dungeon — the Ruined Forge of Starfall. Enemies roam inside, but at the end, a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone awaits us — it's needed to upgrade unique weapons. Be careful with falling meteorites; they can kill in one hit.
quests.goal: Reach the end of the forge and obtain the stone.

quests.title: Fort of Reprimand — Black Knight Edredd
quests.summary: Defeat Black Knight Edredd and obtain the Black Steel Greatshield.
quests.directions: Head south to the Fort of Reprimand. Inside, at the end, Black Knight Edredd awaits us with a massive shield and hammer. He is slow, but his attacks are devastating. Use lightning‑fast attacks and circle to his side. After victory, you will get his shield — one of the best in the game!
quests.goal: Defeat Edredd in the fort.

quests.title: Bonny Village — Path to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr
quests.summary: Cross Bonny Village and reach the Cathedral.
quests.directions: From Moorth Ruins, head east under the large arch. Find a hidden hole in the ground between buildings — this is the entrance to the ravine. Descend the ledges until you see wooden bridges — that is Bonny Village. Potentates roam here — you can kill them for valuable items. Cross the bridges east, then head north through the forest with wolves, circling the Furnace Golem, and you will reach the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.
quests.goal: Traverse the village and reach the cathedral.

quests.title: Count Ymir's Quest — Beginning
quests.summary: Meet Count Ymir at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and start his questline.
quests.directions: Enter the cathedral. On the throne sits Count Ymir — old and wise. Talk to him; he will give you the 'Hole‑Necked Necklace' and the 'Ruins Map'. This is the start of a long quest that will lead us to three Finger Ruins. Nearby stands the Swordhand of Night Jolán — talk to her too.
quests.goal: Talk to Ymir and obtain the Hole‑Necked Necklace and the Ruins Map.

quests.title: Metyr, Mother of Fingers (optional)
quests.summary: Defeat the optional boss Metyr in the Finger Ruins of Miyr.
quests.directions: Beneath Count Ymir's throne is a secret passage down. Descend the stairs — you will reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr, where Metyr, Mother of Fingers, dwells. This is one of the toughest bosses in the DLC — she uses magic that distorts space. Dodge her rays and finger attacks, and strike when she opens up. After victory, you will get the 'Remembrance of Metyr, Mother of Fingers'.
quests.goal: Defeat Metyr and obtain her Remembrance.

quests.title: Preparation for the Shadow Keep — Final Check
quests.summary: Collect all Fragments, check NPCs, and enter the Shadow Keep.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we have gathered almost everything in Scadu Altus. But before entering the Shadow Keep, let's check: you should have at least 7–8 Scadutree Fragments. Make sure you have exhausted all dialogues with Leda, Hornsent, Freyja, Ansbach, and Moore. If Dane hasn't been defeated yet — this is your last chance. And remember: as soon as you enter the Keep, many quests will advance automatically! So make sure you've done everything you wanted. When you are ready — approach the lift at the northern entrance to the Keep and descend. New trials await us!
quests.goal: Ensure all quests and dialogues are complete, and enter the Keep.

chapters.name: Shadow Keep
chapters.mainGoal: Clear the Shadow Keep: explore all four zones, collect Scadutree Fragments, meet key NPCs (Ansbach, Freyja, Hornsent, Quelign), defeat the Golden Hippopotamus, Messmer the Impaler, and optional bosses (Commander Gaius, Scadutree Avatar).
chapters.summary: From entering the keep to defeating Messmer and opening paths to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh and Scaduview — we will go through all halls, bridges and storehouses.

locations.name: Storehouse, First Floor

locations.name: Church District (entrance)
locations.summary: An optional zone in the east of the keep, accessible via Bonny Village.

locations.name: Storehouse, Fourth Floor
locations.summary: Grace on the upper floor, leading to Messmer.

locations.name: Dark Chamber
locations.summary: Grace before the Messmer boss.

locations.name: Messmer the Impaler's Arena
locations.summary: The final arena with the boss Messmer.

locations.name: Shadow Keep Back Gate
locations.summary: Grace behind the keep, leading to Scaduview.

locations.name: Commander Gaius's Arena
locations.summary: An optional boss behind the back gate.

locations.name: Scadutree Avatar's Arena
locations.summary: An optional boss at the base of the Scadutree.

quests.title: Entering the Shadow Keep — Breaking the Charm
quests.summary: Activate the grace at the keep entrance, which triggers the breaking of Miquella's charm.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we are at the gates of the Shadow Keep! Hear that ringing? Miquella's charms are shattering. Now the world will change — all NPCs in the Realm of Shadow will behave differently. This is irreversible! Before entering, make sure you have spoken to Leda, Hornsent, Freyja, Ansbach, and Moore — their quests may break if you missed dialogues. Ride the lift and light the grace at the gate. There is no turning back now.
quests.goal: Approach the keep and activate the grace.

quests.title: Golden Hippopotamus — First Guardian
quests.summary: Defeat the Golden Hippopotamus to open the path to the Storehouse.
quests.directions: Right behind the gate, the Golden Hippopotamus awaits — a huge beast clad in golden armour. It has thick hide, but its hind legs are less protected. Attack them! When it rears up, dodge sideways. If you have progressed Hornsent's and Freyja's quests, their summon signs will be at the entrance — don't hesitate to call them. After victory, you will get two Scadutree Fragments and the Ash of War 'Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns'.
quests.goal: Defeat the boss and obtain Fragments and an Ash of War.

quests.title: Storehouse — Meeting Ansbach
quests.summary: Reach the Storehouse, meet Ansbach, and start his quest.
quests.directions: After the Hippopotamus, take the lift — it will carry us to the Storehouse. It smells of books and dust here. Go around the large altar on the left, weave through the labyrinth of bookshelves. In one of the rooms with an altar you will find Sir Ansbach — he is searching for the Secret Rite Scroll. Talk to him, exhaust all dialogue, he will tell you the scroll is somewhere on the upper floors. Also here you can find a Fire Knight and many shades — be careful.
quests.goal: Activate the grace and talk to Ansbach.

quests.title: Secret Rite Scroll and Path Upward
quests.summary: Find the Secret Rite Scroll and a Fragment on the fourth floor, also obtain the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks and other items.
quests.directions: From the first floor, climb through the labyrinth of bookshelves. Kill Fire Knights, jump across bridges and along the legs of hanging statues. On the fourth floor, activate the grace — next to Marika's statue lies a Scadutree Fragment. In chests you will find 'Ash of War: Wall of Sparks' and 'Field Priest's Cookbook (4)'. And most importantly — on this floor, in a corner, lies the Secret Rite Scroll. Take it back to Ansbach on the first floor — this will advance his quest.
quests.goal: Reach the fourth floor, find the scroll, and deliver it to Ansbach.

quests.title: Church District — Third Encounter with Quelign
quests.summary: Explore the Church District, meet Quelign for the third time, and obtain his reward.
quests.directions: We can explore the Church District — the eastern part of the keep. Go through Bonny Village and exit to the 'Church District — High Road', then head northwest. Here dwell Shades that shoot fire. In one of the rooms you will meet Quelign again — he will be fiercer than ever. After victory, he will become peaceful. If you have the Iris of Grace (from the quest), you can give it to him and get his weapon. Explore the district before it gets flooded after Messmer — some items may become inaccessible.
quests.goal: Reach the Church District, defeat Quelign, and get his weapon (or give him the Iris).

quests.title: Delivering the Scroll to Ansbach and Freyja's Letter
quests.summary: Return to Ansbach, give him the scroll, and receive a letter for Freyja.
quests.directions: Descend back to the first floor and find Ansbach. Give him the scroll — he will be very grateful. After that, he will give you the 'Letter for Freyja', which you need to deliver to her. Freyja is also in the Storehouse — find her and give her the letter. This will advance both their quests.
quests.goal: Give the Secret Rite Scroll to Ansbach and obtain the 'Letter for Freyja'.

quests.title: Path to Messmer — Dark Chamber
quests.summary: Leave the Storehouse, walk along the outer walls, and activate the 'Dark Chamber' grace.
quests.directions: Now that we have done everything in the Storehouse, it is time to face Messmer. Exit the fourth floor through the only exit, walk along the outer walls. Beware of Stormhawks — they attack from the air. At the end you will find the 'Dark Chamber' grace. This is the last point before the fight. Check your weapons and flasks.
quests.goal: Reach the grace before the boss.

quests.title: Messmer the Impaler
quests.summary: Defeat the final boss of the Shadow Keep — Messmer.
quests.directions: Enter the doors — a cutscene will begin. Messmer wields two blades, and in the second phase he transforms into a Base Serpent. He is very fast and dangerous. If you have progressed Hornsent's quest, his summon sign will be at the entrance — summon him if you want to advance his quest. Dodge his strikes and fire attacks, strike when he opens up. After victory, you will get the 'Remembrance of the Impaler' and access to further areas. Remember: after this battle, the Church District will be flooded — so if you have business there, do it now.
quests.goal: Defeat Messmer and obtain his Remembrance.

quests.title: Back Gate and Commander Gaius (optional)
quests.summary: Find the back gate, activate the grace, and defeat the optional boss Commander Gaius.
quests.directions: Now that Messmer has fallen, we can explore the rear of the keep. Go through the Church District or through a secret passage in the Storehouse to the Back Gate. Activate the grace. Beyond the gate, Commander Gaius awaits — an optional boss. He uses a spear and magic, but he has a vulnerability to lightning. If you defeat him, the path to Scaduview — a hidden area beyond the keep — will open.
quests.goal: Defeat Gaius and open the path to Scaduview.

quests.title: Scadutree Avatar (optional)
quests.summary: Defeat the optional boss at the base of the Scadutree.
quests.directions: After the Church District is flooded (which happens after defeating Messmer), you can reach the Base of the Scadutree. There, the Scadutree Avatar will meet you — a huge creature with branch‑arms. Attack its trunk and dodge its magical attacks. This is an optional boss, but it gives a unique Remembrance that can be exchanged for a weapon.
quests.goal: Defeat the Avatar and obtain its Remembrance.

chapters.name: Ancient Ruins of Rauh
chapters.mainGoal: Explore the Ancient Ruins of Rauh: find the region map, collect all 5 Scadutree Fragments and 4 Revered Spirit Ashes, clear optional dungeons (Scorpion River Catacombs, Taylew's Ruined Forge), defeat roaming bosses (Furnace Golem, Rugelea, Divine Beast) and the mandatory boss Romina, Saint of the Bud, to open the path to Enir-Ilim.
chapters.summary: From entering Rauh via two paths to defeating Romina — we will go through overgrown ruins, dungeons, and flooded halls, not missing a single item or quest.

quests.title: Entering the Upper Part of Rauh
quests.summary: Enter Rauh via Viaduct Minor Tower and activate the grace.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we have reached the aqueduct! This bridge leads into the heart of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Take the lift up and light the grace at the top. From here we can explore the upper part of the ruins. Ahead lie flower‑overgrown ruins and ancient secrets. Beware of scorpions and creatures lurking in the shadows.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Viaduct Minor Tower' grace.

quests.title: Entering the Lower Part of Rauh
quests.summary: Enter Rauh via the lower path from Moorth Ruins and activate the grace.
quests.directions: There is another path into Rauh — through tunnels from Moorth Ruins. Go through the cave with blue worms and Marika's statue, then through a second cave with giant birds. The exit will bring us to the base of the ruins. Here we will be met by colossus golems, but we can avoid them. Light the grace — it will be our starting point for exploring the lower part.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Ancient Ruins of Rauh Base' grace.

quests.title: Ancient Ruins of Rauh Map
quests.summary: Find the region map at the stele in the lower part.
quests.directions: From the base, head west, dodging the colossus golems. The map lies on the stele, right before the entrance to the Temple Town Ruins. This is very important, Tarnished! Without the map we will wander this stone labyrinth forever. Grab it quickly before the golems notice us.
quests.goal: Take the Map: Rauh Ruins.

quests.title: Eastern Ruins — Fragment and Illusory Wall
quests.summary: Reach the eastern grace, take the Fragment, and find the illusory wall.
quests.directions: Now with the map, we can navigate. From the Viaduct, head east through the overgrown ruins — there you will find the grace at Miquella's Cross. A Scadutree Fragment lies nearby. And in the room with scorpions, to the northeast, there is a large wall between two braziers — strike it, and a passage will open. Inside are valuable items, don't miss them!
quests.goal: Activate the grace, take the Fragment, and open the illusory wall.

quests.title: Western Ruins — Revered Spirit Ash
quests.summary: Reach the western grace and take the Revered Spirit Ash in the pavilion.
quests.directions: From the eastern part, head west through the ruins. There, by the pavilion, you will find another grace. And inside the pavilion itself lies a Revered Spirit Ash — it will strengthen your summoned spirits. Don't pass it by, Tarnished, it will be very useful for the fight against Romina!
quests.goal: Activate the grace and take the Ash.

quests.title: Church of the Bud — Path to Romina
quests.summary: Reach the entrance to the Church of the Bud and prepare for the boss.
quests.directions: From the western part, head northwest — there, among the flowers, stands the Church of the Bud. Inside are Romina's followers, but they won't stop us. Go through the church and exit the other side — ahead you will see a huge staircase. But first, light the grace at the entrance so we can return here if needed.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Church of the Bud, Main Entrance' grace.

quests.title: Great Staircase — Final Preparation
quests.summary: Reach the grace at the great staircase and prepare for the battle with Romina.
quests.directions: Go through the Church of the Bud and exit onto the open platform. Before you — a giant staircase leading upward. At its foot — a grace. Light it, Tarnished. This is the last stop before the battle. Check your weapons, flasks, and summons. Romina awaits us at the top.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Ancient Ruins, Great Staircase' grace.

quests.title: Romina, Saint of the Bud
quests.summary: Defeat the mandatory boss Romina and open the path to Enir-Ilim.
quests.directions: Climb the staircase and enter the mist. Romina is a half‑human, half‑insect creature covered in buds. In the first phase, she uses polearm combos — dodge and strike her back. In the second phase, she releases rot swarms that will chase you. Use Preserving Boluses and keep your distance when she activates the swarms. If you have Dryleaf Dane as a spirit, summon him. After victory, you will get the 'Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud' and access to Enir-Ilim. This is a mandatory boss, Tarnished — without it we cannot complete our journey.
quests.goal: Defeat Romina and obtain her Remembrance.

quests.title: Scorpion River Catacombs — Death Knight
quests.summary: Clear the optional dungeon and defeat the Death Knight.
quests.directions: In the northwestern part of the lower zone, behind a waterfall, the entrance to the Scorpion River Catacombs is hidden. Inside, scorpions and shades roam. At the end you will face a Death Knight — he is very dangerous, but he has a weakness to holy damage. Defeating him will grant you the Black Knight Huw Spirit Ashes and the Death Knight's Long Axe. It's worth the effort!
quests.goal: Defeat the boss and obtain the Spirit Ashes and the axe.

quests.title: Taylew's Ruined Forge
quests.summary: Clear the optional forge and obtain Taylew's Spirit Ashes.
quests.directions: North of the 'Base' grace, find the forge entrance. Inside — golems and ancient mechanisms. At the end you will meet Taylew himself — the master smith. After victory, you will get his Spirit Ashes — he can be summoned as a mighty golem smith who both attacks and supports. Don't miss this dungeon!
quests.goal: Take Taylew's Spirit Ashes and smithing materials.

chapters.name: Optional Zones
chapters.mainGoal: Explore all optional zones of the DLC: Cerulean Coast, Recluses' River, Abyssal Woods, Scaduview/Hinterland, Jagged Peak, Charo's Hidden Grave. Collect all unique items, Scadutree Fragments, Revered Spirit Ashes, complete quests of Igon, Thiollier, Count Ymir, defeat all optional bosses.
chapters.summary: From the coastline to the dragon peaks — we will go through every hidden corner to not miss a single detail or leave a single quest unfinished.

quests.title: Reach the Cerulean Coast
quests.summary: Get to the Cerulean Coast through caves and the river.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we need to go south, to the blue shore! Go through the cave at the Miranda plant, then descend along the Ellac River, jumping across stones. At the end, a Furnace Golem will meet you — just run past, it's slow. Then climb the slope — and you're on the shore. Light the grace, the sea is glowing!
quests.goal: Activate the 'Cerulean Coast' grace.

quests.title: Cerulean Coast Map and Ghostflame Dragon
quests.summary: Find the map and defeat the Ghostflame Dragon if desired.
quests.directions: The map lies on the slope south of the grace. But a Ghostflame Dragon roams there — it won't attack immediately, but if you get too close, it will start attacking. You can either grab the map quickly and run, or fight it. If you win, you'll get a Dragon Heart and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. The choice is yours, Tarnished!
quests.goal: Take the map and defeat the dragon (optional).

quests.title: Stone Coffin Fissure and the Putrescent Knight
quests.summary: Clear the dungeon, defeat the Putrescent Knight, and find Saint Trina.
quests.directions: In the east of the coast, there is a large fissure — this is the entrance to the Fissure. Descend, skeletons and traps await you. At the end — the Putrescent Knight, he uses rot attacks. Be ready with Preserving Boluses. After victory, you will find a room with Saint Trina — talk to her to advance Thiollier's quest. Don't miss this moment!
quests.goal: Defeat the boss and find Trina.

quests.title: Thiollier's Quest — Talk to Trina
quests.summary: Speak to Saint Trina and receive her blessing.
quests.directions: Approach Trina and speak with her. She will tell you about Miquella and give you advice. This is an important step in Thiollier's quest — if you want to complete it, do it now.
quests.goal: Exhaust dialogue with Trina.

quests.title: Recluses' River and Path to the Darklight Catacombs
quests.summary: Follow the river to the Darklight Catacombs.
quests.directions: From the Cerulean Coast, head east along the cliffs — you will reach the river. Activate the 'Upstream' grace and follow the river downstream. Soon you will need to jump to the western side. Below — the 'Downstream' grace. From there, find the path under the bridge to a hidden room with a painting — strike the wall on the right, there is an illusory wall. Then descend all the way down until you find the entrance to the Darklight Catacombs.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Recluses' River Upstream' grace and reach the catacomb entrance.

quests.title: Darklight Catacombs — Boss Jori, Elder Inquisitor
quests.summary: Clear the catacombs, defeat Jori, and exit to the Abyssal Woods.
quests.directions: Enter the catacombs — there are many traps and shades inside. At the end, Jori, Elder Inquisitor, will meet you — he uses magic and summons shades. Dodge and strike in his openings. After victory, exit outside — you will be in the Abyssal Woods. Activate the grace.
quests.goal: Defeat Jori and exit to the Abyssal Woods.

quests.title: Abyssal Woods and Abyss Map
quests.summary: Explore the Abyssal Woods, find the map, and prepare for Midra's Manse.
quests.directions: In the Abyssal Woods, everything is steeped in Frenzy. Even the sheep can inflict Frenzy on you, so keep Preserving Boluses handy. The map lies at a stele in the woods — take the Map: Abyss. In the church next to the stele, there are 2 Scadutree Fragments. Midra's Manse is in the southwest — head there.
quests.goal: Obtain the map and find the entrance to Midra's Manse.

quests.title: Midra's Manse — Item Collection
quests.summary: Clear Midra's Manse, collect all valuable items, and prepare for the boss.
quests.directions: Enter the manor, strike the illusory wall to the left of the entrance. Take the 'Journal Page' in the first room on the left. Go through the dining room, in the room with the Hornsent Warrior turn right and pull the lever. Climb the stairs behind the moved bookshelf. Pass the shades, exit outside, climb the wooden platforms. In the first room on the right — 'Frenzied Craftsman's Cookbook [3]'. At the end of the corridor — 'Midra's Library' grace. Exit outside, climb the stairs to the right of the Erdtree Priest, enter the door behind the bookshelf — there is a lever. Drop down, walk across the moved bookshelf — at the end lies 'Nanaya's Torch'! Then drop down, head to the room in the east, then to the 'Second Floor Chamber' grace. Nearby, knock down the ladder and jump onto the chandelier for the Revered Spirit Ash. That's everything we need before going to Midra.
quests.goal: Find the 'Nanaya's Torch', Revered Spirit Ash, and other items.

quests.title: Boss: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
quests.summary: Defeat Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, and obtain his Remembrance.
quests.directions: Enter the arena at the centre of the manor. Midra uses Frenzied Flame attacks — this is very dangerous, so keep Preserving Boluses ready. Dodge his beams and attacks, strike after his combos. In the second phase he becomes even fiercer. After victory, you will get the 'Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame'.
quests.goal: Defeat Midra and complete this optional quest.

quests.title: Path to Scaduview and the Hinterland
quests.summary: Enter the hidden area beyond the Shadow Keep.
quests.directions: To reach Scaduview, use the gesture 'O Mother' before the statue in Bonny Village (north of the village). Then enter the Church District of the Shadow Keep from the north side, cross the flooded rooftops, drop through a hole, exit to the lift in the Storehouse, ascend, find the broken bookshelf with a hole in the wall, exit onto the scaffolding, and follow the lift to the Hinterland. Activate the 'Hinterland' grace.
quests.goal: Reach the 'Hinterland' grace.

quests.title: Count Ymir's Quest — Completion at Finger Ruins of Dheo
quests.summary: Find the Finger Ruins of Dheo, ring the bell, and complete the quest.
quests.directions: East of the Hinterland are the Finger Ruins of Dheo. Go to the centre where a bell hangs. Ring it — and you will complete Count Ymir's quest. The reward is the 'Cerulean Seed Talisman +1'. Also check if you missed the Shaman Village nearby.
quests.goal: Ring the bell and receive the reward.

quests.title: Shaman Village
quests.summary: Find the village and collect lore information and items.
quests.directions: East of the Hinterland, slightly south of the Finger Ruins, lies the Shaman Village. This is a beautiful place with falling leaves. Here you can find valuable items and learn more about Miquella. Just stroll through the village and inspect every corner.
quests.goal: Explore the village.

quests.title: Jagged Peak — Igon's Quest
quests.summary: Start Igon's quest, cross the Dragon's Den, and ascend the Peak.
quests.directions: Cross the Dragon's Den in the eastern part of Gravesite Plain. After the Ancient Dragon‑Man boss, exit to the 'Dragon's Den End' grace. Then head to the 'Pillar Path Waypoint' — there you will meet Igon. Talk to him — he will ask you to avenge Bayle. For 100% completion, be sure to summon Igon for the Bayle fight. Ascend the Peak, defeat the Jagged Peak Dragon along the way.
quests.goal: Meet Igon and prepare for Bayle.

quests.title: Bayle the Dread — with Igon
quests.summary: Defeat Bayle the Dread, summoning Igon, and complete his quest.
quests.directions: At the summit of Jagged Peak, Bayle awaits you. Very important: at the entrance to the arena, there will be a summon sign for Igon — be sure to use it! Igon will help you in battle and complete his questline. Bayle is one of the toughest bosses in the DLC — use the Dragon Hunter's Great Katana (drops from the Ancient Dragon‑Man). Dodge his fire attacks and strike his legs. After victory, you will get 'Igon's Greatbow' and his armour set. This is an achievement not to be missed!
quests.goal: Defeat Bayle and claim the rewards.

quests.title: Charo's Hidden Grave — Deathbird
quests.summary: Find the zone, defeat the Deathbird, and obtain the Ash of War.
quests.directions: After the Dragon's Den, exit to the lake with two sleeping dragons, head south past them, go around the dead dragon at the Great Altar of Dragon Communion, and follow the river west — at the end you will find the red zone 'Charo's Hidden Grave'. Activate the grace, then a Deathbird will appear in the centre of the lake. It uses ice and fire attacks. Dodge and strike when it lands. After victory, you will get the 'Ash of War: Ghostflame Ignite'.
quests.goal: Defeat the Deathbird and obtain the 'Ash of War: Ghostflame Ignite'.

chapters.name: Enir-Ilim
chapters.mainGoal: Clear Enir-Ilim, collect all remaining Scadutree Fragments and Revered Spirit Ashes, find the legendary weapon Euporia and the Spira sorcery, defeat Needle Knight Leda and her allies, and then the final boss of the DLC — Radahn, the Promised Consort.
chapters.summary: From entering Enir-Ilim to defeating Radahn — we will go through outer walls, rises, spiral staircases and cleansing chambers, not missing a single item or quest.

quests.title: Entering Enir-Ilim — Burning the Sealing Tree
quests.summary: Burn the Sealing Tree behind Romina's arena and enter Enir-Ilim.
quests.directions: Tarnished, we did it! We defeated Messmer and Romina. Now, behind Romina's arena, stands the Sealing Tree. Approach it and use Messmer's Kindling — it will burn, and we will find ourselves in Enir-Ilim. This is the last point of no return — some NPC quests will close forever. Make sure you have done everything you wanted in the Realm of Shadow. When you are ready — burn the tree. We will arrive at the outer wall; light the grace immediately!
quests.goal: Activate the 'Enir-Ilim: Outer Wall' grace.

quests.title: First Rise and First Items
quests.summary: Reach the 'First Rise' grace, collect Somber Smithing Stone [5] and Fire Grease.
quests.directions: From the outer wall, climb the stairs. On the landing you will meet a Bird Warrior — it is dangerous, but you can run past. Enter the building, climb the stairs and light the 'First Rise' grace. On the right, near the ruined staircase, lies a Somber Smithing Stone [5]. And on a corpse before the large lift — Messmer's Fire Grease x2. Take everything!
quests.goal: Activate the grace and collect loot.

quests.title: Path to the Spiral Rise — Collecting Ashes and Fragments
quests.summary: Cross the courtyard, kill the Erdtree Shaman and Lion Warrior, collect items, and reach the grace.
quests.directions: From the First Rise, exit through the door to the southwest, climb the stairs, cross the bridge — in the centre you will meet an Erdtree Shaman, who drops a Revered Spirit Ash. Then go down to the large tree — there are Fly People, take the Thin Beast Bones and White Flesh Mushroom. Behind the tree, in the building at the statue, find x2 Revered Spirit Ashes. Then climb the stairs upward, kill the archers and the Lion Warrior — he also drops a Revered Spirit Ash. Open the large doors at the end — behind them is Miquella's Cross, a Scadutree Fragment, and the 'Spiral Rise' grace.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Spiral Rise' grace and collect Fragments and Ashes.

quests.title: Spira Sorcery
quests.summary: Find the hidden platform on the tree and take the Spira sorcery.
quests.directions: Before going further, there is a secret! When you are on the platform after the Lion Warrior, approach the cracked corner and jump onto the tree branch. Walk left along it — there will be a platform with an Inquisitor and the Spira sorcery. It creates a rotating pillar of light — a very powerful spell. Take it, Tarnished!
quests.goal: Obtain the Spira sorcery.

quests.title: Legendary Weapon Euporia
quests.summary: Find and obtain the legendary paired blade Euporia.
quests.directions: Now the hardest part, Tarnished. From the Spiral Rise, descend the stairs, turn left into the doorway — there lie the Inquisitor's Spirit Ashes. Then exit onto the platform where you fought the Lion, and find the stairs down to the ruined balcony. Begin carefully jumping along ledges and balconies — this is very dangerous; one wrong step and you will fall. Collect items along the way: Fireproof Liver, Holyproof Liver, Smithing Stones [8], and Bolts. The hardest jump is a running leap into the open window of the tower opposite. If you fall, you'll have to start over. Inside the tower, descend — you will be in Belurat (the title will appear). To the left of the large statue lies a Scadutree Fragment. Descend the giant staircase to the lift, ride it down, cross the bridge over the sewers, and open the door at the end — inside is the legendary paired blade Euporia! After that, teleport back to the 'Spiral Rise'.
quests.goal: Take Euporia from the chest.

quests.title: Path to the Cleansing Chamber — Rooftop Collection
quests.summary: Cross the rooftops, collect remaining items, and reach the grace before Leda.
quests.directions: From the Spiral Rise, climb the spiral stairs, jump through the window onto the roof. Here you will find a second spellcaster — kill him. Go right along the rooftops, avoid the Deathbirds one by one. On the raised section on the right — Smithing Stones [8] x2. In the building on the left behind the Deathbird and Inquisitor — a Revered Spirit Ash. Jump from the ladder to another — below is a Silver Tear Husk. In the building above — Horned Warrior's Spirit Ashes, Stalwart and Neutralising Boluses. Then go through the door on the right, climb the stairs — on the adjacent roof you will see a Frost Lion Warrior. Kill him; in the tower on the left — a Scadutree Fragment. Collect the Sun‑Warming Stones and a Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Then climb up, kill the Inquisitors, take the lift, exit, descend the stairs, kill the Omen and another Lion, take another lift, kill the three Inquisitors in the room, and exit through the door. At the end of the corridor — the 'Cleansing Chamber Anteroom' grace and a Scadutree Fragment nearby.
quests.goal: Activate the 'Cleansing Chamber Anteroom' grace and collect all rooftop items.

quests.title: Battle with Needle Knight Leda and Her Allies
quests.summary: Defeat the final group of NPCs in Enir-Ilim.
quests.directions: Enter the room — Leda will begin a dialogue, then the battle will start. This is a PvP‑style fight against multiple NPCs. The composition depends on your choices in quests. Focus on Leda first — she is the main threat. Use columns for cover and summon spirits to distract enemies. After victory, you will obtain the armour and weapons of all participants: Verdrigris Set, Great Shield, Freyja's Greatsword, Freyja's Set, Dane's Dryleaf Arts, Dane's Footwork, Leda's Set, and Leda's Sword. This is an important battle, Tarnished — it will determine which of Miquella's followers will stand at the Gates.
quests.goal: Defeat Leda and all her allies, obtain their armour and weapons.

quests.title: Radahn, the Promised Consort — Final Boss of the DLC
quests.summary: Defeat the final boss of the DLC — Radahn, the Promised Consort.
quests.directions: Pass through the mist wall — there Radahn awaits you. This is the final boss, Tarnished. He wields two swords and light attacks. In the first phase, stay under him and dodge his combos. When he releases rings of light — jump. At 50% health, Miquella fully possesses Radahn's body — he becomes faster and uses Miquella's Light. Use the Sacred Dragon Talisman for holy damage protection. If you completed Thiollier's and Ansbach's quests, their summon signs will be at the entrance — summon them, they will help. After victory, search the arena — there lie Thiollier's Set, the Hidden Needle, Ansbach's Set, the Obsidian Lamina, Ansbach's Furious Blade, and the 'Remembrance of the Promised Consort'. Also, after the battle, the Circlet of Light will appear at the entrance to the arena. This is the culmination of our entire journey, Tarnished!
quests.goal: Defeat Radahn, obtain his Remembrance, and complete the DLC.
